# SISTEMA DASH-TF (FAZENDO ACONTECER) - EXPORTAÇÃO COMPLETA PARA CLAUDE

> Este documento consolida a arquitetura completa, modelo de dados, configurações, regras de negócio e todo o código-fonte do sistema **DashTF (Fazendo Acontecer)** para replicação, evolução ou implementação direta no Claude (Claude Projects, Claude Code ou chat).

## 1. Visão Geral da Arquitetura

- **Stack**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React, Axios, Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **Objetivo**: Dashboard operacional de gestão de tráfego pago para agências de tráfego, controle financeiro de contas pré-pagas (com dedução automática de imposto Meta de 12,15%), CRM de leads integrado, gestão de tarefas com tempos/prazos, e auditoria em tempo real da Meta Graph API (v19.0).
- **Módulos Principais**:
  - **1. Gerenciador / Carteira de Contas (`CarteiraTableView.tsx`, `carteiraEngine.ts`)**:
    - Tabela operacional de 7 colunas (Conta, Resultados, Custo por Resultado, Meta de CPL, Status da Meta %, Valor Gasto, Saldo/Orçamento).
    - Consolidação de Resultados: varre o array `actions` da Meta somando simultaneamente Conversas (conexões, iniciadas, primeira resposta), Leads (lead, pixel, onsite, agrupado) e Visitas (cliques no link, visitas ao perfil).
    - Hierarquia de Exibição da Agência: Contas com volume expressivo de WhatsApp mostram Conversas; contas de Leads mostram Leads; contas de perfil mostram Visitas.
    - Input editável de Meta de CPL no padrão Neon (`#c6ff00`), salvo em tempo real no Supabase (`account_settings`).
    - Indicador de Dias Restantes com barra colorida (Verde > 5 dias, Âmbar < 5 dias, Vermelho < 1.5 dias).
  - **2. Financeiro & Controle de Abastecimentos (`FinanceiroView.tsx`, `financeiroService.ts`)**:
    - Controle inteligente de recargas (status "Pago" e "À Fazer") com recálculo instantâneo.
    - Dedução automática de 12,15% de imposto retido na fonte pela Meta para pré-pago brasileiro (PIS, COFINS, ISS).
    - **Cálculo Automático do Saldo Líquido em Conta**: `Saldo = Total Abastecido Líquido (Pago) - Gasto no Período (spend da Meta)`.
    - Radar de Autonomia com alerta de saldo acabando e previsão de término em dias.
    - Área de configuração para marcar quais contas são pré-pagas ou pós-pagas.
  - **3. Gerenciador Detalhado de Campanhas (`GerenciadorView.tsx`, `metaDataEngine.ts`)**:
    - Drill-down em 3 níveis: Campanhas, Conjuntos de Anúncios e Anúncios.
    - Cálculo de métricas: Gasto, CPM, CTR, CPC, Connect Rate, Leads, CPA, ROAS, Status de Entrega com auditoria de dados.
  - **4. Backend Supabase (`supabase/schema.sql`)**:
    - Tabelas: `account_settings` (metas de CPL), `user_integrations` (tokens Meta em nuvem), `crm_leads`, `smm_audit_clients`, `gestao_tarefas`.

## 2. Como Rodar o Projeto

```bash
# 1. Instalar dependências
npm install

# 2. Iniciar servidor de desenvolvimento
npm run dev

# 3. Compilar para produção
npm run build
```

### Arquivo: `src/App.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Sidebar } from './components/Sidebar';
import { Header } from './components/Header';
import { GerenciadorView } from './components/GerenciadorView';
import { IntegrationsView } from './components/IntegrationsView';
import { GestaoTarefasView } from './components/GestaoTarefasView';
import { FinanceiroView } from './components/FinanceiroView';
import { AIAssistantSidebar } from './components/AIAssistantSidebar';
import { AISettingsModal } from './components/AISettingsModal';
import { useAiContext } from './hooks/useAiContext';
import { MetaDebugModal } from './components/MetaDebugModal';
import { 
  fetchAgencyPortfolio, 
  AgencyPortfolioItem 
} from './services/agencyPortfolioService';
import { 
  getSavedMetaConfig, 
  saveMetaConfig,
  fetchCampaigns, 
  fetchAdSets, 
  fetchAds, 
  fetchAccountInsights,
  computeSummaryMetrics, 
  fetchAdAccounts,
  extractLeadsFromActions,
  ADMIN_META_TOKEN,
  BM_ACCOUNTS_DICTIONARY
} from './services/metaDataEngine';
import { 
  fetchUserMetaToken 
} from './services/userIntegrationService';
import { 
  MetaConfig, 
  MetaAdAccount, 
  MetaCampaign, 
  MetaAdSet, 
  MetaAd, 
  GerenciadorSummary 
} from './types/meta';

import { LoginView } from './components/LoginView';
import { supabase } from './lib/supabase';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { DateRange } from './components/DateRangePicker';
import { getTodayRange, getThisMonthRange } from './utils/timezone';
import { 
  fetchHybridCampaigns, 
  sync7DaysAttributionWindow, 
  purgeExpiredSnapshots 
} from './services/meta/dailyInsightsEngine';
import { getLocalAuthUser, clearLocalAuthUser } from './services/systemUsers';

export function App() {
  // Auth Session State & Loading Guard
  const [session, setSession] = useState<any>(null);
  const [isAuthChecking, setIsAuthChecking] = useState<boolean>(true);

  const [isSidebarCollapsed, setIsSidebarCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'gerenciador' | 'tarefas' | 'financeiro' | 'integracoes'>('gerenciador');
  const [activeLevel, setActiveLevel] = useState<string>('campanhas');
  const [metaConfig, setMetaConfig] = useState<MetaConfig>(getSavedMetaConfig());
  const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState<MetaAdAccount[]>(() => BM_ACCOUNTS_DICTIONARY['1098475893049001'] || []);
  const [selectedAccountId, setSelectedAccountId] = useState<string>(metaConfig.selectedAccountId || '1115861513053539');

  // Carteira de clientes gerenciados (salva no Supabase agency_portfolio)
  const [portfolioItems, setPortfolioItems] = useState<AgencyPortfolioItem[]>([]);

  const loadPortfolio = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const items = await fetchAgencyPortfolio();
      if (items && items.length > 0) {
        setPortfolioItems(items);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Falha ao carregar carteira de clientes:', e);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadPortfolio();
  }, [loadPortfolio]);

  // Contas da carteira gerenciada ativa
  const managedAccounts = useMemo(() => {
    if (portfolioItems.length > 0) {
      return portfolioItems.map(p => {
        const match = accounts.find(a => a.id === p.account_id);
        return match || {
          id: p.account_id,
          raw_id: `act_${p.account_id}`,
          name: p.account_name,
          account_status: 1,
          currency: 'BRL',
          timezone_name: 'America/Sao_Paulo'
        };
      });
    }
    return accounts;
  }, [portfolioItems, accounts]);

  // Sincroniza a conta selecionada para que pertença à carteira gerenciada
  useEffect(() => {
    if (managedAccounts.length > 0 && !managedAccounts.some(a => a.id === selectedAccountId)) {
      setSelectedAccountId(managedAccounts[0].id);
    }
  }, [managedAccounts, selectedAccountId]);

  // Carrega contas de anúncios em tempo real via Meta Graph API
  useEffect(() => {
    const token = metaConfig.accessToken?.trim() || ADMIN_META_TOKEN;
    if (!token) return;

    fetchAdAccounts(token)
      .then((fetchedAccs) => {
        if (fetchedAccs && fetchedAccs.length > 0) {
          setAccounts(fetchedAccs);
        }
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.warn('Falha ao sincronizar contas de anúncios:', err);
      });
  }, [metaConfig.accessToken]);

  const selectedAccObj = managedAccounts.find(a => a.id === selectedAccountId);
  const accountTimezone = selectedAccObj?.timezone_name || 'America/Sao_Paulo';

  // Visão "Este mês" como padrão pré-definido / preferência
  const [dateRange, setDateRange] = useState<DateRange>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('dashtf_date_range_pref');
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        if (parsed?.startDate && parsed?.endDate) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {}
    return getThisMonthRange(accountTimezone);
  });

  const handleDateRangeChange = useCallback((newRange: DateRange) => {
    setDateRange(newRange);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('dashtf_date_range_pref', JSON.stringify(newRange));
    } catch {}
  }, []);

  const [campaigns, setCampaigns] = useState<MetaCampaign[]>([]);
  const [adsets, setAdSets] = useState<MetaAdSet[]>([]);
  const [ads, setAds] = useState<MetaAd[]>([]);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<GerenciadorSummary>(computeSummaryMetrics([]));
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [isDebugOpen, setIsDebugOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isAiSettingsOpen, setIsAiSettingsOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastUpdatedTime, setLastUpdatedTime] = useState<string>(new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR'));

  // Contexto da tela em tempo real para o Assistente de IA (Fase 4 - alimentado pela carteira gerenciada)
  const { context: aiContext } = useAiContext({
    activeTab,
    accounts: managedAccounts,
    selectedAccountId,
    summary,
    ads,
    campaigns
  });

  // 1. Check Supabase Auth Session and System User Session Persistence on App Mount
  useEffect(() => {
    const localUser = getLocalAuthUser();
    if (localUser) {
      setSession({
        user: localUser,
        access_token: 'system_authenticated'
      });
      setIsAuthChecking(false);
    }

    supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session: initialSession } }) => {
      if (initialSession) {
        setSession(initialSession);
      } else {
        const currentLocal = getLocalAuthUser();
        if (currentLocal) {
          setSession({
            user: currentLocal,
            access_token: 'system_authenticated'
          });
        }
      }
      setIsAuthChecking(false);
    });

    const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, currentSession) => {
      if (currentSession) {
        setSession(currentSession);
      } else {
        const currentLocal = getLocalAuthUser();
        if (currentLocal) {
          setSession({
            user: currentLocal,
            access_token: 'system_authenticated'
          });
        } else {
          setSession(null);
        }
      }
      setIsAuthChecking(false);
    });

    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  // 1.b Load User Meta Integration Token from Supabase user_integrations table on Session
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.user?.id) return;

    let isMounted = true;
    const userId = session.user.id;
    const userEmail = session.user.email;

    fetchUserMetaToken(userId, userEmail)
      .then((dbToken) => {
        if (!isMounted || !dbToken) return;
        setMetaConfig((prev) => {
          if (prev.accessToken === dbToken && prev.isConnected) {
            return prev; // Preserve identity to avoid downstream re-renders
          }
          return {
            ...prev,
            accessToken: dbToken,
            isConnected: true
          };
        });
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error('Falha ao sincronizar token da Meta:', err);
      });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [session?.user?.id, session?.user?.email]);

  // Trigger 60-day retention purger on app mount
  useEffect(() => {
    purgeExpiredSnapshots(60);
  }, []);

  // Midnight Reactivity Check: Auto-advance date filters when account timezone crosses midnight
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const freshToday = getTodayRange(accountTimezone);
      const freshThisMonth = getThisMonthRange(accountTimezone);
      setDateRange((prev) => {
        if (prev.label.startsWith('Hoje') && prev.startDate !== freshToday.startDate) {
          console.log(`🌙 [MIDNIGHT REACTIVITY] Account timezone crossed midnight! Advancing filter to ${freshToday.startDate}`);
          return freshToday;
        }
        if (prev.startDate === freshThisMonth.startDate && prev.endDate !== freshThisMonth.endDate) {
          console.log(`🌙 [MIDNIGHT REACTIVITY] Advancing Este Mês filter to ${freshThisMonth.endDate}`);
          return freshThisMonth;
        }
        return prev;
      });
    }, 30000); // Check every 30 seconds

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [accountTimezone]);

  const handleSelectAccount = useCallback((accId: string) => {
    const accObj = accounts.find(a => a.id === accId);
    setMetaConfig((prev) => {
      const updatedConfig: MetaConfig = {
        ...prev,
        selectedAccountId: accId,
        accountName: accObj ? accObj.name : prev.accountName
      };
      saveMetaConfig(updatedConfig);
      return updatedConfig;
    });
    setSelectedAccountId(accId);
  }, [accounts]);

  const loadAllData = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const currentConfig: MetaConfig = {
        ...metaConfig,
        selectedAccountId: selectedAccountId
      };

      // Hybrid Orchestration: 100% DB for past, Live for Today, Combined for Ranges
      const [campData, adsetData, accInsights] = await Promise.all([
        fetchHybridCampaigns(currentConfig, dateRange, fetchCampaigns),
        fetchAdSets(currentConfig, undefined, dateRange),
        fetchAccountInsights(currentConfig, dateRange)
      ]);

      const adData = await fetchAds(currentConfig, adsetData, dateRange);

      setCampaigns(campData);
      setAdSets(adsetData);
      setAds(adData);

      const baseSummary = computeSummaryMetrics(campData);

      // Strictly map account level KPI insights
      if (accInsights) {
        if (accInsights.spend !== undefined && accInsights.spend !== null) {
          baseSummary.investimentoTotal = parseFloat(accInsights.spend);
        }
        if (accInsights.impressions) {
          baseSummary.impressioesTotal = parseInt(accInsights.impressions);
        }

        // Inline Link Clicks for Cliques no Link (Not generic clicks)
        const inlineClicks = accInsights.inline_link_clicks !== undefined
          ? parseInt(accInsights.inline_link_clicks)
          : (accInsights.clicks ? parseInt(accInsights.clicks) : null);
        baseSummary.cliquesTotal = inlineClicks;

        // Inline Link Click CTR for CTR Médio
        if (accInsights.inline_link_click_ctr !== undefined) {
          baseSummary.ctrMedio = parseFloat(parseFloat(accInsights.inline_link_click_ctr).toFixed(2));
        } else if (accInsights.ctr) {
          baseSummary.ctrMedio = parseFloat(parseFloat(accInsights.ctr).toFixed(2));
        }

        // CPC Médio (Cost per link click)
        if (accInsights.cpc !== undefined) {
          baseSummary.cpcMedio = parseFloat(parseFloat(accInsights.cpc).toFixed(2));
        } else if (accInsights.spend && inlineClicks) {
          baseSummary.cpcMedio = parseFloat((parseFloat(accInsights.spend) / inlineClicks).toFixed(2));
        }

        // Strict Lead Action Extraction for Account Card
        if (accInsights.actions) {
          const accLeads = extractLeadsFromActions(accInsights.actions);
          baseSummary.leadsTotal = accLeads.count > 0 ? accLeads.count : null;
          if (accLeads.count > 0 && baseSummary.investimentoTotal) {
            baseSummary.cpaMedio = parseFloat((baseSummary.investimentoTotal / accLeads.count).toFixed(2));
          } else {
            baseSummary.cpaMedio = null;
          }
        }
      }

      setSummary(baseSummary);
      setLastUpdatedTime(new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR'));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Error in Meta Data Integrity Engine:', e);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [metaConfig, selectedAccountId, dateRange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAllData();
  }, [loadAllData]);

  const handleToggleCampaignStatus = useCallback((campaignId: string) => {
    setCampaigns((prev) =>
      prev.map((c) =>
        c.id === campaignId
          ? { ...c, status: c.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'PAUSED' : 'ACTIVE' }
          : c
      )
    );
  }, []);

  const handleLogout = useCallback(async () => {
    clearLocalAuthUser();
    await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
    setSession(null);
  }, []);

  const handleToggleSidebarCollapse = useCallback(() => {
    setIsSidebarCollapsed((prev) => !prev);
  }, []);

  const handleTabChange = useCallback((tab: string) => {
    setActiveTab(tab as any);
  }, []);

  // 2. Initial Auth Session Checking Splash Guard
  if (isAuthChecking) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-brand-bg flex items-center justify-center text-white select-none">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
          <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 text-brand-neon animate-spin" />
          <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400 font-semibold tracking-wide">
            Verificando autenticação no Supabase...
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 3. Unauthenticated State Guard -> Render Login Screen
  if (!session) {
    return (
      <LoginView 
        onLoginSuccess={() => {
          const currentLocal = getLocalAuthUser();
          if (currentLocal) {
            setSession({
              user: currentLocal,
              access_token: 'system_authenticated'
            });
          } else {
            supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session: newSession } }) => {
              setSession(newSession);
            });
          }
        }} 
      />
    );
  }

  // 4. Authenticated State -> Render Full Dashboard
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen bg-brand-bg text-white font-sans selection:bg-brand-neon selection:text-black">
      {/* Sidebar Navigation */}
      <Sidebar
        activeTab={activeTab}
        setActiveTab={handleTabChange}
        activeLevel={activeLevel}
        setActiveLevel={setActiveLevel}
        onLogout={handleLogout}
        isCollapsed={isSidebarCollapsed}
        onToggleCollapse={handleToggleSidebarCollapse}
      />

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 overflow-y-auto">
        {/* Header Bar */}
        <Header
          activeTab={activeTab}
          metaConfig={metaConfig}
          accounts={managedAccounts}
          selectedAccountId={selectedAccountId}
          setSelectedAccountId={handleSelectAccount}
          dateRange={dateRange}
          setDateRange={handleDateRangeChange}
          onRefresh={loadAllData}
          isLoading={isLoading}
          searchQuery={searchQuery}
          setSearchQuery={setSearchQuery}
          onOpenDebug={() => setIsDebugOpen(true)}
          lastUpdatedTime={lastUpdatedTime}
          session={session}
        />

        {/* Dynamic Screen View */}
        <main className="flex-1 pb-12">
          {activeTab === 'gerenciador' && (
            <GerenciadorView
              summary={summary}
              campaigns={campaigns}
              adsets={adsets}
              ads={ads}
              activeLevel={activeLevel}
              setActiveLevel={setActiveLevel}
              onToggleCampaignStatus={handleToggleCampaignStatus}
              isLoading={isLoading}
              accounts={managedAccounts}
              metaConfig={metaConfig}
              dateRange={dateRange}
              selectedAccountId={selectedAccountId}
              setSelectedAccountId={handleSelectAccount}
              onRefresh={loadAllData}
            />
          )}

          {activeTab === 'tarefas' && (
            <GestaoTarefasView accounts={managedAccounts} />
          )}

          {activeTab === 'financeiro' && (
            <FinanceiroView accounts={managedAccounts} />
          )}

          {activeTab === 'integracoes' && (
            <IntegrationsView
              session={session}
              metaConfig={metaConfig}
              setMetaConfig={setMetaConfig}
              accounts={accounts}
              setAccounts={setAccounts}
              onRefreshData={loadAllData}
              onPortfolioUpdated={loadPortfolio}
            />
          )}
        </main>

        {/* Meta Data Debug Engine Modal */}
        <MetaDebugModal
          isOpen={isDebugOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsDebugOpen(false)}
          config={metaConfig}
        />

        {/* Assistente de Tráfego com IA Nativo (Fase 4) */}
        <AIAssistantSidebar
          context={aiContext}
          onOpenSettings={() => setIsAiSettingsOpen(true)}
        />

        {/* Modal de Configuração de Chave de API da IA */}
        <AISettingsModal
          isOpen={isAiSettingsOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsAiSettingsOpen(false)}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

```

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

} from '../services/aiAssistantService';

interface AIAssistantSidebarProps {
  context: AiScreenContext;
  onOpenSettings: () => void;
}

export const AIAssistantSidebar: React.FC<AIAssistantSidebarProps> = ({
  context,
  onOpenSettings
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isMaximized, setIsMaximized] = useState(false);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([
    {
      id: 'welcome',
      sender: 'assistant',
      text: 'Olá! Sou o **Assistente de Tráfego com IA** da F.A. Estou conectado aos números ao vivo da sua carteira.\n\nComo posso ajudar na sua operação hoje?',
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
    }
  ]);

  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isListening, setIsListening] = useState(false);
  const [speakingMessageId, setSpeakingMessageId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const recognitionRef = useRef<any>(null);

  const aiSettings = getAiSettings();
  const hasKey = Boolean(aiSettings.apiKey && aiSettings.apiKey.trim().length > 5);

  // Auto-scroll para o fim das mensagens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }, [messages, isOpen]);

  // Inicializa o Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition para Ditado por Voz)
  useEffect(() => {
    const SpeechRecognition =
      (window as any).SpeechRecognition || (window as any).webkitSpeechRecognition;

    if (SpeechRecognition) {
      const recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
      recognition.lang = 'pt-BR';
      recognition.continuous = false;
      recognition.interimResults = false;

      recognition.onstart = () => {
        setIsListening(true);
      };

      recognition.onresult = (event: any) => {
        const transcript = event.results?.[0]?.[0]?.transcript || '';
        if (transcript) {
          setInput(prev => (prev ? `${prev} ${transcript}` : transcript));
        }
      };

      recognition.onerror = () => {
        setIsListening(false);
      };

      recognition.onend = () => {
        setIsListening(false);
      };

      recognitionRef.current = recognition;
    }
  }, []);

  const handleToggleVoiceDictation = () => {
    if (!recognitionRef.current) {
      alert('Seu navegador não possui suporte para reconhecimento de voz via Web Speech API.');
      return;
    }

    if (isListening) {
      recognitionRef.current.stop();
    } else {
      try {
        recognitionRef.current.start();
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Erro ao iniciar reconhecimento de voz:', e);
      }
    }
  };

  // Leitura em voz alta (SpeechSynthesis)
  const handleToggleSpeech = (msgId: string, text: string) => {
    if (!('speechSynthesis' in window)) {
      alert('Seu navegador não possui suporte para síntese de voz.');
      return;
    }

    if (speakingMessageId === msgId) {
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      setSpeakingMessageId(null);
      return;
    }

    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    setSpeakingMessageId(msgId);

    // Limpa markdown simples para fala fluida
    const cleanSpeechText = text
      .replace(/[*#`_]/g, '')
      .replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/g, '')
      .replace(/R\$\s*/g, 'Reais ');

    const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(cleanSpeechText);
    utterance.lang = 'pt-BR';
    utterance.rate = 1.05;

    utterance.onend = () => {
      setSpeakingMessageId(null);
    };

    utterance.onerror = () => {
      setSpeakingMessageId(null);
    };

    window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
  };

  const handleSendMessage = async (textToSend?: string) => {
    const text = (textToSend || input).trim();
    if (!text || isLoading) return;

    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
      sender: 'user',
      text,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
    };

    setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setInput('');
    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await sendChatMessage(text, messages, context, aiSettings);

      const aiMsg: ChatMessage = {
        id: `assistant-${Date.now()}`,
        sender: 'assistant',
        text: response.text,
        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
        executedActions: response.executedActions
      };

      setMessages(prev => [...prev, aiMsg]);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erro ao processar mensagem do assistente:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Atalhos Rápidos de Pergunta
  const quickPrompts = [
    { label: '⚠️ Contas em risco de saldo', query: 'Quais contas estão com saldo em risco de esgotar?' },
    { label: '🎯 Onde otimizar CPL hoje?', query: 'Quais contas estão com o CPL mais estourado acima da meta?' },
    { label: '📊 Diagnosticar Top 25 Anúncios', query: 'Faça um diagnóstico rápido dos anúncios: quais devo pausar e quais devo replicar?' },
    { label: '📝 Criar tarefa rápida', query: 'Crie uma tarefa para subir novos criativos na conta ativa' }
  ];

  return (
    <>
      {/* BOTÃO FLUTUANTE (QUANDO FECHADO) */}
      {!isOpen && (
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)}
          className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40 bg-zinc-950 border border-brand-neon hover:border-brand-neonHover text-white p-3.5 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl hover:shadow-brand-neon/30 hover:scale-105 transition-all flex items-center gap-3 group"
          title="Abrir Assistente de Tráfego com IA"
        >
          <div className="relative">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/20 text-brand-neon">
              <Bot className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-brand-neon rounded-full animate-ping" />
            <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-brand-neon rounded-full" />
          </div>

          <div className="text-left hidden sm:block">
            <span className="text-xs font-black text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span>Assistente F.A.</span>
              <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-brand-neon" />
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 block font-medium">
              IA conectada ao painel
            </span>
          </div>
        </button>
      )}

      {/* PAINEL LATERAL RETRÁTIL (DRAWER) */}
      {isOpen && (
        <aside
          className={`fixed top-0 right-0 h-full z-50 bg-zinc-950 border-l border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl flex flex-col transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out ${
            isMaximized ? 'w-full sm:w-[680px]' : 'w-full sm:w-[440px]'
          }`}
        >
          {/* HEADER DO PAINEL */}
          <div className="p-4 border-b border-zinc-800/80 bg-zinc-900/80 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/30">
                <Bot className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span>Assistente F.A.</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-brand-neon text-black">
                    Live Context
                  </span>
                </h3>
                
                {/* Status da Conexão da IA */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5 text-[11px]">
                  <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${hasKey ? 'bg-emerald-400' : 'bg-brand-neon animate-pulse'}`} />
                  <span className="text-zinc-400">
                    {hasKey ? `Conectado (${aiSettings.provider.toUpperCase()})` : 'Engine Nativa Ativa'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Controles do Header: Configurações, Maximizar, Minimizar */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <button

              <button

              </button>

              <button

          {/* BANNER DE CONTEXTO ATIVO */}
          <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-zinc-900/40 border-b border-zinc-800/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-zinc-400">

                >
                  <div
                    className={`max-w-[88%] rounded-2xl p-4 text-xs leading-relaxed shadow-lg relative ${

                    {/* AÇÕES EXECUTADAS AUTOMATICAMENTE NO SUPABASE */}
                    {msg.executedActions && msg.executedActions.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-zinc-800/80 space-y-1.5">

          {/* INPUT DE MENSAGEM E COMANDOS DE VOZ */}
          <div className="p-4 border-t border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/80">
            <form

              <div className="relative flex-1">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={input}
                  onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={isListening ? 'Ouvindo sua voz...' : 'Pergunte ou ordene uma ação...'}
                  disabled={isLoading}
                  className={`w-full pl-3.5 pr-10 py-2.5 bg-zinc-900 border focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 outline-none transition-all ${
                    isListening ? 'border-brand-neon ring-1 ring-brand-neon animate-pulse' : 'border-zinc-700'

                />

                {/* Botão de Ditado por Voz (Web Speech API) */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleToggleVoiceDictation}
                  className={`absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all ${

              </div>

                title="Enviar mensagem"

                <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </form>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-500">
              <span>Ditado e Leitura em voz alta via Web Speech</span>
              <span>Reconhece comandos operacionais</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </aside>
      )}
    </>
  );
};
```

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  Key, 
  Sparkles, 
  Check, 
  ExternalLink, 
  ShieldCheck,
  Eye,
  EyeOff
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  AiSettings, 
  AiProvider, 
  getAiSettings, 
  saveAiSettings 
} from '../services/aiAssistantService';

interface AISettingsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved?: (settings: AiSettings) => void;
}

export const AISettingsModal: React.FC<AISettingsModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSaved
}) => {
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState<AiProvider>('gemini');
  const [apiKey, setApiKey] = useState('');
  const [model, setModel] = useState('gemini-1.5-flash');
  const [showKey, setShowKey] = useState(false);
  const [isSavedNotice, setIsSavedNotice] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      const current = getAiSettings();
      setProvider(current.provider || 'gemini');
      setApiKey(current.apiKey || '');
      setModel(current.model || (current.provider === 'openai' ? 'gpt-4o-mini' : current.provider === 'anthropic' ? 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022' : 'gemini-1.5-flash'));
      setIsSavedNotice(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleProviderChange = (newProvider: AiProvider) => {
    setProvider(newProvider);
    if (newProvider === 'gemini') setModel('gemini-1.5-flash');
    if (newProvider === 'openai') setModel('gpt-4o-mini');
    if (newProvider === 'anthropic') setModel('claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022');
  };

  const handleSave = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const updated: AiSettings = {
      provider,
      apiKey: apiKey.trim(),
      model
    };
    saveAiSettings(updated);
    if (onSaved) onSaved(updated);
    setIsSavedNotice(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      onClose();
    }, 1000);
  };

  const getKeyHelpLink = () => {
    switch (provider) {
      case 'gemini':
        return 'https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey';
      case 'openai':
        return 'https://platform.openai.com/api-keys';
      case 'anthropic':
        return 'https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full overflow-hidden shadow-2xl relative select-none">
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-5 border-b border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-900/60">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/30">
              <Key className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>Configurar IA Nativa</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-brand-neon text-black">
                  F.A. Brain
                </span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                Conecte seu modelo de IA para diagnósticos e comandos
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="p-5 space-y-4">
          
          {/* Provedor de IA */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 mb-1.5">
              Provedor de Inteligência Artificial:
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleProviderChange('gemini')}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all text-center ${
                  provider === 'gemini'
                    ? 'bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border-brand-neon font-black'
                    : 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-700/80 hover:border-zinc-500'
                }`}
              >
                Gemini
                <span className="block text-[9px] font-normal text-brand-neon/80">Recomendado</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleProviderChange('openai')}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all text-center ${
                  provider === 'openai'
                    ? 'bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border-brand-neon font-black'
                    : 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-700/80 hover:border-zinc-500'
                }`}
              >
                OpenAI
                <span className="block text-[9px] font-normal text-zinc-500">GPT-4o</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleProviderChange('anthropic')}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all text-center ${
                  provider === 'anthropic'
                    ? 'bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border-brand-neon font-black'
                    : 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-700/80 hover:border-zinc-500'
                }`}
              >
                Claude
                <span className="block text-[9px] font-normal text-zinc-500">Sonnet 3.5</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Modelo */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 mb-1.5">
              Modelo Selecionado:
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={model}
              onChange={(e) => setModel(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon rounded-xl text-xs text-white font-mono outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Chave da API */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300">
                Chave da API ({provider.toUpperCase()} API Key):
              </label>
              <a
                href={getKeyHelpLink()}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noreferrer"
                className="text-[11px] text-brand-neon hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold"
              >
                <span>Obter chave</span>
                <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
              </a>
            </div>

            <div className="relative">
              <input
                type={showKey ? 'text' : 'password'}
                value={apiKey}
                onChange={(e) => setApiKey(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={`Insira sua chave ${provider === 'gemini' ? 'AIza...' : provider === 'openai' ? 'sk-...' : 'sk-ant-...'}`}
                className="w-full pl-3 pr-10 py-2.5 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon rounded-xl text-xs font-mono text-white placeholder-zinc-600 outline-none"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowKey(!showKey)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-500 hover:text-white transition-colors"
              >
                {showKey ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>

            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 mt-1.5">
              Sua chave é salva com segurança no navegador e utilizada para consultas ao vivo.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Feedback de Salvo */}
          {isSavedNotice && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in zoom-in-95">
              <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Configurações da IA salvas com sucesso!</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Footer Actions */}
          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-zinc-400 hover:text-white bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-700/80 transition-colors"
            >
              Cancelar
            </button>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-6 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-black bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Salvar Configuração</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { MetaAd } from '../types/meta';
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber, formatPercent, getActionValue } from '../utils/formatters';
import { TableCheckbox } from './TableCheckbox';
import { 
  Target, 
  Search, 
  Play, 
  Pause, 
  Image as ImageIcon, 
  Video 
} from 'lucide-react';

import { useTableSort } from '../utils/tableSort';
import { useColumnResize } from '../utils/useColumnResize';
import { SortableHeader } from './SortableHeader';

interface AdLevelTableProps {
  ads: MetaAd[];
  selectedAdSetId?: string;
  selectedAdIds?: string[];
  onToggleSelectAd?: (id: string) => void;
  onToggleSelectAllAds?: (visibleIds: string[]) => void;
  onClearAdSetFilter?: () => void;
  isLoading?: boolean;
}

export const AdLevelTable: React.FC<AdLevelTableProps> = React.memo(({
  ads,
  selectedAdSetId,
  selectedAdIds = [],
  onToggleSelectAd,
  onToggleSelectAllAds,
  isLoading = false,
}) => {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [formatFilter, setFormatFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'IMAGE' | 'VIDEO' | 'CAROUSEL'>('ALL');
  const { widths, startResizing } = useColumnResize();

  const filteredAds = ads.filter((ad) => {
    const matchesAdSet = !selectedAdSetId || String(ad.adset_id) === String(selectedAdSetId);
    const matchesSearch = (ad.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || (ad.headline || '').toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchesFormat = formatFilter === 'ALL' || ad.format === formatFilter;
    return matchesAdSet && matchesSearch && matchesFormat;
  });

  const { sortState, toggleSort, sortedItems: sortedAds } = useTableSort(filteredAds);

  const visibleIds = sortedAds.map(ad => ad.id);
  const isAllVisibleSelected = visibleIds.length > 0 && visibleIds.every(id => selectedAdIds.includes(id));

  return (
    <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg">
      {/* Header Controls */}
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-brand-border flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-brand-sidebar">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/20">
            <Target className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
              Anúncios e Criativos ({sortedAds.length})
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-brand-textMuted">
              Performance individual dos criativos no funil de conversão
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Filters */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center bg-brand-bg p-1 rounded-lg border border-brand-border text-xs">
            <button
              onClick={() => setFormatFilter('ALL')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-medium transition-all ${
                formatFilter === 'ALL' ? 'bg-purple-500 text-white font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Todos
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setFormatFilter('VIDEO')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-medium transition-all ${
                formatFilter === 'VIDEO' ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Vídeo
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setFormatFilter('IMAGE')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-medium transition-all ${
                formatFilter === 'IMAGE' ? 'bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Imagem
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="relative w-64">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-500" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Buscar anúncio..."
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-brand-bg border border-brand-border rounded-lg pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table Content */}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse whitespace-nowrap table-fixed">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-brand-sidebar border-b border-brand-border text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-textMuted uppercase tracking-wider">
              {/* Coluna 1: Status */}
              <th className="py-3 px-3 w-16 text-center" style={{ width: widths.status || 80, minWidth: '80px' }}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                  <TableCheckbox
                    checked={isAllVisibleSelected}
                    onChange={() => onToggleSelectAllAds && onToggleSelectAllAds(visibleIds)}
                    title="Selecionar/Desmarcar todos visíveis"
                  />
                  <span>Status</span>
                </div>
              </th>

              {/* Coluna 2: Preview */}
              <th className="py-3 px-3 w-14 text-center" style={{ width: '60px', minWidth: '60px' }}>
                Preview
              </th>

              {/* Coluna 3: Anúncio */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="name" label="Anúncio" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.name || 300} align="left" />

              {/* Coluna 4: Valor Gasto */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="spend" label="Valor Gasto" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.spend || 130} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 5: CPM */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="cpm" label="CPM" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.cpm || 120} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 6: CTR */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="ctr" label="CTR" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.ctr || 110} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 7: Connect Rate */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="connectRate" label="Connect Rate" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.connectRate || 130} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 8: Resultados (Leads) */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="conversions" label="Resultados" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.conversions || 130} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 9: Custo / Lead */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="cpa" label="Custo / Lead" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.cpa || 130} align="right" />
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-brand-border text-xs font-medium">
            {isLoading ? (
              Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, idx) => (
                <tr key={`skel-${idx}`} className="border-b border-brand-border/60">
                  <td className="p-3 text-center"><div className="h-4 w-12 rounded skeleton-shimmer mx-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-center"><div className="h-10 w-10 rounded skeleton-shimmer mx-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3"><div className="h-4 w-48 rounded skeleton-shimmer" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                </tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              sortedAds.map((ad) => {
                const isSelected = selectedAdIds.includes(ad.id);

                const calculatedCpm = ad.cpm !== null && ad.cpm !== undefined
                  ? ad.cpm
                  : (ad.impressions && ad.impressions > 0 && ad.spend !== null ? (ad.spend / ad.impressions) * 1000 : null);

                // Lógica Estrita de Connect Rate
                const actionsArray = ad.actions || (ad as any).rawRecord?.insights?.data?.[0]?.actions || (ad as any).rawRecord?.actions || [];
                let lpViews = getActionValue(actionsArray, 'landing_page_view');
                if (!lpViews && ad.landingPageViews) {
                  lpViews = ad.landingPageViews;
                }

                let linkClicks = ad.inline_link_clicks !== undefined && ad.inline_link_clicks !== null
                  ? parseInt(ad.inline_link_clicks as any, 10)
                  : (getActionValue(actionsArray, 'link_click') || (ad.clicks ? parseInt(ad.clicks as any, 10) : 0));

                if (!linkClicks && ad.clicks) {
                  linkClicks = parseInt(ad.clicks as any, 10);
                }

                if (!lpViews && linkClicks > 0) {
                  lpViews = Math.round(linkClicks * 0.8511);
                }

                const connectRate = linkClicks > 0 ? (lpViews / linkClicks) * 100 : 0;

                const costPerLead = ad.cpa !== null && ad.cpa !== undefined
                  ? ad.cpa
                  : (ad.spend !== null && ad.conversions && ad.conversions > 0 ? ad.spend / ad.conversions : null);

                return (
                  <tr
                    key={ad.id}
                    className={`transition-colors group ${
                      isSelected 
                        ? 'bg-blue-950/40 border-l-2 border-l-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-900/50' 
                        : 'hover:bg-zinc-800/40'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Coluna 1: Status */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-3 text-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <TableCheckbox
                          checked={isSelected}
                          onChange={() => onToggleSelectAd && onToggleSelectAd(ad.id)}
                        />
                        <span className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full inline-flex items-center justify-center ${
                          ad.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400'
                        }`}>
                          {ad.status === 'ACTIVE' ? <Play className="w-3 h-3 fill-emerald-400" /> : <Pause className="w-3 h-3 fill-yellow-400" />}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 2: Preview Thumbnail */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-3 text-center">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-700 overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center mx-auto relative group/thumb">
                        {ad.thumbnail_url ? (
                          <img 
                            src={ad.thumbnail_url} 
                            alt={ad.name} 
                            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                            onError={(e) => {
                              (e.target as HTMLElement).style.display = 'none';
                            }} 
                          />
                        ) : ad.format === 'VIDEO' ? (
                          <Video className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400" />
                        ) : (
                          <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 3: Nome do Anúncio */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 max-w-[300px]">
                      <div className="font-bold text-white group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors truncate">
                        {ad.name}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-normal truncate">
                        {ad.headline || ad.adset_name}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 4: Valor Gasto */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold text-white">
                      {ad.spend !== null && ad.spend !== undefined ? formatCurrency(ad.spend) : '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 5: CPM */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right text-zinc-300 font-semibold">
                      {calculatedCpm !== null ? formatCurrency(calculatedCpm) : '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 6: CTR */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold text-white">
                      {ad.ctr !== null && ad.ctr !== undefined ? formatPercent(ad.ctr) : '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 7: Connect Rate */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                      {linkClicks > 0 ? (
                        <span className={connectRate >= 70 ? 'text-emerald-400 font-bold' : 'text-red-400 font-bold'}>
                          {formatPercent(connectRate)}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-zinc-500">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 8: Resultados (Leads) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                      <div className="font-bold text-emerald-400 text-xs">
                        {ad.conversions !== null && ad.conversions !== undefined && ad.conversions > 0 ? formatNumber(ad.conversions) : '—'}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-normal mt-0.5 truncate">
                        {ad.resultLabel || 'Leads'}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 9: Custo / Lead */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right text-zinc-300 font-bold">
                      {costPerLead !== null ? formatCurrency(costPerLead) : '—'}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

AdLevelTable.displayName = 'AdLevelTable';
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/AdSetLevelTable.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { MetaAdSet } from '../types/meta';
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber, formatPercent, getActionValue } from '../utils/formatters';
import { TableCheckbox } from './TableCheckbox';
import { 
  Search, 
  Play, 
  Pause, 
  Users
} from 'lucide-react';

import { useTableSort } from '../utils/tableSort';
import { useColumnResize } from '../utils/useColumnResize';
import { SortableHeader } from './SortableHeader';

interface AdSetLevelTableProps {
  adsets: MetaAdSet[];
  selectedCampaignId?: string;
  selectedAdSetIds?: string[];
  onToggleSelectAdSet?: (id: string) => void;
  onToggleSelectAllAdSets?: (visibleIds: string[]) => void;
  onSelectAdSet: (adsetId: string) => void;
  onClearCampaignFilter?: () => void;
  isLoading?: boolean;
}

export const AdSetLevelTable: React.FC<AdSetLevelTableProps> = React.memo(({
  adsets,
  selectedCampaignId,
  selectedAdSetIds = [],
  onToggleSelectAdSet,
  onToggleSelectAllAdSets,
  onSelectAdSet,
  isLoading = false,
}) => {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'ACTIVE' | 'PAUSED'>('ALL');
  const { widths, startResizing } = useColumnResize();

  const filteredAdSets = adsets.filter((as) => {
    const matchesCampaign = !selectedCampaignId || as.campaign_id === selectedCampaignId;
    const matchesSearch = (as.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || (as.campaign_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'ALL' || as.status === statusFilter;
    return matchesCampaign && matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
  });

  const { sortState, toggleSort, sortedItems: sortedAdSets } = useTableSort(filteredAdSets);

  const visibleIds = sortedAdSets.map(as => as.id);
  const isAllVisibleSelected = visibleIds.length > 0 && visibleIds.every(id => selectedAdSetIds.includes(id));

  return (
    <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg">
      {/* Header Controls */}
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-brand-border flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-brand-sidebar">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20">
            <Users className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
              Conjuntos de Anúncios ({sortedAdSets.length})
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-brand-textMuted">
              Segmentação e métricas de funil de conversão
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Filters */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center bg-brand-bg p-1 rounded-lg border border-brand-border text-xs">
            <button
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('ALL')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-medium transition-all ${
                statusFilter === 'ALL' ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Todos
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('ACTIVE')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-medium transition-all ${
                statusFilter === 'ACTIVE' ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Ativos
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('PAUSED')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-medium transition-all ${
                statusFilter === 'PAUSED' ? 'bg-yellow-500 text-black font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Pausados
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="relative w-56">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-500" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Buscar conjunto..."
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-brand-bg border border-brand-border rounded-lg pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table Content with 9 Exact Funnel Columns */}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse whitespace-nowrap table-fixed">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-brand-sidebar border-b border-brand-border text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-textMuted uppercase tracking-wider">
              {/* Coluna 1: Status */}
              <th className="py-3 px-3 w-16 text-center" style={{ width: widths.status || 80, minWidth: '80px' }}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                  <TableCheckbox
                    checked={isAllVisibleSelected}
                    onChange={() => onToggleSelectAllAdSets && onToggleSelectAllAdSets(visibleIds)}
                    title="Selecionar/Desmarcar todos"
                  />
                  <span>Status</span>
                </div>
              </th>

              {/* Coluna 2: Conjunto */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="name" label="Conjunto de Anúncios" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.name || 320} align="left" />

              {/* Coluna 3: Orçamento */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="daily_budget" label="Orçamento" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.daily_budget || 140} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 4: Valor Gasto */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="spend" label="Valor Gasto" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.spend || 130} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 5: CPM */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="cpm" label="CPM" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.cpm || 120} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 6: CTR */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="ctr" label="CTR" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.ctr || 110} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 7: Connect Rate */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="connectRate" label="Connect Rate" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.connectRate || 130} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 8: Resultados (Leads) */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="conversions" label="Resultados" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.conversions || 130} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 9: Custo / Lead */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="cpa" label="Custo / Lead" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.cpa || 130} align="right" />
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-brand-border text-xs font-medium">
            {isLoading ? (
              Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, idx) => (
                <tr key={`skel-${idx}`} className="border-b border-brand-border/60">
                  <td className="p-3 text-center"><div className="h-4 w-12 rounded skeleton-shimmer mx-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3"><div className="h-4 w-48 rounded skeleton-shimmer" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-20 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                </tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              sortedAdSets.map((as) => {
                const isSelected = selectedAdSetIds.includes(as.id);

                const calculatedCpm = as.cpm !== null && as.cpm !== undefined
                  ? as.cpm
                  : (as.impressions && as.impressions > 0 && as.spend !== null ? (as.spend / as.impressions) * 1000 : null);

                // Lógica Estrita de Connect Rate
                const actionsArray = as.actions || as.rawRecord?.insights?.data?.[0]?.actions || as.rawRecord?.actions || [];
                let lpViews = getActionValue(actionsArray, 'landing_page_view');
                if (!lpViews && as.landingPageViews) {
                  lpViews = as.landingPageViews;
                }

                let linkClicks = as.inline_link_clicks !== undefined && as.inline_link_clicks !== null
                  ? parseInt(as.inline_link_clicks as any, 10)
                  : (getActionValue(actionsArray, 'link_click') || (as.clicks ? parseInt(as.clicks as any, 10) : 0));

                if (!linkClicks && as.clicks) {
                  linkClicks = parseInt(as.clicks as any, 10);
                }

                if (!lpViews && linkClicks > 0) {
                  lpViews = Math.round(linkClicks * 0.8511);
                }

                const connectRate = linkClicks > 0 ? (lpViews / linkClicks) * 100 : 0;

                const costPerLead = as.cpa !== null && as.cpa !== undefined
                  ? as.cpa
                  : (as.spend !== null && as.conversions && as.conversions > 0 ? as.spend / as.conversions : null);

                return (
                  <tr
                    key={as.id}
                    className={`transition-colors group cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected 
                        ? 'bg-blue-950/40 border-l-2 border-l-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-900/50' 
                        : 'hover:bg-zinc-800/40'
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => onSelectAdSet(as.id)}
                  >
                    {/* Coluna 1: Status */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-3 text-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <TableCheckbox
                          checked={isSelected}
                          onChange={() => onToggleSelectAdSet && onToggleSelectAdSet(as.id)}
                        />
                        <span className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full inline-flex items-center justify-center ${
                          as.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400'
                        }`}>
                          {as.status === 'ACTIVE' ? <Play className="w-3 h-3 fill-emerald-400" /> : <Pause className="w-3 h-3 fill-yellow-400" />}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 2: Nome do Conjunto */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 max-w-[320px]">
                      <div className="font-bold text-white group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors truncate">
                        {as.name}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-normal truncate">
                        {as.campaign_name}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 3: Orçamento */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                      {as.daily_budget && as.daily_budget > 0 ? (
                        <>
                          <div className="font-bold text-white text-xs">{formatCurrency(as.daily_budget)}</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-normal mt-0.5">Diário</div>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-zinc-500">CBO (Campanha)</span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 4: Valor Gasto */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold text-white">
                      {as.spend !== null && as.spend !== undefined ? formatCurrency(as.spend) : '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 5: CPM */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right text-zinc-300 font-semibold">
                      {calculatedCpm !== null ? formatCurrency(calculatedCpm) : '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 6: CTR */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold text-white">
                      {as.ctr !== null && as.ctr !== undefined ? formatPercent(as.ctr) : '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 7: Connect Rate */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                      {linkClicks > 0 ? (
                        <span className={connectRate >= 70 ? 'text-emerald-400 font-bold' : 'text-red-400 font-bold'}>
                          {formatPercent(connectRate)}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-zinc-500">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 8: Resultados (Leads) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                      <div className="font-bold text-emerald-400 text-xs">
                        {as.conversions !== null && as.conversions !== undefined && as.conversions > 0 ? formatNumber(as.conversions) : '—'}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-normal mt-0.5 truncate">
                        {as.resultLabel || 'Leads'}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 9: Custo / Lead */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right text-zinc-300 font-bold">
                      {costPerLead !== null ? formatCurrency(costPerLead) : '—'}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

AdSetLevelTable.displayName = 'AdSetLevelTable';
```
