```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { X, UserPlus, DollarSign, Calendar, Megaphone, Target, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { createManualCrmLead } from '../services/crmLeadsService';

interface AddLeadModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onLeadCreated: () => void;
}

export const AddLeadModal: React.FC<AddLeadModalProps> = React.memo(({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onLeadCreated
}) => {
  const getTodayDate = () => {
    const now = new Date();
    const year = now.getFullYear();
    const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
  };

  const [dataLead, setDataLead] = useState<string>(getTodayDate());
  const [campaignId, setCampaignId] = useState<string>('');
  const [adId, setAdId] = useState<string>('');
  const [agendamento, setAgendamento] = useState<'Sim' | 'Não'>('Não');
  const [venda, setVenda] = useState<'Sim' | 'Não'>('Não');
  const [valorConversao, setValorConversao] = useState<string>('');

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Reset form when modal opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setDataLead(getTodayDate());
      setCampaignId('');
      setAdId('');
      setAgendamento('Não');
      setVenda('Não');
      setValorConversao('');
      setErrorMessage(null);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Handle ESC key to close modal
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const handleSubmit = useCallback(async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!dataLead) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, informe a data do lead.');
      return;
    }

    let parsedValor = 0;
    if (venda === 'Sim' && valorConversao) {
      const cleanValor = valorConversao
        .replace(/[^0-9,.-]/g, '')
        .replace(/\./g, '')
        .replace(',', '.');
      parsedValor = parseFloat(cleanValor) || 0;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    // Anexa horário padrão T12:00:00.000Z para garantir compatibilidade com colunas TIMESTAMPTZ
    const isoDateTime = dataLead.includes('T')
      ? new Date(dataLead).toISOString()
      : new Date(`${dataLead}T12:00:00.000Z`).toISOString();

    const res = await createManualCrmLead({
      data_hora: isoDateTime,
      nome: 'Lead Anônimo',
      telefone: '',
      campaign_id: campaignId.trim(),
      ad_id: adId.trim(),
      agendamento,
      venda,
      valor_conversao: parsedValor
    });

    setIsSubmitting(false);

    if (res.success) {
      onLeadCreated();
      onClose();
    } else {
      setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Erro ao cadastrar lead. Verifique sua conexão.');
    }
  }, [dataLead, campaignId, adId, agendamento, venda, valorConversao, onLeadCreated, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in duration-200"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div 
        className="bg-[#121214] border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-lg overflow-hidden animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 my-8 select-none"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-5 border-b border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-900/60">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/10 border border-brand-neon/20 text-brand-neon">
              <UserPlus className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
                Cadastrar Lead Manual
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                Atribua diretamente a conversão ao ID da Campanha / Anúncio
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-white p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors"
            title="Fechar (Esc)"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Error Feedback */}
        {errorMessage && (
          <div className="m-5 mb-0 p-3 bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-red-400 font-medium">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{errorMessage}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Form Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4 text-xs">
          {/* Data do Lead */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-zinc-300">
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon" />
              <span>Data do Lead <span className="text-red-400">*</span></span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="date"
              required
              value={dataLead}
              onChange={(e) => setDataLead(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700/70 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon transition-colors"
            />
          </div>

          {/* IDs da Campanha e Anúncio (2 Colunas) */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-zinc-300">
                <Megaphone className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
                <span>ID da Campanha Meta</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Ex: 1202500230899..."
                value={campaignId}
                onChange={(e) => setCampaignId(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700/70 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-white font-mono text-[11px] placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon transition-colors"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-zinc-300">
                <Target className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
                <span>ID do Anúncio Meta</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Ex: 1202500773350..."
                value={adId}
                onChange={(e) => setAdId(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700/70 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-white font-mono text-[11px] placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon transition-colors"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Status de Agendamento e Venda (2 Colunas com Toggles Elegantes) */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-1">
            {/* Agendamento */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="font-bold text-zinc-300 block">
                Agendamento Realizado?
              </label>
              <div className="flex bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700/70 rounded-xl p-1 gap-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setAgendamento('Não')}
                  className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    agendamento === 'Não'
                      ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-white shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  Não
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setAgendamento('Sim')}
                  className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    agendamento === 'Sim'
                      ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  Sim
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Venda */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="font-bold text-zinc-300 block">
                Venda Concluída?
              </label>
              <div className="flex bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700/70 rounded-xl p-1 gap-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setVenda('Não');
                    setValorConversao('');
                  }}
                  className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    venda === 'Não'
                      ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-white shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  Não
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setVenda('Sim')}
                  className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    venda === 'Sim'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-black shadow-sm font-black'
                      : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  Sim
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Campo Condicional: Valor de Conversão (Exibido apenas quando Venda === 'Sim') */}
          {venda === 'Sim' && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-150">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-emerald-400">
                <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Valor do Contrato / Conversão (R$) <span className="text-red-400">*</span></span>
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 font-bold text-zinc-400">
                  R$
                </span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required={venda === 'Sim'}
                  placeholder="Ex: 5.000,00"
                  value={valorConversao}
                  onChange={(e) => setValorConversao(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-emerald-500/50 rounded-xl pl-10 pr-3.5 py-2.5 text-white font-bold text-sm placeholder-zinc-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-400 transition-colors"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Footer Controls */}
          <div className="pt-4 border-t border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-700/70 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Cancelar
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting || !dataLead}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black font-bold text-xs px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Salvando no CRM...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Salvar Lead</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

AddLeadModal.displayName = 'AddLeadModal';
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/AddSmmClientBulkModal.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  Upload, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Info,
  Sparkles,
  Instagram,
  RefreshCw
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  saveBulkMonitoredClients, 
  cleanInstagramHandle, 
  SmmMonitoredClient 
} from '../services/instagramScraperService';
import { 
  getSocialMediaForClient, 
  getSocialMediaBadgeStyle 
} from '../services/teamData';

interface AddSmmClientBulkModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onClientsSaved: (savedClients: SmmMonitoredClient[]) => void;
}

interface ParsedClientRow {
  clientName: string;
  instagramInput: string;
  cleanHandle: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  isValid: boolean;
  error?: string;
}

export const AddSmmClientBulkModal: React.FC<AddSmmClientBulkModalProps> = React.memo(({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onClientsSaved
}) => {
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Reset state when opening
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setInputText('');
      setErrorMessage(null);
      setSuccessMessage(null);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Handle ESC key
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  // Real-time parsing of the textarea content
  const parsedRows: ParsedClientRow[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!inputText.trim()) return [];

    const lines = inputText.split('\n');
    const results: ParsedClientRow[] = [];

    for (const rawLine of lines) {
      const line = rawLine.trim();
      if (!line) continue; // Ignora linhas vazias

      // Separador por pipe "|"
      const parts = line.split('|').map(p => p.trim());
      const clientName = parts[0] || '';
      const rawHandle = parts[1] || '';
      const rawAvatar = parts[2] || '';

      if (!clientName && !rawHandle) continue;

      const { cleanHandle } = cleanInstagramHandle(rawHandle);

      if (!clientName) {
        results.push({
          clientName: '',
          instagramInput: rawHandle,
          cleanHandle,
          avatarUrl: rawAvatar || undefined,
          isValid: false,
          error: 'Nome do cliente ausente'
        });
        continue;
      }

      if (!cleanHandle && !rawHandle) {
        results.push({
          clientName,
          instagramInput: '',
          cleanHandle: '',
          avatarUrl: rawAvatar || undefined,
          isValid: false,
          error: 'Handle ou link do Instagram ausente'
        });
        continue;
      }

      results.push({
        clientName,
        instagramInput: rawHandle,
        cleanHandle,
        avatarUrl: rawAvatar || (cleanHandle ? `https://unavatar.io/instagram/${cleanHandle}` : undefined),
        isValid: true
      });
    }

    return results;
  }, [inputText]);

  const validRows = useMemo(() => parsedRows.filter(r => r.isValid), [parsedRows]);
  const invalidRows = useMemo(() => parsedRows.filter(r => !r.isValid), [parsedRows]);

  const handleSubmit = useCallback(async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (validRows.length === 0) {
      setErrorMessage('Nenhum cliente válido encontrado. Verifique o formato inserido.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      setErrorMessage(null);

      const toSave = validRows.map(row => ({
        clientName: row.clientName,
        instagramInput: row.cleanHandle || row.instagramInput,
        avatarUrl: row.avatarUrl,
        isActive: true
      }));

      const saved = await saveBulkMonitoredClients(toSave);

      setSuccessMessage(`${saved.length} clientes importados com sucesso!`);
      setIsSubmitting(false);

      setTimeout(() => {
        onClientsSaved(saved);
        onClose();
      }, 500);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erro na importação em massa:', err);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Falha ao importar clientes em massa.');
    }
  }, [validRows, onClientsSaved, onClose]);

  const handleInsertExample = () => {
    setInputText(
      `Dra. Mariella Palmeira | @dramariellapalmeira | https://unavatar.io/instagram/dramariellapalmeira\n` +
      `Dr. Jair Dacás | @drjairdacas\n` +
      `Clínica Doctors | clinicadoctors\n` +
      `Coife Odonto | @coifeodonto`
    );
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn select-text"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div 
        className="bg-brand-sidebar border border-brand-border rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-scaleUp flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-5 border-b border-brand-border bg-brand-card/40 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/10 border border-brand-neon/30 flex items-center justify-center text-brand-neon shadow-inner">
              <Upload className="w-5 h-5" />

            </div>

            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Textarea de Entrada */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 uppercase tracking-wider">

              </label>
              {parsedRows.length > 0 && (
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400">
                  <strong className="text-emerald-400">{validRows.length}</strong> válidos

                    <span className="text-rose-400 ml-1">({invalidRows.length} com erro)</span>
                  )}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <textarea
              rows={8}

              onChange={(e) => setInputText(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={`Alessandra Montera | @alessandramontera | https://...\nBodyincision | @bodyincision\nClínica Doctors (Dr. Fernando) | @clinicadoctors\nCoife Odonto | @coifeodonto`}
              className="w-full h-56 px-4 py-3 bg-zinc-900/90 border border-brand-border rounded-xl text-white font-mono text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon placeholder:text-zinc-600 resize-y"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              autoFocus

          {validRows.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">

              <div className="max-h-36 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/60 divide-y divide-zinc-800/60 text-xs custom-scrollbar">
                {validRows.slice(0, 10).map((row, idx) => {
                  const sm = getSocialMediaForClient(row.clientName);
                  const smStyle = getSocialMediaBadgeStyle(sm);
                  return (
                    <div key={idx} className="p-2.5 px-3 flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-zinc-800/30">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">

                          <Instagram className="w-3 h-3" />

                      </div>

                {validRows.length > 10 && (
                  <div className="p-2 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 italic bg-zinc-900/90">

            </div>
          )}

          {/* Feedback de Erro ou Sucesso */}
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-red-400">

            </div>
          )}

          {successMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-emerald-400">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{successMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Footer Actions */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-brand-border">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-400 hover:text-white bg-zinc-850 hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-700/60 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >

            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"

              className="px-5 py-2 text-xs font-black text-black bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed active:scale-95"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (

                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Importando ({validRows.length})...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[2.5]" />
                  <span>Processar e Salvar ({validRows.length})</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});
```

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  UserPlus,

  Instagram, 
  Image as ImageIcon, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Sparkles,
  ExternalLink,
  Trash2,
  Download
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  saveMonitoredClient, 
  updateMonitoredClient, 
  cleanInstagramHandle, 
  SmmMonitoredClient 
} from '../services/instagramScraperService';
import { getSocialMediaForClient } from '../services/teamData';
import { InstagramAvatar } from './InstagramAvatar';

interface AddSmmClientModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onClientSaved: (savedClient: SmmMonitoredClient) => void;
  clientToEdit?: SmmMonitoredClient | null;
}

export const AddSmmClientModal: React.FC<AddSmmClientModalProps> = React.memo(({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onClientSaved,
  clientToEdit = null
}) => {
  const isEditing = Boolean(clientToEdit);

  const [clientName, setClientName] = useState('');
  const [instagramInput, setInstagramInput] = useState('');
  const [avatarUrl, setAvatarUrl] = useState('');
  const [socialMedia, setSocialMedia] = useState('Sara Silva');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Live parsed handle
  const parsed = cleanInstagramHandle(instagramInput);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      if (clientToEdit) {
        setClientName(clientToEdit.clientName || '');
        setInstagramInput(clientToEdit.instagramUrl || clientToEdit.handle || '');
        setAvatarUrl(clientToEdit.avatarUrl || '');
        setSocialMedia(clientToEdit.socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(clientToEdit.clientName));
      } else {
        setClientName('');
        setInstagramInput('');
        setAvatarUrl('');
        setSocialMedia('Sara Silva');
      }
      setErrorMessage(null);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, clientToEdit]);

  // Handle client name change with auto-detected social media
  const handleClientNameChange = (name: string) => {
    setClientName(name);
    if (!isEditing && name.trim()) {
      const autoSm = getSocialMediaForClient(name);
      setSocialMedia(autoSm);
    }
  };

  // Auto-fill avatar when handle is typed if avatar is empty
  const handleAutoFetchAvatar = () => {
    if (parsed.cleanHandle) {
      setAvatarUrl(`https://unavatar.io/instagram/${parsed.cleanHandle}`);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const handleSubmit = useCallback(async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!clientName.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, informe o nome do cliente ou empresa.');
      return;
    }
    if (!instagramInput.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, informe o link ou @handle do Instagram.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      setErrorMessage(null);

      // If user didn't enter custom avatar, auto-set unavatar link as fallback
      const finalAvatar = avatarUrl.trim() || (parsed.cleanHandle ? `https://unavatar.io/instagram/${parsed.cleanHandle}` : undefined);
      const finalSm = socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(clientName.trim());

      let saved: SmmMonitoredClient;

      if (isEditing && clientToEdit) {
        saved = await updateMonitoredClient({
          id: clientToEdit.id,
          clientName: clientName.trim(),
          instagramInput: instagramInput.trim(),
          avatarUrl: finalAvatar,
          socialMedia: finalSm,
          isActive: clientToEdit.isActive
        });
      } else {
        saved = await saveMonitoredClient({
          clientName: clientName.trim(),
          instagramInput: instagramInput.trim(),
          avatarUrl: finalAvatar,
          socialMedia: finalSm,
          isActive: true
        });
      }

      setIsSubmitting(false);
      onClientSaved(saved);
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erro ao salvar cliente SMM:', err);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Falha ao salvar cliente.');
    }
  }, [clientName, instagramInput, avatarUrl, socialMedia, parsed.cleanHandle, isEditing, clientToEdit, onClientSaved, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div

        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-5 border-b border-brand-border bg-brand-card/40">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/10 border border-brand-neon/30 flex items-center justify-center text-brand-neon shadow-inner">
              {isEditing ? <Pencil className="w-5 h-5" /> : <UserPlus className="w-5 h-5" />}
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
                {isEditing ? 'Editar Cliente SMM' : 'Cadastrar Cliente SMM'}
                <span className="text-[10px] bg-brand-neon/10 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
                  Instagram
                </span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                {isEditing 
                  ? 'Atualize as informações de perfil e foto do Instagram.' 
                  : 'Monitore postagens diárias e entregas no feed automaticamente.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"

            className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4">
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 rounded-xl text-rose-400 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{errorMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Nome do Cliente */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 block">
              Nome do Cliente / Empresa <span className="text-rose-400">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Ex: Dra. Mariella Palmeira ou Clínica Harmonize"
              value={clientName}
              onChange={(e) => handleClientNameChange(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-brand-bg border border-brand-border rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon transition-all"
              required

          </div>

          {/* Link ou @ do Instagram */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 block flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>Link ou @ do Instagram <span className="text-rose-400">*</span></span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-normal">Aceita link completo ou @usuario</span>
            </label>
            <div className="relative">

                required
              />
            </div>

            {/* Live Handle Feedback + Botão Auto-puxar foto */}
            {parsed.cleanHandle && (
              <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border/80 rounded-xl p-2.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs animate-fadeIn">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/AdsMetricsTable.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  MetaAd, 
  MetaAdSet 
} from '../types/meta';
import { 
  formatCurrency, 
  formatNumber, 
  formatPercent 
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { 
  getAdSuggestion, 
  extractAdConversasAndCpl,
  AdSuggestionInfo
} from '../utils/adDiagnostics';
import { ScaleBudgetModal } from './ScaleBudgetModal';
import { 
  Pause, 
  Play, 
  TrendingUp, 
  Sparkles, 
  Flame, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Check, 
  Eye, 
  Copy, 
  CheckCheck, 
  ExternalLink,
  MessageSquare,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  Video,
  X,
  Layers,
  Search,
  ArrowUpDown,
  Filter
} from 'lucide-react';

interface AdsMetricsTableProps {
  ads: MetaAd[];
  adsets?: MetaAdSet[];
  metaCpl?: number | null;
  accountName?: string;
  onToggleAdStatus?: (adId: string) => void;
  isLoading?: boolean;
}

export const AdsMetricsTable: React.FC<AdsMetricsTableProps> = ({
  ads = [],
  adsets = [],
  metaCpl,
  accountName,
  onToggleAdStatus,
  isLoading = false
}) => {
  // Estado para busca e filtro por sugestão
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [suggestionFilter, setSuggestionFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  // Estado para o Modal de Escala de Orçamento
  const [selectedAdForScale, setSelectedAdForScale] = useState<MetaAd | null>(null);
  const [isScaleModalOpen, setIsScaleModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Estado para Lightbox de Prévia do Criativo
  const [previewMediaUrl, setPreviewMediaUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Estado para confirmação de cópia do ID
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // 1. Filtra e Ordena estritamente os 25 anúncios que mais gastaram no período
  const top25Ads = useMemo(() => {
    return [...ads]
      .sort((a, b) => Number(b.spend || 0) - Number(a.spend || 0))
      .slice(0, 25);
  }, [ads]);

  // 2. Aplica filtros secundários de busca e status se desejado
  const filteredAds = useMemo(() => {
    return top25Ads.filter(ad => {
      const matchesSearch = 
        (ad.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        (ad.campaign_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        (ad.adset_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        ad.id.includes(searchTerm);

      if (!matchesSearch) return false;

      if (suggestionFilter !== 'ALL') {
        const diag = getAdSuggestion(ad, metaCpl);
        if (diag.type !== suggestionFilter) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [top25Ads, searchTerm, suggestionFilter, metaCpl]);

  // Contadores rápidos para o topo da tabela
  const counters = useMemo(() => {
    let pausar = 0;
    let replicar = 0;
    let fadiga = 0;
    let totalSpend = 0;
    let totalConversas = 0;

    top25Ads.forEach(ad => {
      totalSpend += Number(ad.spend || 0);
      const { conversas } = extractAdConversasAndCpl(ad);
      totalConversas += conversas;
      const diag = getAdSuggestion(ad, metaCpl);
      if (diag.type === 'PAUSAR') pausar++;
      if (diag.type === 'REPLICAR') replicar++;
      if (diag.type === 'FADIGA') fadiga++;
    });

    return { pausar, replicar, fadiga, totalSpend, totalConversas };
  }, [top25Ads, metaCpl]);

  const handleCopyId = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(id);
    setCopiedId(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 1500);
  };

  const handleOpenScale = (ad: MetaAd) => {
    setSelectedAdForScale(ad);
    setIsScaleModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleConfirmScale = async (adsetId: string, newBudget: number) => {
    console.log(`[ESCALA DE ORÇAMENTO] Conjunto ${adsetId} escalado para R$ ${newBudget.toFixed(2)}/dia`);
    // Futura integração com Graph API POST /{adset_id}
  };

  // Renderizador do Ícone de Sugestão
  const renderSuggestionIcon = (iconName: AdSuggestionInfo['iconName']) => {
    switch (iconName) {
      case 'pause':
        return <Pause className="w-3 h-3 text-red-400" />;
      case 'flame':
        return <Flame className="w-3 h-3 text-orange-400" />;
      case 'sparkles':
        return <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-black" />;
      case 'check':
        return <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-300" />;
      case 'alert':
        return <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-400" />;
      case 'eye':
        return <Eye className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-400" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl space-y-0 select-none">
      
      {/* Banner Superior com Métricas Rápidas do Top 25 */}
      <div className="p-5 bg-zinc-900/80 border-b border-zinc-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <h2 className="text-base font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>Top 25 Anúncios com Maior Gasto</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-brand-neon text-black">
                Microgerenciamento
              </span>
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
            Inspeção tática dos criativos com sugestões automáticas baseadas na meta de CPL{' '}
            {metaCpl ? (
              <strong className="text-brand-neon">({formatCurrency(metaCpl)})</strong>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-zinc-500">(Meta padrão: R$ 25,00)</span>
            )}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Badges de Contadores do Diagnóstico */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {counters.replicar > 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setSuggestionFilter(prev => prev === 'REPLICAR' ? 'ALL' : 'REPLICAR')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 border ${
                suggestionFilter === 'REPLICAR'
                  ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black border-brand-neon shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20 ring-1 ring-brand-neon'
                  : 'bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border-brand-neon/30 hover:bg-brand-neon/25'
              }`}
            >
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{counters.replicar} Replicar</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {counters.pausar > 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setSuggestionFilter(prev => prev === 'PAUSAR' ? 'ALL' : 'PAUSAR')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 border ${
                suggestionFilter === 'PAUSAR'
                  ? 'bg-red-500 text-white border-red-500 shadow-md shadow-red-500/20 ring-1 ring-red-500'
                  : 'bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 border-red-500/30 hover:bg-red-500/25'
              }`}
            >
              <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{counters.pausar} Pausar</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {counters.fadiga > 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setSuggestionFilter(prev => prev === 'FADIGA' ? 'ALL' : 'FADIGA')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 border ${
                suggestionFilter === 'FADIGA'
                  ? 'bg-orange-500 text-white border-orange-500 ring-1 ring-orange-500'
                  : 'bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-400 border-orange-500/30 hover:bg-orange-500/25'
              }`}
            >
              <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{counters.fadiga} Fadiga</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <div className="pl-3 border-l border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-3">
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 block">Total Gasto Top 25</span>
              <strong className="text-white text-xs">{formatCurrency(counters.totalSpend)}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 block">Conversas</span>
              <strong className="text-white text-xs">{formatNumber(counters.totalConversas)}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Controles de Busca e Filtros */}
      <div className="p-3.5 bg-zinc-900/50 border-b border-zinc-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[260px] max-w-md">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Buscar por anúncio, conjunto ou ID..."
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-1.5 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700/80 rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon transition-all"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {suggestionFilter !== 'ALL' && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setSuggestionFilter('ALL')}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
            >
              <span>Limpar Filtro ({suggestionFilter})</span>
              <X className="w-3 h-3" />
            </button>
          )}

          <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
            Exibindo <strong className="text-white">{filteredAds.length}</strong> de <strong className="text-white">{top25Ads.length}</strong> anúncios
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* TABELA DE MÉTRICAS E MICROGERENCIAMENTO DE ANÚNCIOS */}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-zinc-900/90 text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-800 uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] font-semibold">
              {/* Coluna 1: Prévia */}
              <th className="py-3 px-3 w-[72px] text-center">Prévia</th>

              {/* Coluna 2: Anúncio */}
              <th className="py-3 px-4 min-w-[220px]">Anúncio (Conjunto & Campanha)</th>

              {/* Coluna 3: Sugestão do Sistema */}
              <th className="py-3 px-4 min-w-[140px]">Sugestão do Sistema</th>

              {/* Coluna 4: Gasto */}
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right min-w-[100px]">Gasto</th>

              {/* Coluna 5: Conversas */}
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right min-w-[90px]">Conversas</th>

              {/* Coluna 6: CPL */}
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right min-w-[95px]">CPL</th>

              {/* Coluna 7: CTR */}
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right min-w-[80px]">CTR</th>

              {/* Coluna 8: Frequência */}
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right min-w-[85px]">Frequência</th>

              {/* Coluna 9: CPM */}
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right min-w-[85px]">CPM</th>

              {/* Coluna 10: Ações (Botões Reais) */}
              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center min-w-[170px]">Ações</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>

          <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-800/60 font-medium">
            {isLoading ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={10} className="py-12 text-center text-zinc-400">
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-brand-neon border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                    <span>Carregando os 25 anúncios que mais gastaram...</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : filteredAds.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={10} className="py-12 text-center text-zinc-400">
                  Nenhum anúncio encontrado para os filtros selecionados.
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              filteredAds.map((ad, idx) => {
                const { conversas, cpl } = extractAdConversasAndCpl(ad);
                const suggestion = getAdSuggestion(ad, metaCpl);
                const isPaused = ad.status === 'PAUSED';

                return (
                  <tr
                    key={ad.id}
                    className={`transition-colors group hover:bg-zinc-900/60 ${
                      isPaused ? 'opacity-65 bg-zinc-950/40' : ''
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* COLUNA 1: PRÉVIA (MINIATURA) */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                      <div 
                        onClick={() => ad.thumbnail_url && setPreviewMediaUrl(ad.thumbnail_url)}
                        className="relative w-12 h-12 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 cursor-pointer hover:border-brand-neon hover:scale-105 transition-all mx-auto shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center group/thumb"
                        title="Clique para ampliar miniatura"
                      >
                        {ad.thumbnail_url ? (
                          <img
                            src={ad.thumbnail_url}
                            alt={ad.name}
                            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                            loading="lazy"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <div className="text-zinc-600">
                            {ad.format === 'VIDEO' ? <Video className="w-5 h-5" /> : <ImageIcon className="w-5 h-5" />}
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {/* Badge de formato discreto */}
                        <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 bg-black/80 text-[8px] font-black text-white px-1 rounded-tl">
                          {ad.format === 'VIDEO' ? 'VÍD' : 'IMG'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 2: ANÚNCIO (NOME, CAMPANHA E CONJUNTO) */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-zinc-500">#{idx + 1}</span>
                          <span 
                            className="font-bold text-white text-xs truncate max-w-[260px] group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors block"
                            title={ad.name}
                          >
                            {ad.name}
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        {/* Campanha e Conjunto */}
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 truncate max-w-[280px]">
                          <span className="text-zinc-300 font-medium">{ad.adset_name || 'Conjunto'}</span>
                          <span className="mx-1 text-zinc-600">·</span>
                          <span className="text-zinc-500">{ad.campaign_name || 'Campanha'}</span>
                        </div>

                        {/* ID com Botão de Cópia Rápida */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-zinc-500">
                          <span className="font-mono">ID: {ad.id}</span>
                          <button
                            onClick={(e) => handleCopyId(ad.id, e)}
                            className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                            title="Copiar ID do Anúncio"
                          >
                            {copiedId === ad.id ? (
                              <CheckCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-brand-neon" />
                            ) : (
                              <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 3: SUGESTÃO DO SISTEMA (BADGE COLORIDA COM LÓGICA ESTRITA) */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <span
                          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border transition-all ${suggestion.badgeBg} ${suggestion.badgeText} ${suggestion.badgeBorder}`}
                          title={suggestion.reason}
                        >
                          {renderSuggestionIcon(suggestion.iconName)}
                          <span>{suggestion.label}</span>
                        </span>

                        <span className="block text-[10px] text-zinc-400 leading-tight max-w-[200px]">
                          {suggestion.reason}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 4: GASTO */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                      <span className="font-extrabold text-white text-xs">
                        {formatCurrency(ad.spend)}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 5: CONVERSAS */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 font-bold text-zinc-200">
                        <MessageSquare className="w-3 h-3 text-brand-neon" />
                        <span>{formatNumber(conversas)}</span>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 6: CPL (CUSTO POR CONVERSA) */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                      {cpl !== null && cpl > 0 ? (
                        <span className={`font-black text-xs ${
                          metaCpl && cpl > metaCpl ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-emerald-400'
                        }`}>
                          {formatCurrency(cpl)}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-zinc-600 text-xs">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 7: CTR */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                      <span className={`font-bold text-xs ${
                        (ad.ctr ?? 0) >= 1.5 ? 'text-emerald-400' : (ad.ctr ?? 0) < 0.8 ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-zinc-300'
                      }`}>
                        {formatPercent(ad.ctr)}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 8: FREQUÊNCIA */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                      <span className={`font-bold text-xs ${
                        (ad.frequency ?? 1) > 3.0 ? 'text-orange-400' : 'text-zinc-300'
                      }`}>
                        {ad.frequency ? `${Number(ad.frequency).toFixed(2)}x` : '—'}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 9: CPM */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                      <span className="font-medium text-zinc-400 text-xs">
                        {formatCurrency(ad.cpm)}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 10: AÇÕES (BOTÕES REAIS: PAUSAR/ATIVAR E ESCALAR) */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        {/* Botão de Pausar / Ativar */}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onToggleAdStatus && onToggleAdStatus(ad.id)}
                          className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 border ${
                            isPaused
                              ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30'
                              : 'bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-500/30'
                          }`}
                          title={isPaused ? 'Ativar anúncio' : 'Pausar anúncio'}
                        >
                          {isPaused ? (
                            <>
                              <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Ativar</span>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Pausar</span>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </button>

                        {/* Botão de Escalar (Verde Neon #CCFF00) */}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleOpenScale(ad)}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-black bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95"
                          title="Escalar orçamento diário do conjunto deste anúncio"
                        >
                          <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>Escalar</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Footer com Regras de Leitura */}
      <div className="p-3.5 bg-zinc-900/70 border-t border-zinc-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00]" />
            <span>Replicar: CPL 20% abaixo e 3+ conversas</span>
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-red-500" />
            <span>Pausar: Gasto 2× sem conversa ou 3× com CPL +50%</span>
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-orange-500" />
            <span>Fadiga: Freq &gt; 3 e CTR &lt; 0,8%</span>
          </span>
        </div>

        <span className="text-zinc-500 font-mono text-[10px]">
          F.A. Rules Engine v2.0
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* MODAL DE ESCALA DE ORÇAMENTO */}
      {selectedAdForScale && (
        <ScaleBudgetModal
          isOpen={isScaleModalOpen}
          onClose={() => {
            setIsScaleModalOpen(false);
            setSelectedAdForScale(null);
          }}
          ad={selectedAdForScale}
          adset={adsets.find(as => as.id === selectedAdForScale.adset_id)}
          onConfirmScale={handleConfirmScale}
        />
      )}

      {/* LIGHTBOX DE PRÉVIA DA MINIATURA */}
      {previewMediaUrl && (
        <div 
          onClick={() => setPreviewMediaUrl(null)}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in"
        >
          <div 
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} 
            className="relative max-w-2xl max-h-[85vh] bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden p-2 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <button
              onClick={() => setPreviewMediaUrl(null)}
              className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-2 rounded-full bg-black/70 hover:bg-black text-white transition-colors z-10"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
            <img
              src={previewMediaUrl}
              alt="Prévia do Criativo"
              className="w-full h-full max-h-[80vh] object-contain rounded-xl"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/AlertasTrilho.tsx`

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Flame, 
  TrendingDown, 
  TrendingUp, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  ExternalLink,
  Wallet,
  ArrowRight,
  Clock,
  Sparkles
} from 'lucide-react';
import { MetaAccountCarteiraItem } from '../types/meta';
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber } from '../utils/formatters';

interface AlertasTrilhoProps {
  items: MetaAccountCarteiraItem[];
  onSelectAccount?: (id: string) => void;
}

export const AlertasTrilho: React.FC<AlertasTrilhoProps> = ({ items, onSelectAccount }) => {
  // 1. Contas em Risco de Saldo (Apenas pré-pagas com saldo durando < 5 dias)
  const contasEmRisco = React.useMemo(() => {
    return items
      .filter(item => {
        if (!item.is_prepay_account) return false;
        if (item.account_status !== 1) return false; // Apenas contas ativas
        if (item.remaining_days === null) return false;
        return item.remaining_days < 5;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => (a.remaining_days ?? 999) - (b.remaining_days ?? 999));
  }, [items]);

  // 2. Otimizar Primeiro: Top 3 contas com CPL mais acima da Meta de CPL
  const contasOtimizarPrimeiro = React.useMemo(() => {
    return items
      .filter(item => {
        return (
          item.account_status === 1 &&
          item.cpl !== null && 
          item.meta_cpl !== null && 
          item.meta_cpl > 0 && 
          item.cpl > item.meta_cpl
        );
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        // Ordena pelo maior valor excedente total pago (ou maior diferença unitária de CPL)
        const excessoA = a.excesso_pago ?? ((a.cpl! - a.meta_cpl!) * (a.conversas || 1));
        const excessoB = b.excesso_pago ?? ((b.cpl! - b.meta_cpl!) * (b.conversas || 1));
        return excessoB - excessoA;
      })
      .slice(0, 3);
  }, [items]);

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
      {/* CARD 1: CONTAS EM RISCO (SALDO) */}
      <div className="bg-zinc-900/80 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-amber-500/5 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none" />
        
        <div>
          {/* Header do Card */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-zinc-800/80 mb-3.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 text-amber-400">
                <Wallet className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span>Contas em Risco</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">(Saldo Pré-pago)</span>
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                  Duração calculada pelo orçamento diário ativo ou ritmo de gasto
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {contasEmRisco.length > 0 ? (
              <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300">
                {contasEmRisco.length} {contasEmRisco.length === 1 ? 'conta' : 'contas'}
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Seguro
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Lista de Contas em Risco */}
          {contasEmRisco.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {contasEmRisco.map(acc => {
                const isCritico = (acc.remaining_days ?? 99) < 1.5;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={acc.id}

                    }`}

                            title={acc.name}
                          >
                            {acc.name}
                          </button>
                          <span className={`text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded ${
                            isCritico ? 'bg-red-500/30 text-red-300' : 'bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-200'
                          }`}>
                            {isCritico ? 'Crítico < 1,5d' : 'Atenção < 5d'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                          <span>
                            Saldo: <strong className="text-zinc-200">{formatCurrency(acc.balance)}</strong>
                          </span>
                          <span>•</span>
                          <span>
                            Ritmo: <strong className="text-zinc-200">{formatCurrency(acc.daily_budget)}/dia</strong>
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <span className={`block text-xs font-black ${
                          isCritico ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-amber-400'
                        }`}>
                          {acc.remaining_days !== null ? `${acc.remaining_days.toFixed(1)} dias` : '—'}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">restantes</span>
                      </div>

                      <a
                        href={`https://adsmanager.facebook.com/ads/manager/billing/transactions?act=${acc.id}`}
                        target="_blank"

                        className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800/80 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                        title="Abrir Cobrança no Meta Ads"
                      >
                        <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ) : (

                Todas as contas pré-pagas possuem saldo suficiente.
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                Nenhuma conta está com cobertura abaixo da régua de 5 dias.
              </p>

          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer info */}

            Régua F.A.: Alerta Médio (&lt; 5d) · Crítico (&lt; 1,5d)
          </span>
          <span className="text-zinc-400">Leitura contínua Meta Ads</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* CARD 2: OTIMIZAR PRIMEIRO (CPL VS META) */}
      <div className="bg-zinc-900/80 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-red-500/5 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div>
          {/* Header do Card */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-zinc-800/80 mb-3.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-400">
                <TrendingDown className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span>Otimizar Primeiro</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">(Top 3 Estouro de CPL)</span>
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                  Contas com custo por conversa mais acima da meta estabelecida
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {contasOtimizarPrimeiro.length > 0 ? (
              <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-red-500/15 border border-red-500/30 text-red-400">
                {contasOtimizarPrimeiro.length} prioritárias
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon" />
                No Alvo
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Lista de Contas para Otimizar Primeiro */}
          {contasOtimizarPrimeiro.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {contasOtimizarPrimeiro.map((acc, idx) => {
                const diffPercent = acc.status_meta_percent ?? 0;
                const excessoUnitario = (acc.cpl ?? 0) - (acc.meta_cpl ?? 0);
                const excessoTotal = acc.excesso_pago ?? (excessoUnitario * (acc.conversas || 1));

                return (
                  <div

                        {idx + 1}
                      </span>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => onSelectAccount && onSelectAccount(acc.id)}
                            className="text-xs font-bold text-white hover:text-brand-neon truncate text-left transition-colors"
                            title={acc.name}
                          >
                            {acc.name}
                          </button>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-500/25 text-red-300">
                            +{diffPercent.toFixed(1)}% acima
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                          <span>
                            CPL Atual: <strong className="text-red-400">{formatCurrency(acc.cpl)}</strong>
                          </span>
                          <span>•</span>
                          <span>
                            Meta: <strong className="text-brand-neon font-semibold">{formatCurrency(acc.meta_cpl)}</strong>
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                      <div className="text-xs font-black text-red-400">
                        +{formatCurrency(excessoUnitario)}/conv.
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                        Excedente: <strong className="text-red-300">{formatCurrency(excessoTotal)}</strong>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="py-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center text-zinc-400 space-y-1.5">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8 text-brand-neon mb-1" />
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-300">
                Todas as contas operando dentro ou abaixo da meta de CPL!
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                Nenhum estouro de custo identificado para as metas configuradas.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer info */}
        <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-zinc-800/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
          <span className="text-zinc-400">
            Foco de ação prioritária: revisar criativos, públicos e saturação
          </span>
          <span className="text-brand-neon font-semibold text-[11px]">
            Meta CPL integrada ao Supabase
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/AppleSelect.tsx`

```typescript
﻿import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, Check } from 'lucide-react';

export interface AppleSelectOption<T = string> {
  value: T;
  label: string;
  badgeColor?: string;
  badgeClass?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  subtitle?: string;
}

export interface AppleSelectProps<T = string> {
  value: T;
  onChange: (value: T) => void;
  options: AppleSelectOption<T>[];
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  label?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  className?: string;
  menuWidth?: string;
  align?: 'left' | 'right';
}

export function AppleSelect<T extends string = string>({
  value,
  onChange,
  options,
  icon,
  label,
  placeholder,
  className = '',
  menuWidth = 'min-w-[190px]',
  align = 'left'
}: AppleSelectProps<T>) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const selectedOption = options.find((opt) => opt.value === value) || options[0];
  const isDefault = value === 'TODOS' || value === 'TODAS' || value === 'ALL';

  // Fechar ao clicar fora
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };

    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleSelect = (val: T) => {
    onChange(val);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className={`relative select-none ${className}`} ref={containerRef}>
      {/* Botão Trigger Estilo Apple Glassmorphism */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`group flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 outline-none active:scale-[0.97] ${
          isOpen
            ? 'bg-zinc-800/95 border-brand-neon/60 text-white shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/10 ring-1 ring-brand-neon/30'
            : !isDefault
            ? 'bg-zinc-850/90 border-brand-neon/40 text-brand-neon shadow-sm hover:border-brand-neon hover:bg-zinc-800'
            : 'bg-zinc-900/80 hover:bg-zinc-850/90 border-zinc-750/80 hover:border-zinc-600 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white shadow-xs'
        }`}
      >
        {/* Ícone ou Badge */}
        {icon && (
          <span className="shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:scale-110">
            {icon}
          </span>
        )}

        {/* Label descritivo opcional */}
        {label && (
          <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 font-medium">
            {label}:
          </span>
        )}

        {/* Texto Selecionado */}
        <span className="truncate tracking-tight font-medium">
          {selectedOption ? selectedOption.label : placeholder || 'Selecionar'}
        </span>

        {/* Indicador de filtro ativo (ponto sutil) */}
        {!isDefault && (
          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-brand-neon animate-pulse shrink-0" />
        )}

        {/* Seta Chevron com animação de rotação */}
        <ChevronDown
          className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 ${
            isOpen ? 'rotate-180 text-brand-neon' : 'group-hover:text-zinc-200'
          }`}
        />
      </button>

      {/* Menu Popover Flutuante Estilo macOS / Apple Glass */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div
          className={`absolute ${
            align === 'right' ? 'right-0' : 'left-0'
          } top-full mt-2 ${menuWidth} p-1.5 bg-[#18181b]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-zinc-700/80 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl shadow-black/80 z-50 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 overflow-hidden ring-1 ring-white/10`}
        >
          <div className="space-y-0.5 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
            {options.map((option) => {
              const isSelected = option.value === value;
              return (
                <div
                  key={String(option.value)}
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(option.value)}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon font-bold shadow-xs'
                      : 'text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-800/80 hover:text-white font-medium'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 truncate">
                    {/* Dot ou Badge Colorido opcional */}
                    {option.badgeColor ? (
                      <span
                        className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full shrink-0 shadow-xs"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: option.badgeColor }}
                      />
                    ) : option.badgeClass ? (
                      <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full shrink-0 ${option.badgeClass}`} />
                    ) : null}

                    {/* Ícone opcional no item */}
                    {option.icon && (
                      <span className="shrink-0">{option.icon}</span>
                    )}

                    <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
                      <span className="truncate">{option.label}</span>
                      {option.subtitle && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-normal truncate">
                          {option.subtitle}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Ícone Checkmark para item selecionado estilo Apple */}
                  {isSelected && (
                    <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[3] text-brand-neon shrink-0 animate-in fade-in duration-150" />
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/BaseTooltip.tsx`

```typescript
import React from 'react';

interface BaseTooltipProps {
  title?: string;
  titleIcon?: React.ReactNode;
  content: string | React.ReactNode;
  visible: boolean;
  position?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right';
  maxWidthClass?: string;
}

export const BaseTooltip: React.FC<BaseTooltipProps> = React.memo(({
  title,
  titleIcon,
  content,
  visible,
  position = 'top',
  maxWidthClass = 'max-w-[320px]'
}) => {
  if (!visible) return null;

  const positionClasses = {
    top: 'bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2.5',
    bottom: 'top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-2.5',
    left: 'right-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 mr-2.5',
    right: 'left-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 ml-2.5'
  }[position];

  return (
    <div 
      className={`absolute ${positionClasses} ${maxWidthClass} min-w-[240px] bg-zinc-900/95 text-white border border-zinc-700/80 rounded-xl shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md px-4 py-3 z-50 pointer-events-none text-left box-border whitespace-normal break-words overflow-hidden leading-relaxed`}
      style={{ boxSizing: 'border-box' }}
    >
      {title && (
        <div className="font-bold text-xs text-red-400 mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-zinc-800 pb-1.5">
          {titleIcon}
          <span>{title}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="text-xs text-zinc-200 leading-normal tracking-wide space-y-1">
        {content}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

BaseTooltip.displayName = 'BaseTooltip';
```
