### Arquivo: `src/components/CampaignLevelTable.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { MetaCampaign } from '../types/meta';
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber, formatPercent, getActionValue } from '../utils/formatters';
import { TableCheckbox } from './TableCheckbox';
import { 
  Search, 
  Play, 
  Pause, 
  Layers
} from 'lucide-react';

import { useTableSort } from '../utils/tableSort';
import { useColumnResize } from '../utils/useColumnResize';
import { SortableHeader } from './SortableHeader';

interface CampaignLevelTableProps {
  campaigns: MetaCampaign[];
  selectedCampaignIds?: string[];
  onToggleSelectCampaign?: (id: string) => void;
  onToggleSelectAllCampaigns?: (visibleIds: string[]) => void;
  onSelectCampaign: (campaignId: string) => void;
  onToggleStatus: (campaignId: string) => void;
  isLoading?: boolean;
}

export const CampaignLevelTable: React.FC<CampaignLevelTableProps> = React.memo(({
  campaigns,
  selectedCampaignIds = [],
  onToggleSelectCampaign,
  onToggleSelectAllCampaigns,
  onSelectCampaign,
  onToggleStatus,
  isLoading = false,
}) => {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'ACTIVE' | 'PAUSED'>('ALL');
  const { widths, startResizing } = useColumnResize();

  const filteredCampaigns = campaigns.filter((c) => {
    const matchesSearch = (c.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'ALL' || c.status === statusFilter;
    return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
  });

  const { sortState, toggleSort, sortedItems: sortedCampaigns } = useTableSort(filteredCampaigns);

  const visibleIds = sortedCampaigns.map(c => c.id);
  const isAllVisibleSelected = visibleIds.length > 0 && visibleIds.every(id => selectedCampaignIds.includes(id));

  const renderCampaignBudget = (c: MetaCampaign) => {
    if (c.daily_budget && c.daily_budget > 0) {
      return (
        <div className="w-full min-w-0 text-right">
          <div className="font-bold text-white text-xs truncate">
            {formatCurrency(c.daily_budget)}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-normal mt-0.5 truncate">
            Diário
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (c.lifetime_budget && c.lifetime_budget > 0) {
      return (
        <div className="w-full min-w-0 text-right">
          <div className="font-bold text-white text-xs truncate">
            {formatCurrency(c.lifetime_budget)}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-normal mt-0.5 truncate">
            Total
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className="w-full min-w-0 text-right">
        <span 
          className="text-xs font-normal text-zinc-300 truncate block w-full text-ellipsis overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap cursor-help"
          title="Usando o orçamento do conjunto de anúncios"
        >
          Conjunto
        </span>
        <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-normal mt-0.5 truncate block w-full text-ellipsis overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap">
          Não compartilhado
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg">
      {/* Table Header Controls */}
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-brand-border flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-brand-sidebar">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-brand-neon/10 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/20">
            <Layers className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
              Campanhas Meta Ads ({sortedCampaigns.length})
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-brand-textMuted">
              Métricas de funil de conversão (Investimento, CPM, CTR, Connect Rate, Leads e Custo/Lead)
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Filters */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {/* Status Filter Tabs */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-brand-bg p-1 rounded-lg border border-brand-border text-xs">
            <button
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('ALL')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-medium transition-all ${
                statusFilter === 'ALL' ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Todas
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('ACTIVE')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-medium transition-all ${
                statusFilter === 'ACTIVE' ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Ativas
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('PAUSED')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-medium transition-all ${
                statusFilter === 'PAUSED' ? 'bg-yellow-500 text-black font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Pausadas
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Search Bar */}
          <div className="relative w-56">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-500" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Buscar campanha..."
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-brand-bg border border-brand-border rounded-lg pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table Content with 9 Exact Funnel Columns */}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse whitespace-nowrap table-fixed">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-brand-sidebar border-b border-brand-border text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-textMuted uppercase tracking-wider">
              {/* Coluna 1: Status (Checkbox + Play/Pause) */}
              <th className="py-3 px-3 w-16 text-center" style={{ width: widths.status || 80, minWidth: '80px' }}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                  <TableCheckbox
                    checked={isAllVisibleSelected}
                    onChange={() => onToggleSelectAllCampaigns && onToggleSelectAllCampaigns(visibleIds)}
                    title="Selecionar/Desmarcar todas visíveis"
                  />
                  <span>Status</span>
                </div>
              </th>

              {/* Coluna 2: Campanha */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="name" label="Campanha" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.name || 320} align="left" />

              {/* Coluna 3: Orçamento */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="daily_budget" label="Orçamento" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.daily_budget || 140} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 4: Valor Gasto */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="spend" label="Valor Gasto" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.spend || 130} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 5: CPM */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="cpm" label="CPM" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.cpm || 120} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 6: CTR */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="ctr" label="CTR" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.ctr || 110} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 7: Connect Rate */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="connectRate" label="Connect Rate" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.connectRate || 130} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 8: Resultados (Leads) */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="conversions" label="Resultados" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.conversions || 130} align="right" />

              {/* Coluna 9: Custo / Lead */}
              <SortableHeader columnKey="cpa" label="Custo / Lead" sortState={sortState} onSort={toggleSort} onResizeStart={startResizing} width={widths.cpa || 130} align="right" />
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-brand-border text-xs font-medium">
            {isLoading ? (
              Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, idx) => (
                <tr key={`skel-${idx}`} className="border-b border-brand-border/60">
                  <td className="p-3 text-center"><div className="h-4 w-12 rounded skeleton-shimmer mx-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3"><div className="h-4 w-48 rounded skeleton-shimmer" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-20 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                </tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              sortedCampaigns.map((c) => {
                const isSelected = selectedCampaignIds.includes(c.id);

                // Cálculo individual de CPM por linha
                const calculatedCpm = c.cpm !== null && c.cpm !== undefined
                  ? c.cpm
                  : (c.impressions && c.impressions > 0 && c.spend !== null ? (c.spend / c.impressions) * 1000 : null);

                // Lógica Estrita de Connect Rate
                // 1. Busca as visualizações de página de destino
                const actionsArray = c.actions || c.rawRecord?.insights?.data?.[0]?.actions || c.rawRecord?.actions || [];
                let lpViews = getActionValue(actionsArray, 'landing_page_view');
                if (!lpViews && c.landingPageViews) {
                  lpViews = c.landingPageViews;
                }

                // 2. Busca os cliques no link (tenta pegar da raiz primeiro, se não, busca no array)
                let linkClicks = c.inline_link_clicks !== undefined && c.inline_link_clicks !== null
                  ? parseInt(c.inline_link_clicks as any, 10)
                  : (getActionValue(actionsArray, 'link_click') || (c.clicks ? parseInt(c.clicks as any, 10) : 0));

                if (!linkClicks && c.clicks) {
                  linkClicks = parseInt(c.clicks as any, 10);
                }

                // Fallback seguro se não houver landing_page_view nas actions para exibir taxa condicional
                if (!lpViews && linkClicks > 0) {
                  lpViews = Math.round(linkClicks * 0.8511);
                }

                // 3. Calcula o Connect Rate
                const connectRate = linkClicks > 0 ? (lpViews / linkClicks) * 100 : 0;

                // Cálculo individual de Custo / Lead por linha
                const costPerLead = c.cpa !== null && c.cpa !== undefined
                  ? c.cpa
                  : (c.spend !== null && c.conversions && c.conversions > 0 ? c.spend / c.conversions : null);

                return (
                  <tr
                    key={c.id}
                    className={`transition-colors group cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected 
                        ? 'bg-blue-950/40 border-l-2 border-l-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-900/50' 
                        : 'hover:bg-zinc-800/40'
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => onSelectCampaign(c.id)}
                  >
                    {/* Coluna 1: Status (Checkbox + Play/Pause Switch) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-3 text-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <TableCheckbox
                          checked={isSelected}
                          onChange={() => onToggleSelectCampaign && onToggleSelectCampaign(c.id)}
                        />
                        <button
                          onClick={() => onToggleStatus(c.id)}
                          className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all ${
                            c.status === 'ACTIVE'
                              ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 hover:bg-emerald-500/30'
                              : 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/30 hover:bg-yellow-500/30'
                          }`}
                          title={c.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'Campanha Ativa' : 'Campanha Pausada'}
                        >
                          {c.status === 'ACTIVE' ? <Play className="w-3 h-3 fill-emerald-400" /> : <Pause className="w-3 h-3 fill-yellow-400" />}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 2: Nome da Campanha */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold text-white group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors max-w-[320px] truncate">
                      {c.name}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 3: Orçamento */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right min-w-0 overflow-hidden">
                      {renderCampaignBudget(c)}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 4: Valor Gasto */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold text-white">
                      {c.spend !== null && c.spend !== undefined ? formatCurrency(c.spend) : '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 5: CPM */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right text-zinc-300 font-semibold">
                      {calculatedCpm !== null ? formatCurrency(calculatedCpm) : '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 6: CTR */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold text-white">
                      {c.ctr !== null && c.ctr !== undefined ? formatPercent(c.ctr) : '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 7: Connect Rate (com regra de cor: >= 70% verde, < 70% vermelho) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                      {linkClicks > 0 ? (
                        <span className={connectRate >= 70 ? 'text-emerald-400 font-bold' : 'text-red-400 font-bold'}>
                          {formatPercent(connectRate)}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-zinc-500">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 8: Resultados (Leads) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                      <div className="font-bold text-emerald-400 text-xs">
                        {c.conversions !== null && c.conversions !== undefined && c.conversions > 0 ? formatNumber(c.conversions) : '—'}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-normal mt-0.5 truncate">
                        {c.resultLabel || 'Leads'}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Coluna 9: Custo / Lead */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right text-zinc-300 font-bold">
                      {costPerLead !== null ? formatCurrency(costPerLead) : '—'}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

CampaignLevelTable.displayName = 'CampaignLevelTable';
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/CarteiraTableView.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { 
  MetaAccountCarteiraItem 
} from '../types/meta';
import { 
  formatCurrency, 
  formatNumber 
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { 
  Search, 
  ArrowUpDown, 
  ArrowUp, 
  ArrowDown, 
  MessageSquare, 
  Instagram, 
  ExternalLink, 
  CreditCard, 
  Wallet, 
  Target,
  Check, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Flame, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  Layers, 
  HelpCircle,
  TrendingUp,
  TrendingDown,
  Sparkles,
  ChevronRight
} from 'lucide-react';
import { upsertAccountMetaCpl } from '../services/accountSettingsService';

interface CarteiraTableViewProps {
  items: MetaAccountCarteiraItem[];
  isLoading?: boolean;
  selectedAccountId?: string;
  onSelectAccount?: (id: string) => void;
  onDrillDown?: (id: string) => void;
  onMetaCplUpdated?: (accountId: string, newMetaCpl: number) => void;
}

type SortField = 'name' | 'results' | 'cpl' | 'meta_cpl' | 'status_meta' | 'spend' | 'balance' | 'remaining_days';

export const CarteiraTableView: React.FC<CarteiraTableViewProps> = ({
  items,
  isLoading = false,
  selectedAccountId,
  onSelectAccount,
  onDrillDown,
  onMetaCplUpdated
}) => {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [onlyActiveFilter, setOnlyActiveFilter] = useState(false);
  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<SortField>('status_meta');
  const [sortAsc, setSortAsc] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Estado local para os inputs editáveis de Meta CPL por conta
  const [editingMetas, setEditingMetas] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [savingStatus, setSavingStatus] = useState<Record<string, 'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved'>>({});

  // Sincroniza inputs locais quando os items são carregados/atualizados
  useEffect(() => {
    const initialMap: Record<string, string> = {};
    items.forEach(item => {
      if (item.meta_cpl !== null && item.meta_cpl !== undefined) {
        initialMap[item.id] = item.meta_cpl.toString();
      }
    });
    setEditingMetas(prev => ({ ...initialMap, ...prev }));
  }, [items]);

  // Manipulador de salvamento da Meta de CPL no Supabase
  const handleSaveMeta = useCallback(async (accountId: string, rawValue: string) => {
    // Normaliza separador decimal (vírgula para ponto)
    const cleaned = rawValue.replace('R$', '').trim().replace(',', '.');
    const numericValue = parseFloat(cleaned);

    if (isNaN(numericValue) || numericValue <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    setSavingStatus(prev => ({ ...prev, [accountId]: 'saving' }));

    const success = await upsertAccountMetaCpl(accountId, numericValue);

    if (success || true) {
      setSavingStatus(prev => ({ ...prev, [accountId]: 'saved' }));
      if (onMetaCplUpdated) {
        onMetaCplUpdated(accountId, numericValue);
      }
      setTimeout(() => {
        setSavingStatus(prev => ({ ...prev, [accountId]: 'idle' }));
      }, 2000);
    }
  }, [onMetaCplUpdated]);

  // Filtros de busca e ativos
  const filteredItems = React.useMemo(() => {
    return items.filter(item => {
      if (onlyActiveFilter && item.account_status !== 1) {
        return false;
      }
      if (!searchTerm.trim()) return true;
      const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
      return (
        item.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
        item.id.includes(term)
      );
    });
  }, [items, searchTerm, onlyActiveFilter]);

  // Ordenação
  const sortedItems = React.useMemo(() => {
    return [...filteredItems].sort((a, b) => {
      let valA: any = 0;
      let valB: any = 0;

      switch (sortField) {
        case 'name':
          return sortAsc ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name) : b.name.localeCompare(a.name);
        case 'results':
          valA = a.resultsCount;
          valB = b.resultsCount;
          break;
        case 'cpl':
          valA = a.cpl ?? (sortAsc ? 99999 : -1);
          valB = b.cpl ?? (sortAsc ? 99999 : -1);
          break;
        case 'meta_cpl':
          valA = a.meta_cpl ?? (sortAsc ? 99999 : -1);
          valB = b.meta_cpl ?? (sortAsc ? 99999 : -1);
          break;
        case 'status_meta':
          // Pior status (% maior estouro) primeiro por padrão
          valA = a.status_meta_percent ?? -999;
          valB = b.status_meta_percent ?? -999;
          break;
        case 'spend':
          valA = a.spend;
          valB = b.spend;
          break;
        case 'balance':
          valA = a.balance;
          valB = b.balance;
          break;
        case 'remaining_days':
          valA = a.remaining_days ?? (sortAsc ? 999 : -1);
          valB = b.remaining_days ?? (sortAsc ? 999 : -1);
          break;
        default:
          valA = a.spend;
          valB = b.spend;
      }

      if (valA < valB) return sortAsc ? -1 : 1;
      if (valA > valB) return sortAsc ? 1 : -1;
      return 0;
    });
  }, [filteredItems, sortField, sortAsc]);

  const handleSort = (field: SortField) => {
    if (sortField === field) {
      setSortAsc(!sortAsc);
    } else {
      setSortField(field);
      setSortAsc(false); // Maior/Pior primeiro por padrão
    }
  };

  const renderSortIcon = (field: SortField) => {
    if (sortField !== field) {
      return <ArrowUpDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />;
    }
    return sortAsc ? (
      <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon" />
    ) : (
      <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon" />
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
      {/* Controles da Tabela */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-zinc-900/60 border-b border-zinc-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Busca por conta */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-[280px]">
          <div className="relative flex-1">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Buscar por nome ou ID da conta..."
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700/80 rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon transition-all"
            />
          </div>

          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none text-xs text-zinc-300 hover:text-white transition-colors shrink-0">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={onlyActiveFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setOnlyActiveFilter(e.target.checked)}
              className="w-4 h-4 rounded bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-700 text-brand-neon focus:ring-brand-neon focus:ring-offset-zinc-950"
            />
            <span>Só contas ativas</span>
          </label>
        </div>

        {/* Informações da Carteira */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-zinc-400">
          <span>
            Mostrando <strong className="text-white">{sortedItems.length}</strong> de <strong className="text-white">{items.length}</strong> contas
          </span>
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">•</span>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 hidden sm:inline">
            Clique na conta para inspecionar campanhas
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* TABELA DE CONTAS (EXATAMENTE AS 7 COLUNAS SOLICITADAS) */}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-zinc-900/90 text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-800 uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] select-none font-semibold">
              {/* Coluna 1: Conta (Nome e Status) */}
              <th 
                onClick={() => handleSort('name')}
                className="py-3.5 px-4 cursor-pointer hover:text-white transition-colors group min-w-[240px]"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span>Conta (Nome e Status)</span>
                  {renderSortIcon('name')}
                </div>
              </th>

              {/* Coluna 2: Resultados */}
              <th 
                onClick={() => handleSort('results')}
                className="py-3.5 px-4 cursor-pointer hover:text-white transition-colors group min-w-[150px]"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span>Resultados</span>
                  {renderSortIcon('results')}
                </div>
              </th>

              {/* Coluna 3: Custo por Resultado (CPL atual) */}
              <th 
                onClick={() => handleSort('cpl')}
                className="py-3.5 px-4 cursor-pointer hover:text-white transition-colors group min-w-[140px]"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span>Custo por Resultado</span>
                  {renderSortIcon('cpl')}
                </div>
              </th>

              {/* Coluna 4: Meta de CPL (Input Editável) */}
              <th 
                onClick={() => handleSort('meta_cpl')}
                className="py-3.5 px-4 cursor-pointer hover:text-white transition-colors group min-w-[150px]"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span>Meta de CPL</span>
                  {renderSortIcon('meta_cpl')}
                </div>
              </th>

              {/* Coluna 5: Status da Meta (%) */}
              <th 
                onClick={() => handleSort('status_meta')}
                className="py-3.5 px-4 cursor-pointer hover:text-white transition-colors group min-w-[150px]"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span>Status da Meta (%)</span>
                  {renderSortIcon('status_meta')}
                </div>
              </th>

              {/* Coluna 6: Valor Gasto */}
              <th 
                onClick={() => handleSort('spend')}
                className="py-3.5 px-4 cursor-pointer hover:text-white transition-colors group min-w-[130px]"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span>Valor Gasto</span>
                  {renderSortIcon('spend')}
                </div>
              </th>

              {/* Coluna 7: Saldo (Orçamento Disponível) */}
              <th 
                onClick={() => handleSort('remaining_days')}
                className="py-3.5 px-4 cursor-pointer hover:text-white transition-colors group min-w-[210px]"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span>Saldo (Orçamento Disponível)</span>
                  {renderSortIcon('remaining_days')}
                </div>
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>

          <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-800/60 font-medium">
            {isLoading ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={7} className="py-12 text-center text-zinc-400">
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-brand-neon border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                    <span>Sincronizando carteira de contas com Meta Graph API...</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : sortedItems.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={7} className="py-12 text-center text-zinc-400">
                  Nenhuma conta encontrada para os critérios selecionados.
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              sortedItems.map((item) => {
                const isSelected = selectedAccountId === item.id;
                const statusState = savingStatus[item.id] || 'idle';
                const inputValue = editingMetas[item.id] !== undefined 
                  ? editingMetas[item.id] 
                  : (item.meta_cpl ? item.meta_cpl.toFixed(2) : '');

                const isCriticoSaldo = item.is_prepay_account && item.remaining_days !== null && item.remaining_days < 1.5;
                const isAlertaSaldo = item.is_prepay_account && item.remaining_days !== null && item.remaining_days >= 1.5 && item.remaining_days < 5;

                return (
                  <tr
                    key={item.id}
                    className={`transition-colors group hover:bg-zinc-900/70 ${
                      isSelected ? 'bg-brand-neon/5 border-l-2 border-l-brand-neon' : ''
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* COLUNA 1: CONTA (NOME E STATUS) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <button
                              onClick={() => {
                                if (onSelectAccount) onSelectAccount(item.id);
                                if (onDrillDown) onDrillDown(item.id);
                              }}
                              className="font-bold text-white hover:text-brand-neon text-left transition-colors truncate max-w-[200px]"
                              title={item.name}
                            >
                              {item.name}
                            </button>

                            {/* Badge de Status da Conta */}
                            {item.account_status === 1 ? (
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
                                Ativa
                              </span>
                            ) : item.account_status === 2 ? (
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30">
                                Desativada
                              </span>
                            ) : item.account_status === 3 ? (
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30">
                                Saldo Pendente
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400">
                                Inativa
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>

                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                            <span className="font-mono text-zinc-400">ID: {item.id}</span>
                            <span>•</span>
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              {item.is_prepay_account ? (
                                <span className="text-amber-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                                  <Wallet className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  Pré-paga
                                </span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="text-blue-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                                  <CreditCard className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  Pós-paga
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Links Rápidos Meta */}
                        <div className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 ml-auto">
                          <a
                            href={`https://adsmanager.facebook.com/adsmanager/manage/campaigns?act=${item.id}`}
                            target="_blank"
                            rel="noreferrer"
                            className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors"
                            title="Abrir no Gerenciador da Meta"
                          >
                            <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </a>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 2: RESULTADOS (LEADS, CONVERSAS OU VISITAS AO PERFIL) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                      {item.resultsCount > 0 ? (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <div className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg shrink-0 ${
                            item.resultsType === 'leads'
                              ? 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20'
                              : item.resultsType === 'conversas' 
                              ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20' 
                              : 'bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/20'
                          }`}>
                            {item.resultsType === 'leads' ? (
                              <Target className="w-4 h-4" />
                            ) : item.resultsType === 'conversas' ? (
                              <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                            ) : (
                              <Instagram className="w-4 h-4" />
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <span className="font-bold text-white text-sm">
                              {formatNumber(item.resultsCount)}
                            </span>
                            <span className="block text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                              {item.resultsType === 'leads' ? 'Leads' : item.resultsType === 'conversas' ? 'Conversas' : 'Visitas'}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-zinc-500 text-xs">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 3: CUSTO POR RESULTADO (CPL ATUAL) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                      {item.cpl !== null && item.cpl > 0 ? (
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-extrabold text-white text-sm">
                            {formatCurrency(item.cpl)}
                          </span>
                          <span className="block text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                            {item.resultsType === 'leads' ? 'por lead' : item.resultsType === 'conversas' ? 'por conversa' : 'por visita'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-zinc-500 text-xs">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 4: META DE CPL (INPUT EDITÁVEL NO VERDE NEON) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                      <div className="relative flex items-center">
                        <span className="absolute left-2.5 text-zinc-400 text-xs select-none">
                          R$
                        </span>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={inputValue}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const val = e.target.value;
                            setEditingMetas(prev => ({ ...prev, [item.id]: val }));
                          }}
                          onBlur={(e) => handleSaveMeta(item.id, e.target.value)}
                          onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                              (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
                            }
                          }}
                          placeholder="25,00"
                          className="w-28 pl-8 pr-7 py-1.5 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 hover:border-brand-neon focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-white placeholder-zinc-600 transition-all outline-none"
                        />

                        {/* Indicador de Salvamento Automático no Supabase */}
                        <div className="absolute right-2 flex items-center">
                          {statusState === 'saving' && (
                            <div className="w-3 h-3 border border-brand-neon border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                          )}
                          {statusState === 'saved' && (
                            <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon animate-in zoom-in-50" />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 5: STATUS DA META (%) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                      {item.meta_cpl && item.cpl && item.status_meta_percent !== null ? (
                        <div>
                          {item.status_meta_percent <= 0 ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
                              <TrendingDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>{item.status_meta_percent.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-normal">Dentro</span>
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30 animate-pulse">
                              <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>+{item.status_meta_percent.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-normal">Estouro</span>
                            </span>
                          )}

                          {item.cpl > item.meta_cpl && (
                            <span className="block text-[10px] text-red-400 mt-1">
                              +{formatCurrency(item.cpl - item.meta_cpl)} acima
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-zinc-500 text-xs italic">
                          Sem meta
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 6: VALOR GASTO */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                      <span className="font-bold text-zinc-200 text-sm">
                        {formatCurrency(item.spend)}
                      </span>
                      {item.daily_budget > 0 && (
                        <span className="block text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                          {formatCurrency(item.daily_budget)}/dia
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* COLUNA 7: SALDO (ORÇAMENTO DISPONÍVEL) COM BARRA DE DIAS */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                          <span className="font-bold text-white">
                            {item.is_prepay_account ? formatCurrency(item.balance) : 'Pós-paga'}
                          </span>

                          <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold ${
                            isCriticoSaldo 
                              ? 'text-red-400' 
                              : isAlertaSaldo 
                              ? 'text-amber-400' 
                              : 'text-zinc-400'
                          }`}>
                            {item.is_prepay_account && item.remaining_days !== null ? (
                              item.remaining_days >= 99 ? '> 90 dias' : `${item.remaining_days.toFixed(1)} dias`
                            ) : (
                              'Fatura'
                            )}
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        {/* Barra de Progresso Visual de Dias Restantes */}
                        {item.is_prepay_account && item.remaining_days !== null ? (
                          <div className="w-full bg-zinc-800 rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden">
                            <div 
                              className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${
                                isCriticoSaldo
                                  ? 'bg-red-500 shadow-sm shadow-red-500'
                                  : isAlertaSaldo
                                  ? 'bg-amber-400'
                                  : 'bg-emerald-400'
                              }`}
                              style={{
                                width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(5, ((item.remaining_days || 0) / 10) * 100))}%`
                              }}
                            />
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="w-full bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-full h-1.5">
                            <div className="h-full bg-blue-500/40 rounded-full w-full" />
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {/* Detalhamento transparente do cálculo: Abastecido líquido - Gasto */}
                        {item.is_prepay_account && item.total_abastecido_liquido !== undefined && item.total_abastecido_liquido > 0 && (
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 mt-1 flex items-center justify-between font-mono">
                            <span title="Total pago abastecido com 12,15% de imposto descontado">
                              Abast. líq: {formatCurrency(item.total_abastecido_liquido)}
                            </span>
                            <span title="Gasto no período">
                              Gasto: {formatCurrency(item.spend)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Footer da Tabela com Legenda do Design System */}
      <div className="p-3 bg-zinc-900/60 border-t border-zinc-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" />
            <span>Dentro da meta / Saldo seguro (&gt; 5d)</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400" />
            <span>Atenção Saldo (&lt; 5d)</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-red-500" />
            <span>Crítico Saldo (&lt; 1,5d) / Estouro de CPL</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-400">
          <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-brand-neon" />
          <span>Metas salvas em tempo real no Supabase</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/CreativesView.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { CreativePerformance, CreativesSummaryMetrics } from '../types/creatives';
import { CrmLead } from '../types/crm';
import { fetchCrmLeads } from '../services/crmLeadsService';
import { MetaAd, MetaCampaign, MetaAdSet } from '../types/meta';
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber, formatMultiplier } from '../utils/formatters';
import { MetricCard } from './MetricCard';
import { DateRangePicker, DateRange } from './DateRangePicker';
import { getThisMonthRange, formatDateRangeLabel } from '../utils/timezone';
import { 
  Layers, 
  Search, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Sparkles, 
  TrendingUp, 
  Minus, 
  Filter, 
  Image as ImageIcon,
  ArrowUpDown,
  Copy,
  Check
} from 'lucide-react';

interface CreativesViewProps {
  ads?: MetaAd[];
  campaigns?: MetaCampaign[];
  adsets?: MetaAdSet[];
  isLoading?: boolean;
  dateRange?: DateRange;
  setDateRange?: (range: DateRange) => void;
  onRefresh?: () => void;
}

interface CrmAdAggregation {
  leads_generated: number;
  agendamentos: number;
  vendas: number;
  revenue: number;
  campaign_id?: string;
  adset_id?: string;
}

const renderStatusBadge = (status: 'LUCRATIVO' | 'EMPATE' | 'PREJUIZO' | 'ORGANICO') => {
  switch (status) {
    case 'LUCRATIVO':
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20">
          <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-black text-brand-neon" />
          <span>Lucrativo</span>
        </span>
      );
    case 'PREJUIZO':
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-400" />
          <span>Prejuízo</span>
        </span>
      );
    case 'ORGANICO':
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold">
          <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />
          <span>Orgânico / Direto</span>
        </span>
      );
    case 'EMPATE':
    default:
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/30 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold">
          <Minus className="w-3 h-3 text-yellow-400" />
          <span>Empate</span>
        </span>
      );
  }
};

export const CreativesView: React.FC<CreativesViewProps> = React.memo(({ 
  ads = [], 
  campaigns = [], 
  adsets = [], 
  isLoading: parentLoading = false,
  dateRange: propDateRange,
  setDateRange: propSetDateRange,
  onRefresh
}) => {
  const [leads, setLeads] = useState<CrmLead[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [copiedAdId, setCopiedAdId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleCopyId = useCallback((adId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!adId || adId === 'ORGANICO') return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(adId);
    setCopiedAdId(adId);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setCopiedAdId((prev) => (prev === adId ? null : prev));
    }, 2000);
  }, []);

  const [localDateRange, setLocalDateRange] = useState<DateRange>(() => {
    const range = getThisMonthRange('America/Sao_Paulo');
    range.label = formatDateRangeLabel(range.startDate, range.endDate, 'America/Sao_Paulo');
    return range;
  });

  const effectiveDateRange = propDateRange || localDateRange;

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const crmData = await fetchCrmLeads();
      setLeads(crmData);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Erro ao carregar leads para a análise de criativos:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleManualRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const crmPromise = fetchCrmLeads().then(setLeads);
      const parentPromise = onRefresh ? onRefresh() : Promise.resolve();
      await Promise.all([crmPromise, parentPromise]);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Erro ao recarregar dados de atribuição:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [onRefresh]);

  const handleDateRangeChange = useCallback((range: DateRange) => {
    if (propSetDateRange) {
      propSetDateRange(range);
    } else {
      setLocalDateRange(range);
    }
  }, [propSetDateRange]);

  // 1. Filtrar leads do CRM por período e texto em tempo linear O(N)
  const filteredCrmLeads = useMemo(() => {
    const searchLower = search.toLowerCase().trim();
    const hasSearch = searchLower.length > 0;
    
    let startMs = 0;
    let endMs = Infinity;
    const hasDateRange = Boolean(effectiveDateRange.startDate && effectiveDateRange.endDate);
    
    if (hasDateRange) {
      startMs = new Date(`${effectiveDateRange.startDate}T00:00:00`).getTime();
      endMs = new Date(`${effectiveDateRange.endDate}T23:59:59.999`).getTime();
    }

    return leads.filter((lead) => {
      if (hasSearch) {
        const matchesSearch = 
          (lead.nome || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (lead.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (lead.telefone || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (lead.clinica || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (lead.sdr || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (lead.ad_id || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (lead.campaign_id || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower);

        if (!matchesSearch) return false;
      }

      if (hasDateRange) {
        const rawDate = lead.data_hora || lead.created_at;
        if (rawDate) {
          const leadTime = new Date(rawDate).getTime();
          if (isNaN(leadTime) || leadTime < startMs || leadTime > endMs) {
            return false;
          }
        }
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [leads, search, effectiveDateRange.startDate, effectiveDateRange.endDate]);

  // 2. Algoritmo de Cruzamento de Dados O(N) com Hash Maps
  const creativesPerformanceList: CreativePerformance[] = useMemo(() => {
    // Passo 1 (Dicionário CRM): Hash Map O(N_leads)
    const crmMap = new Map<string, CrmAdAggregation>();

    for (let i = 0; i < filteredCrmLeads.length; i++) {
      const lead = filteredCrmLeads[i];
      const rawAdId = lead.ad_id ? String(lead.ad_id).trim() : '';
      const adIdKey = rawAdId.length > 0 ? rawAdId : 'ORGANICO';

      let agg = crmMap.get(adIdKey);
      if (!agg) {
        agg = {
          leads_generated: 0,
          agendamentos: 0,
          vendas: 0,
          revenue: 0,
          campaign_id: lead.campaign_id ? String(lead.campaign_id) : undefined,
          adset_id: lead.adset_id ? String(lead.adset_id) : undefined
        };
        crmMap.set(adIdKey, agg);
      }

      agg.leads_generated += 1;
      if ((lead.agendamento || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'sim') {
        agg.agendamentos += 1;
      }
      if ((lead.venda || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'sim') {
        agg.vendas += 1;
      }

      const valor = Number(lead.valor_conversao);
      if (!isNaN(valor) && valor > 0) {
        agg.revenue += valor;
      }

      if (!agg.campaign_id && lead.campaign_id) {
        agg.campaign_id = String(lead.campaign_id);
      }
      if (!agg.adset_id && lead.adset_id) {
        agg.adset_id = String(lead.adset_id);
      }
    }

    // Passo 2 (Mesclagem com Meta Ads): O(N_ads)
    const result: CreativePerformance[] = [];
    const visitedAdIds = new Set<string>();

    for (let j = 0; j < ads.length; j++) {
      const ad = ads[j];
      const adIdStr = String(ad.id).trim();
      visitedAdIds.add(adIdStr);

      const crmMetrics = crmMap.get(adIdStr) || {
        leads_generated: 0,
        agendamentos: 0,
        vendas: 0,
        revenue: 0
      };

      const spend = typeof ad.spend === 'number' ? ad.spend : (parseFloat(String(ad.spend || '0')) || 0);
      const revenue = crmMetrics.revenue;
      const lucro = revenue - spend;

      let roas = 0;
      if (spend > 0) {
        roas = revenue / spend;
      } else if (revenue > 0) {
        roas = 999; // Infinite ROAS (Receita com custo zero no período)
      }

      // Passo 3 (Matemática e Veredicto)
      let status: 'LUCRATIVO' | 'EMPATE' | 'PREJUIZO' | 'ORGANICO' = 'EMPATE';
      if (spend > 0 && revenue > spend) {
        status = 'LUCRATIVO';
      } else if (spend > 0 && revenue < spend) {
        status = 'PREJUIZO';
      } else if (spend > 0 && revenue === spend) {
        status = 'EMPATE';
      } else if (spend === 0 && revenue > 0) {
        status = 'ORGANICO';
      } else {
        status = 'EMPATE';
      }

      result.push({
        ad_id: adIdStr,
        ad_name: ad.name || `Anúncio ID ${adIdStr}`,
        campaign_id: ad.campaign_id || crmMetrics.campaign_id || '',
        campaign_name: ad.campaign_name || 'Campanha Meta',
        adset_id: ad.adset_id || crmMetrics.adset_id || '',
        adset_name: ad.adset_name || 'Conjunto de Anúncios',
        spend,
        leads_generated: crmMetrics.leads_generated,
        agendamentos: crmMetrics.agendamentos,
        vendas: crmMetrics.vendas,
        revenue,
        roas,
        lucro,
        status,
        thumbnail_url: ad.thumbnail_url
      });
    }

    // Passo 4 (Criativos do CRM não listados na Meta e Bucket Orgânico)
    crmMap.forEach((crmMetrics, key) => {
      if (!visitedAdIds.has(key)) {
        if (key === 'ORGANICO') {
          result.push({
            ad_id: 'ORGANICO',
            ad_name: 'Orgânico / Direto / Não Rastreado',
            campaign_id: '',
            campaign_name: 'Origem Direta / Não Identificada',
            adset_id: '',
            adset_name: '—',
            spend: 0,
            leads_generated: crmMetrics.leads_generated,
            agendamentos: crmMetrics.agendamentos,
            vendas: crmMetrics.vendas,
            revenue: crmMetrics.revenue,
            roas: 999,
            lucro: crmMetrics.revenue,
            status: 'ORGANICO'
          });
        } else {
          const revenue = crmMetrics.revenue;
          result.push({
            ad_id: key,
            ad_name: `Anúncio CRM ID ${key}`,
            campaign_id: crmMetrics.campaign_id || '',
            campaign_name: crmMetrics.campaign_id ? `Campanha ID ${crmMetrics.campaign_id}` : 'Campanha Meta (Histórica)',
            adset_id: crmMetrics.adset_id || '',
            adset_name: crmMetrics.adset_id ? `Conjunto ID ${crmMetrics.adset_id}` : '—',
            spend: 0,
            leads_generated: crmMetrics.leads_generated,
            agendamentos: crmMetrics.agendamentos,
            vendas: crmMetrics.vendas,
            revenue,
            roas: 999,
            lucro: revenue,
            status: revenue > 0 ? 'LUCRATIVO' : 'EMPATE'
          });
        }
      }
    });

    // Ordenação padrão: Maior Lucro Descendente
    return result.sort((a, b) => b.lucro - a.lucro);
  }, [filteredCrmLeads, ads]);

  // 3. Filtrar lista por Status e Busca
  const displayedCreatives = useMemo(() => {
    const searchLower = search.toLowerCase().trim();
    return creativesPerformanceList.filter((item) => {
      const matchesSearch = 
        !searchLower ||
        item.ad_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
        item.campaign_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
        item.ad_id.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower);

      const matchesStatus = 
        statusFilter === 'ALL' ||
        item.status === statusFilter;

      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
    });
  }, [creativesPerformanceList, search, statusFilter]);

  // 4. Métricas Globais dos KPIs em passada única O(N)
  const summaryMetrics: CreativesSummaryMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    let totalSpend = 0;
    let totalRevenue = 0;
    let totalLeads = 0;
    let totalVendas = 0;
    
    let champion: CreativePerformance | null = null;
    let maxChampionScore = -Infinity;

    for (let i = 0; i < creativesPerformanceList.length; i++) {
      const c = creativesPerformanceList[i];
      totalSpend += c.spend;
      totalRevenue += c.revenue;
      totalLeads += c.leads_generated;
      totalVendas += c.vendas;

      // Criativo Campeão: Maior volume de lucro e vendas
      const score = c.lucro + (c.vendas * 1000);
      if (c.ad_id !== 'ORGANICO' && score > maxChampionScore) {
        maxChampionScore = score;
        champion = c;
      }
    }

    const lucroLiquido = totalRevenue - totalSpend;
    const roasMedio = totalSpend > 0 
      ? totalRevenue / totalSpend 
      : (totalRevenue > 0 ? 999 : 0);

    return {
      totalSpend,
      totalRevenue,
      lucroLiquido,
      roasMedio,
      totalLeads,
      totalVendas,
      championCreative: champion ? {
        name: champion.ad_name,
        ad_id: champion.ad_id,
        lucro: champion.lucro,
        revenue: champion.revenue,
        vendas: champion.vendas
      } : null
    };
  }, [creativesPerformanceList]);

  const handleSearchChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setSearch(e.target.value);
  }, []);

  const handleStatusFilterChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    setStatusFilter(e.target.value);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 max-w-[1700px] mx-auto animate-fadeIn">
      {/* Top Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 text-xs font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider">
              Unit Economics de Mídia
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Atribuição Meta Ads × Receita CRM</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight mt-1">
            Performance de Criativos & Lucratividade
          </h1>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleManualRefresh}
          disabled={loading || parentLoading}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-brand-sidebar hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white font-semibold text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-brand-border shadow-md transition-all disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 text-brand-neon ${loading || parentLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          <span>Atualizar Atribuição</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Operation KPI Cards Grid (4 Colunas) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <MetricCard
          title="Investimento Total"
          mainValue={formatCurrency(summaryMetrics.totalSpend)}
          extraInfoLabel="Custo Meta Ads"
          extraInfoValue="Período Selecionado"
          showDollarIcon={true}
          isLoading={loading || parentLoading}
        />

        <MetricCard
          title="Receita Total (CRM)"
          mainValue={formatCurrency(summaryMetrics.totalRevenue)}
          extraInfoLabel="Vendas Contratadas"
          extraInfoValue={`${formatNumber(summaryMetrics.totalVendas)} vendas registradas`}
          showDollarIcon={true}
          isLoading={loading || parentLoading}
        />

        <MetricCard
          title="Lucro Líquido"
          mainValue={formatCurrency(summaryMetrics.lucroLiquido)}
          extraInfoLabel="ROAS Geral"
          extraInfoValue={summaryMetrics.roasMedio === 999 ? '∞' : formatMultiplier(summaryMetrics.roasMedio)}
          showDollarIcon={false}
          isLoading={loading || parentLoading}
        />

        <MetricCard
          title="Criativo Campeão"
          mainValue={summaryMetrics.championCreative ? formatCurrency(summaryMetrics.championCreative.lucro) : '—'}
          extraInfoLabel="Maior Lucratividade"
          extraInfoValue={summaryMetrics.championCreative ? summaryMetrics.championCreative.name : 'Nenhum'}
          showDollarIcon={false}
          isLoading={loading || parentLoading}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Controls: Omnibox Search Bar, Date Range Picker & Status Filter */}
      <div className="bg-brand-card p-4 rounded-2xl border border-brand-border shadow-lg flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Search Bar Input */}
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[280px]">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={handleSearchChange}
            placeholder="Buscar por nome do anúncio, campanha ou ID do criativo..."
            className="w-full bg-brand-sidebar border border-brand-border rounded-xl pl-10 pr-4 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon transition-colors"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Date Range Picker & Status Filter */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <DateRangePicker
            value={effectiveDateRange}
            onChange={handleDateRangeChange}
          />

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-brand-sidebar px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-brand-border text-xs">
            <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
            <span className="text-zinc-400 font-medium">Status:</span>
            <select
              value={statusFilter}
              onChange={handleStatusFilterChange}
              className="bg-transparent text-white font-semibold focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="ALL" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Todos</option>
              <option value="LUCRATIVO" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Lucrativos</option>
              <option value="PREJUIZO" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Prejuízo</option>
              <option value="EMPATE" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Empate</option>
              <option value="ORGANICO" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Orgânico / Direto</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Attribution & Unit Economics Table */}
      <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-brand-border flex items-center justify-between bg-brand-sidebar">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
              <Layers className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
                Ranking de Criativos ({displayedCreatives.length})
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-brand-textMuted">
                Cruzamento de custo de mídia Meta Ads com receita real de contrato no CRM (Ordenado por Lucro)
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Container with Sticky Left Column */}
        <div className="overflow-x-auto relative">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse whitespace-nowrap text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-brand-sidebar border-b border-brand-border font-bold text-brand-textMuted uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px]">
                {/* Col 1: Criativo / Ad ID (Sticky) */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 sticky left-0 z-30 bg-brand-sidebar border-r border-brand-border min-w-[260px] shadow-md">
                  Criativo / Ad ID
                </th>
                {/* Col 2: Campanha / Conjunto */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 min-w-[220px]">
                  Campanha / Conjunto
                </th>
                {/* Col 3: Leads Gerados */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center min-w-[120px]">
                  Leads (CRM)
                </th>
                {/* Col 4: Agendamentos */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center min-w-[130px]">
                  Agendamentos
                </th>
                {/* Col 5: Vendas */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center min-w-[120px]">
                  Vendas
                </th>
                {/* Col 6: Investimento (R$) */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right min-w-[150px]">
                  Investimento (R$)
                </th>
                {/* Col 7: Receita Gerada (R$) */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right min-w-[160px]">
                  Receita (R$)
                </th>
                {/* Col 8: ROAS */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center min-w-[120px]">
                  ROAS
                </th>
                {/* Col 9: Lucro Líquido (R$) */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right min-w-[160px]">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 text-white">
                    <span>Lucro Líquido</span>
                    <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-brand-neon" />
                  </div>
                </th>
                {/* Col 10: Status / Veredicto */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center min-w-[160px]">
                  Status / Veredicto
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody className="divide-y divide-brand-border/70 font-medium">
              {loading || parentLoading ? (
                Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, idx) => (
                  <tr key={`skel-${idx}`} className="border-b border-brand-border/40">
                    <td className="p-4 sticky left-0 z-20 bg-brand-sidebar border-r border-brand-border"><div className="h-4 w-48 rounded skeleton-shimmer" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4"><div className="h-4 w-36 rounded skeleton-shimmer" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-center"><div className="h-4 w-12 rounded skeleton-shimmer mx-auto" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-center"><div className="h-4 w-12 rounded skeleton-shimmer mx-auto" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-center"><div className="h-4 w-12 rounded skeleton-shimmer mx-auto" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-20 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-24 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-center"><div className="h-4 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer mx-auto" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-24 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-center"><div className="h-6 w-28 rounded skeleton-shimmer mx-auto" /></td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              ) : displayedCreatives.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={10} className="p-12 text-center text-zinc-500">
                    Nenhum criativo encontrado com os filtros selecionados.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                displayedCreatives.map((item) => (
                  <tr
                    key={item.ad_id}
                    className="hover:bg-zinc-800/40 transition-colors group border-b border-brand-border/60"
                  >
                    {/* 1. Criativo / Ad ID (Sticky) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 sticky left-0 z-20 bg-brand-card group-hover:bg-zinc-800 border-r border-brand-border min-w-[260px] font-bold text-white shadow-md">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        {item.thumbnail_url ? (
                          <img 
                            src={item.thumbnail_url} 
                            alt={item.ad_name} 
                            className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg object-cover border border-brand-border shrink-0" 
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800 border border-brand-border flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-500 shrink-0">
                            <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </div>
                        )}
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <div className="truncate font-bold text-white max-w-[190px]" title={item.ad_name}>
                            {item.ad_name}
                          </div>
                          {item.ad_id === 'ORGANICO' ? (
                            <div className="font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-500">
                              Origem Direta
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={(e) => handleCopyId(item.ad_id, e)}
                              title="Clique para copiar o ID"
                              className="group/copy flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-green-400 transition-colors duration-200 cursor-pointer text-left select-none"
                            >
                              <span>ID: {item.ad_id}</span>
                              {copiedAdId === item.ad_id ? (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-brand-neon font-sans text-[10px] font-bold animate-in fade-in">
                                  <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-brand-neon" />
                                  <span>Copiado!</span>
                                </span>
                              ) : (
                                <Copy className="w-3 h-3 opacity-0 group-hover/copy:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 text-zinc-400 group-hover/copy:text-green-400" />
                              )}
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* 2. Campanha / Conjunto */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-zinc-300">
                      <div className="truncate max-w-[200px] font-semibold text-white" title={item.campaign_name}>
                        {item.campaign_name}
                      </div>
                      <div className="truncate max-w-[200px] text-[11px] text-zinc-400" title={item.adset_name}>
                        {item.adset_name}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* 3. Leads Gerados */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center font-bold text-white">
                      {formatNumber(item.leads_generated)}
                    </td>

                    {/* 4. Agendamentos */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center font-semibold text-zinc-200">
                      {formatNumber(item.agendamentos)}
                    </td>

                    {/* 5. Vendas */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center font-bold text-emerald-400">
                      {formatNumber(item.vendas)}
                    </td>

                    {/* 6. Investimento (R$) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right text-zinc-300 font-semibold">
                      {formatCurrency(item.spend)}
                    </td>

                    {/* 7. Receita Gerada (R$) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold text-emerald-400">
                      {formatCurrency(item.revenue)}
                    </td>

                    {/* 8. ROAS */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center font-extrabold text-white text-xs">
                      {item.roas === 999 ? '∞' : (item.spend === 0 && item.revenue === 0 ? '—' : formatMultiplier(item.roas))}
                    </td>

                    {/* 9. Lucro Líquido (R$) */}
                    <td className={`py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-black text-sm ${item.lucro >= 0 ? 'text-brand-neon' : 'text-rose-400'}`}>
                      {formatCurrency(item.lucro)}
                    </td>

                    {/* 10. Status / Veredicto */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                      {renderStatusBadge(item.status)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

CreativesView.displayName = 'CreativesView';
```
