```typescript
// 4. Formatação de Data Simples (Apenas DD/MM/YYYY)
const formatCrmDate = (isoStr?: string): string => {
  if (!isoStr) return '—';
  try {
    const datePart = isoStr.split('T')[0];
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(datePart)) {
      const [year, month, day] = datePart.split('-');
      return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
    }
    const d = new Date(isoStr);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return isoStr;
    const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const year = d.getFullYear();
    return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
  } catch {
    return isoStr;
  }
};

const renderCrmStatusBadge = (val?: string) => {
  const isYes = (val || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'sim';
  if (isYes) {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20">
        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-black text-brand-neon" />
        <span>Sim</span>
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-zinc-800/80 text-zinc-400 border border-zinc-700/60 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium">
      <XCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-500" />
      <span>Não</span>
    </span>
  );
};

export const CrmLeadsView: React.FC<CrmLeadsViewProps> = React.memo(({ isLoading: parentLoading = false }) => {
  const [leads, setLeads] = useState<CrmLead[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [isSeeding, setIsSeeding] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [agendamentoFilter, setAgendamentoFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [vendaFilter, setVendaFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [isAddModalOpen, setIsAddModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [dateRange, setDateRange] = useState<DateRange>(() => {
    const range = getThisMonthRange('America/Sao_Paulo');
    range.label = formatDateRangeLabel(range.startDate, range.endDate, 'America/Sao_Paulo');
    return range;
  });

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await fetchCrmLeads();
      setLeads(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Erro ao carregar dados do CRM:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [loadData]);

  // 2. Lógica de Execução do Seed (Replace Total + Bulk Insert)
  const runSeed = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsSeeding(true);
    try {
      // 1. Wipe Automático (Replace): esvazia a tabela para evitar duplicações
      await supabase.from('crm_leads').delete().not('id', 'is', null);
      MOCK_CRM_LEADS.length = 0;

      // 2. Mapeamento Rigoroso de Nomes dinamicamente do array
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      const mappedLeads = historicalSeedData.map((item, index) => ({
        data_hora: `${item.data_hora}T12:00:00.000Z`,
        nome: item.nome || (item as any).Nome || 'Lead Anônimo',
        email: `seed_${Date.now()}_${index}@fa.com`,
        telefone: '',
        clinica: '',
        especialidade: '',
        objetivo_principal: '',
        faturamento: '',
        trafego_pago: '',
        prazo_estimado: '',
        score_pontos: 0,
        tipo_lead: 'D',
        campaign_id: (item.campaign_id || '').trim(),
        adset_id: 'paid',
        ad_id: (item.ad_id || '').trim(),
        sdr: 'Sistema',
        agendamento: item.agendamento || 'Não',
        venda: item.venda || 'Não',
        valor_conversao: item.venda === 'Sim' ? (Number(item.valor_conversao) || 0) : 0,
        updated_at: nowIso
      }));

      // 3. Bulk Insert
      const { error } = await supabase.from('crm_leads').insert(mappedLeads);

      if (error) {
        throw new Error(error.message);
      }

      // 4. Feedback UI & Recarregamento
      alert('Base sincronizada com sucesso!');
      await loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erro ao executar seed histórico:', err);
      // Fallback para sessão local com mapeamento correto de nomes
      const localMockLeads: CrmLead[] = historicalSeedData.map((item, index) => ({
        id: `seed_lead_${Date.now()}_${index}`,
        data_hora: `${item.data_hora}T12:00:00.000Z`,
        nome: item.nome || (item as any).Nome || 'Lead Anônimo',
        email: `seed_${Date.now()}_${index}@fa.com`,
        telefone: '',
        clinica: '',
        especialidade: '',
        objetivo_principal: '',
        faturamento: '',
        trafego_pago: '',
        prazo_estimado: '',
        score_pontos: 0,
        tipo_lead: 'D',
        campaign_id: (item.campaign_id || '').trim(),
        adset_id: 'paid',
        ad_id: (item.ad_id || '').trim(),
        sdr: 'Sistema',
        agendamento: item.agendamento || 'Não',
        venda: item.venda || 'Não',
        valor_conversao: item.venda === 'Sim' ? (Number(item.valor_conversao) || 0) : 0,
        created_at: `${item.data_hora}T12:00:00.000Z`,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }));
      MOCK_CRM_LEADS.length = 0;
      MOCK_CRM_LEADS.unshift(...localMockLeads);
      setLeads([...localMockLeads]);
      alert('Base sincronizada com sucesso!');
    } finally {
      setIsSeeding(false);
    }
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleDeleteAllLeads = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!window.confirm('Tem certeza que deseja apagar todos os leads da base?')) {
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('crm_leads')
        .delete()
        .not('id', 'is', null);

      if (error) {
        console.warn('⚠️ [CRM LEADS] Aviso ao deletar do Supabase:', error.message);
      }
      
      MOCK_CRM_LEADS.length = 0;
      setLeads([]);
      alert('Toda a base de leads foi apagada com sucesso (0 leads).');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erro ao apagar leads:', err);
      alert('Erro ao apagar base: ' + (err?.message || 'Falha inesperada'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleSearchChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setSearch(e.target.value);
  }, []);

  const handleAgendamentoFilterChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    setAgendamentoFilter(e.target.value);
  }, []);

  const handleVendaFilterChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    setVendaFilter(e.target.value);
  }, []);

  const handleDateRangeChange = useCallback((range: DateRange) => {
    setDateRange(range);
  }, []);

  const filteredLeads = useMemo(() => {
    const searchLower = search.toLowerCase().trim();
    const hasSearch = searchLower.length > 0;
    const hasAgendamentoFilter = agendamentoFilter !== 'ALL';
    const hasVendaFilter = vendaFilter !== 'ALL';

    let startMs = 0;
    let endMs = Infinity;
    const hasDateRange = Boolean(dateRange.startDate && dateRange.endDate);

    if (hasDateRange) {
      startMs = new Date(`${dateRange.startDate}T00:00:00`).getTime();
      endMs = new Date(`${dateRange.endDate}T23:59:59.999`).getTime();
    }

    return leads.filter((lead) => {
      if (hasSearch) {
        const matchesSearch = 
          (lead.nome || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (lead.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (lead.telefone || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (lead.clinica || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (lead.sdr || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (lead.campaign_id || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower);

        if (!matchesSearch) return false;
      }

      if (hasAgendamentoFilter && lead.agendamento !== agendamentoFilter) {
        return false;
      }

      if (hasVendaFilter && lead.venda !== vendaFilter) {
        return false;
      }

      if (hasDateRange) {
        const rawDate = lead.data_hora || lead.created_at;
        if (rawDate) {
          const leadTime = new Date(rawDate).getTime();
          if (isNaN(leadTime) || leadTime < startMs || leadTime > endMs) {
            return false;
          }
        }
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [leads, search, agendamentoFilter, vendaFilter, dateRange.startDate, dateRange.endDate]);

  const summary: CrmLeadSummary = useMemo(() => {
    return computeCrmLeadSummary(filteredLeads);
  }, [filteredLeads]);

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 max-w-[1700px] mx-auto animate-fadeIn">
      {/* Top Header & Overview Title */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 text-xs font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider">
              Single Source of Truth
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Atribuição CRM Real-time</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight mt-1">
            Gestão de Leads & Conversões
          </h1>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={handleDeleteAllLeads}
            disabled={loading || parentLoading || isSeeding}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 font-bold text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 shadow-md transition-all disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
            title="Zerar todos os leads cadastrados"
          >
            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400" />
            <span>Apagar Toda a Base</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={runSeed}
            disabled={isSeeding || loading || parentLoading}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-800/90 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-brand-neon font-bold text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-brand-neon/30 shadow-md transition-all disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
            title="Importar carga histórica de leads"
          >
            {isSeeding ? (
              <>
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-brand-neon" />
                <span>Importando Seed...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Database className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-neon" />
                <span>Executar Seed</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setIsAddModalOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black font-bold text-xs px-4 py-2 rounded-xl shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[3]" />
            <span>Cadastrar Lead</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={loadData}
            disabled={loading || parentLoading || isSeeding}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-brand-sidebar hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white font-semibold text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-brand-border shadow-md transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
            title="Atualizar lista de leads"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 text-brand-neon ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>Atualizar</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Summary Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <MetricCard
          title="Total de Leads Ingeridos"
          mainValue={formatNumber(summary.totalLeads)}
          extraInfoLabel="Base Consolidada"
          extraInfoValue="CRM Postgres"
          showDollarIcon={false}
          isLoading={loading || parentLoading}
        />

        <MetricCard
          title="Agendamentos Realizados"
          mainValue={formatNumber(summary.totalAgendamentos)}
          extraInfoLabel="Taxa de Agendamento"
          extraInfoValue={formatPercent(summary.taxaAgendamentoPct)}
          showDollarIcon={false}
          isLoading={loading || parentLoading}
        />

        <MetricCard
          title="Vendas Concluídas"
          mainValue={formatNumber(summary.totalVendas)}
          extraInfoLabel="Conversão Agendados"
          extraInfoValue={formatPercent(summary.taxaConversaoVendasPct)}
          showDollarIcon={false}
          isLoading={loading || parentLoading}
        />

        <MetricCard
          title="Faturamento Total"
          mainValue={formatCurrency(summary.faturamentoTotal)}
          extraInfoLabel="Ticket Médio"
          extraInfoValue={formatCurrency(summary.ticketMedio)}
          showDollarIcon={true}
          isLoading={loading || parentLoading}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Controls & Search Bar */}
      <div className="bg-brand-card p-4 rounded-2xl border border-brand-border shadow-lg flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Real-time Search Input */}
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[280px]">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={handleSearchChange}
            placeholder="Buscar por nome, e-mail, telefone, clínica, SDR ou ID da campanha..."
            className="w-full bg-brand-sidebar border border-brand-border rounded-xl pl-10 pr-4 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon transition-colors"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Filter Dropdowns & Action Button */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <DateRangePicker
            value={dateRange}
            onChange={handleDateRangeChange}
          />

          {/* Agendamento Filter */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-brand-sidebar px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-brand-border text-xs">
            <span className="text-zinc-400 font-medium">Agendado:</span>
            <select
              value={agendamentoFilter}
              onChange={handleAgendamentoFilterChange}
              className="bg-transparent text-white font-semibold focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="ALL" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Todos</option>
              <option value="Sim" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Sim</option>
              <option value="Não" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Não</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Venda Filter */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-brand-sidebar px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-brand-border text-xs">
            <span className="text-zinc-400 font-medium">Venda:</span>
            <select
              value={vendaFilter}
              onChange={handleVendaFilterChange}
              className="bg-transparent text-white font-semibold focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="ALL" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Todas</option>
              <option value="Sim" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Sim</option>
              <option value="Não" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Não</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Prominent Action Button in Toolbar */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsAddModalOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black font-bold text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all cursor-pointer shrink-0"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[3]" />
            <span>Cadastrar Lead</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modal de Cadastro Manual de Leads */}
      <AddLeadModal
        isOpen={isAddModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAddModalOpen(false)}
        onLeadCreated={loadData}
      />

      {/* Main CRM Data Table - Exactly 7 Required Columns */}
      <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-brand-border flex items-center justify-between bg-brand-sidebar">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
              <Users className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
                Base de Leads ({filteredLeads.length})
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-brand-textMuted">
                Atribuição direta entre leads, identificadores Meta Ads e conversão comercial
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Container with Sticky Left Columns */}
        <div className="overflow-x-auto relative">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse whitespace-nowrap text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-brand-sidebar border-b border-brand-border font-bold text-brand-textMuted uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px]">
                {/* Col 1: Data (Sticky) */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 sticky left-0 z-30 bg-brand-sidebar border-r border-brand-border min-w-[130px] shadow-md">
                  Data
                </th>
                {/* Col 2: Nome do Lead (Sticky) */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 sticky left-[130px] z-30 bg-brand-sidebar border-r border-brand-border min-w-[220px] shadow-md">
                  Nome do Lead
                </th>
                {/* Col 3: Campanha Meta ID */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 min-w-[200px]">
                  Campanha Meta ID
                </th>
                {/* Col 4: Anúncio Meta ID */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 min-w-[200px]">
                  Anúncio Meta ID
                </th>
                {/* Col 5: Agendamento */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center min-w-[130px]">
                  Agendamento
                </th>
                {/* Col 6: Venda */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center min-w-[130px]">
                  Venda
                </th>
                {/* Col 7: Valor Conversão */}
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right min-w-[160px]">
                  Valor Conversão
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody className="divide-y divide-brand-border/70 font-medium">
              {loading || parentLoading ? (
                Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, idx) => (
                  <tr key={`skel-${idx}`} className="border-b border-brand-border/40">
                    <td className="p-4 sticky left-0 z-20 bg-brand-sidebar border-r border-brand-border"><div className="h-4 w-24 rounded skeleton-shimmer" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 sticky left-[130px] z-20 bg-brand-sidebar border-r border-brand-border"><div className="h-4 w-36 rounded skeleton-shimmer" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4"><div className="h-4 w-36 rounded skeleton-shimmer" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4"><div className="h-4 w-36 rounded skeleton-shimmer" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-center"><div className="h-6 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer mx-auto" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-center"><div className="h-6 w-16 rounded skeleton-shimmer mx-auto" /></td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-right"><div className="h-4 w-24 rounded skeleton-shimmer ml-auto" /></td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              ) : filteredLeads.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={7} className="p-12 text-center text-zinc-500">
                    Nenhum lead encontrado com os filtros selecionados.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredLeads.map((lead) => (
                  <tr
                    key={lead.id}
                    className="hover:bg-zinc-800/40 transition-colors group border-b border-brand-border/60"
                  >
                    {/* 1. Data (Sticky) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 sticky left-0 z-20 bg-brand-card group-hover:bg-zinc-800 border-r border-brand-border min-w-[130px] font-mono text-zinc-300 shadow-md">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                        <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 shrink-0" />
                        <span>{formatCrmDate(lead.data_hora)}</span>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* 2. Nome do Lead (Sticky) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 sticky left-[130px] z-20 bg-brand-card group-hover:bg-zinc-800 border-r border-brand-border min-w-[220px] font-bold text-white shadow-md">
                      <div className="truncate max-w-[200px]" title={lead.nome}>
                        {lead.nome}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* 3. Campanha Meta ID */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono text-[11px] text-blue-400">
                      {lead.campaign_id || '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* 4. Anúncio Meta ID */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                      {lead.ad_id || '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* 5. Agendamento */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                      {renderCrmStatusBadge(lead.agendamento)}
                    </td>

                    {/* 6. Venda */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                      {renderCrmStatusBadge(lead.venda)}
                    </td>

                    {/* 7. Valor Conversão */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold text-emerald-400">
                      {lead.valor_conversao ? formatCurrency(lead.valor_conversao) : '—'}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

CrmLeadsView.displayName = 'CrmLeadsView';
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/DateRangePicker.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Calendar, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';

import { 
  getTodayRange, 
  getYesterdayRange, 
  getLast7DaysRange, 
  getThisMonthRange, 
  getLastMonthRange,
  formatDateRangeLabel
} from '../utils/timezone';

export interface DateRange {
  startDate: string; // YYYY-MM-DD
  endDate: string;   // YYYY-MM-DD
  label: string;
}

interface DateRangePickerProps {
  value: DateRange;
  onChange: (range: DateRange) => void;
  timezone?: string;
  align?: 'left' | 'right';
}

const PRESET_TABS = [
  { id: 'hoje', label: 'Hoje', getRange: getTodayRange },
  { id: 'ontem', label: 'Ontem', getRange: getYesterdayRange },
  { id: '7d', label: 'Últimos 7 dias', getRange: getLast7DaysRange },
  { id: 'este_mes', label: 'Este mês', getRange: getThisMonthRange },
  { id: 'mes_anterior', label: 'Mês anterior', getRange: getLastMonthRange },
];

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'janeiro', 'fevereiro', 'março', 'abril', 'maio', 'junho',
  'julho', 'agosto', 'setembro', 'outubro', 'novembro', 'dezembro'
];

const WEEKDAYS = ['dom', 'seg', 'ter', 'qua', 'qui', 'sex', 'sab'];

export const DateRangePicker: React.FC<DateRangePickerProps> = ({ 
  value, 
  onChange, 
  timezone = 'America/Sao_Paulo',
  align = 'left'
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [tempStart, setTempStart] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const todayRange = getTodayRange(timezone);
  const todayParts = (value.startDate || todayRange.startDate).split('-');
  const initialYear = parseInt(todayParts[0]) || new Date().getFullYear();
  const initialMonth = (parseInt(todayParts[1]) || (new Date().getMonth() + 1)) - 1;

  const [startMonth, setStartMonth] = useState<number>(initialMonth);
  const [startYear, setStartYear] = useState<number>(initialYear);

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Sync calendar display month when value changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (value.startDate) {
      const parts = value.startDate.split('-');
      if (parts.length === 3) {
        setStartYear(parseInt(parts[0]));
        setStartMonth(parseInt(parts[1]) - 1);
      }
    }
  }, [value.startDate]);

  // Close when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  // Determina o preset ativo comparando as datas atuais com os intervalos pré-definidos
  const activePreset = useMemo(() => {
    if (!value.startDate || !value.endDate || tempStart) return null;

    for (const preset of PRESET_TABS) {
      const pRange = preset.getRange(timezone);
      if (pRange.startDate === value.startDate && pRange.endDate === value.endDate) {
        return preset.id;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }, [value.startDate, value.endDate, timezone, tempStart]);

  const handlePresetSelect = (presetId: string) => {
    const preset = PRESET_TABS.find(p => p.id === presetId);
    if (!preset) return;

    const range = preset.getRange(timezone);
    range.label = formatDateRangeLabel(range.startDate, range.endDate, timezone);
    setTempStart(null);

    const sParts = range.startDate.split('-');
    setStartYear(parseInt(sParts[0]));
    setStartMonth(parseInt(sParts[1]) - 1);

    onChange(range);
  };

  const handleDateClick = (dayNum: number, mIdx: number, yNum: number) => {
    const formatNum = (n: number) => (n < 10 ? `0${n}` : `${n}`);
    const clickedStr = `${yNum}-${formatNum(mIdx + 1)}-${formatNum(dayNum)}`;

    if (!tempStart) {
      // First click: set temporary start date
      setTempStart(clickedStr);
      onChange({
        startDate: clickedStr,
        endDate: clickedStr,
        label: formatDateRangeLabel(clickedStr, clickedStr, timezone)
      });
    } else {
      // Second click: finalize range between tempStart and clickedStr
      const t1 = new Date(`${tempStart}T00:00:00`).getTime();
      const t2 = new Date(`${clickedStr}T00:00:00`).getTime();

      let finalStart = tempStart;
      let finalEnd = clickedStr;

      if (t2 < t1) {
        finalStart = clickedStr;
        finalEnd = tempStart;
      }

      setTempStart(null);

      onChange({
        startDate: finalStart,
        endDate: finalEnd,
        label: formatDateRangeLabel(finalStart, finalEnd, timezone)
      });
    }
  };

  // Helper to render days grid for a given month/year
  const renderMonthGrid = (monthIdx: number, yearNum: number) => {
    const daysInMonth = new Date(yearNum, monthIdx + 1, 0).getDate();
    const firstDayOfWeek = new Date(yearNum, monthIdx, 1).getDay();

    // Previous month filler days
    const prevMonthDays = new Date(yearNum, monthIdx, 0).getDate();
    const fillerDays = [];
    for (let i = firstDayOfWeek - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      fillerDays.push(prevMonthDays - i);
    }

    const days = [];
    for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
      days.push(d);
    }

    const startMs = value.startDate ? new Date(`${value.startDate}T00:00:00`).getTime() : 0;
    const endMs = value.endDate ? new Date(`${value.endDate}T00:00:00`).getTime() : 0;

    return (
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {/* Month Name Header */}
        <div className="text-center font-bold text-sm text-white capitalize">
          {MONTH_NAMES[monthIdx]} {yearNum}
        </div>

        {/* Weekday Labels */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-7 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400 font-medium mb-1">
          {WEEKDAYS.map((w, idx) => (
            <span key={idx}>{w}</span>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Calendar Days Matrix */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 text-center text-xs">
          {/* Muted Filler Days from Previous Month */}
          {fillerDays.map((fd, idx) => (
            <span key={`f-${idx}`} className="py-1.5 text-zinc-600 font-sans cursor-default">
              {fd}
            </span>
          ))}

          {/* Actual Month Days */}
          {days.map((d) => {
            const formatNum = (n: number) => (n < 10 ? `0${n}` : `${n}`);
            const cellDateStr = `${yearNum}-${formatNum(monthIdx + 1)}-${formatNum(d)}`;
            const cellMs = new Date(`${cellDateStr}T00:00:00`).getTime();

            const isStart = cellDateStr === value.startDate;
            const isEnd = cellDateStr === value.endDate;
            const isInRange = startMs && endMs && cellMs >= Math.min(startMs, endMs) && cellMs <= Math.max(startMs, endMs);

            return (
              <button
                key={d}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleDateClick(d, monthIdx, yearNum)}
                className={`py-1.5 rounded-md font-semibold text-xs transition-all relative ${
                  isStart || isEnd
                    ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black font-extrabold shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/30 z-10'
                    : isInRange
                    ? 'bg-[#536A00] text-brand-neon font-bold'
                    : 'text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {d}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const nextMonthIdx = (startMonth + 1) % 12;
  const nextMonthYear = startMonth === 11 ? startYear + 1 : startYear;

  return (
    <div className={`relative ${isOpen ? 'z-40' : ''}`} ref={containerRef}>
      {/* Date Range Trigger Pill */}
      <button
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all select-none cursor-pointer ${
          isOpen
            ? 'border-2 border-brand-neon text-brand-neon bg-brand-neon/10 shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/20'
            : 'border border-brand-border bg-brand-card text-zinc-200 hover:border-brand-neon/50'
        }`}
      >
        <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon" />
        <span>{value.label}</span>
      </button>

      {/* Popover Calendar (Positioned with left-0 / align and z-[100] to expand rightward and float above sidebar) */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className={`absolute ${align === 'right' ? 'right-0' : 'left-0'} top-full mt-2 bg-[#121214] border border-brand-border rounded-2xl shadow-2xl z-[100] p-5 w-[540px] max-w-[90vw] space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150`}>
          {/* Top Horizontal Preset Tabs */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-6 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400 border-b border-brand-border/60 pb-3 px-1 overflow-x-auto">
            {PRESET_TABS.map((preset) => {
              const isActive = activePreset === preset.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={preset.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handlePresetSelect(preset.id)}
                  className={`transition-all shrink-0 pb-1 relative cursor-pointer ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'text-white font-bold after:content-[""] after:absolute after:left-0 after:right-0 after:-bottom-[13px] after:h-[2.5px] after:bg-brand-neon'
                      : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  {preset.label}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Navigation Controls & Dual Month Grid */}
          <div className="relative">
            {/* Prev Month Arrow */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStartMonth(startMonth === 0 ? 11 : startMonth - 1)}
              className="absolute left-0 top-0.5 p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors z-10"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>

            {/* Next Month Arrow */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStartMonth((startMonth + 1) % 12)}
              className="absolute right-0 top-0.5 p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors z-10"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>

            {/* Dual Month Side-by-Side Display */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-8 px-2 pt-1">
              {renderMonthGrid(startMonth, startYear)}
              {renderMonthGrid(nextMonthIdx, nextMonthYear)}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/DeliveryBadge.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { DeliveryStatusInfo } from '../types/meta';
import { BaseTooltip } from './BaseTooltip';
import { AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Clock, HelpCircle, PauseCircle, XCircle } from 'lucide-react';

interface DeliveryBadgeProps {
  deliveryInfo?: DeliveryStatusInfo;
  statusFallback?: string;
}

export const DeliveryBadge: React.FC<DeliveryBadgeProps> = React.memo(({
  deliveryInfo,
  statusFallback = 'ACTIVE'
}) => {
  const [showTooltip, setShowTooltip] = useState(false);

  const info: DeliveryStatusInfo = deliveryInfo || {
    code: statusFallback === 'ACTIVE' ? 'ACTIVE' : 'PAUSED',
    label: statusFallback === 'ACTIVE' ? 'Ativo' : 'Pausado',
    badgeColor: statusFallback === 'ACTIVE' ? 'green' : 'gray'
  };

  const getStyleClasses = () => {
    switch (info.badgeColor) {
      case 'green':
        return 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30 hover:bg-emerald-500/20';
      case 'blue':
        return 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30 hover:bg-blue-500/20';
      case 'yellow':
        return 'bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/30 hover:bg-yellow-500/20';
      case 'amber':
        return 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30 hover:bg-amber-500/25';
      case 'red':
        return 'bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 border-red-500/40 hover:bg-red-500/25 font-bold animate-pulse';
      case 'gray':
      default:
        return 'bg-zinc-800/60 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-800';
    }
  };

  const getIcon = () => {
    switch (info.code) {
      case 'ACTIVE':
        return <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />;
      case 'SCHEDULED':
      case 'IN_LEARNING':
        return <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-400 shrink-0" />;
      case 'LEARNING_LIMITED':
      case 'PENDING_REVIEW':
        return <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />;
      case 'DISAPPROVED':
      case 'ACCOUNT_ERROR':
      case 'NOT_DELIVERING':
        return <XCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-red-400 shrink-0" />;
      case 'PAUSED':
      case 'COMPLETED':
      default:
        return <PauseCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-500 shrink-0" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block">
      <div
        onMouseEnter={() => setShowTooltip(true)}
        onMouseLeave={() => setShowTooltip(false)}
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold border transition-all cursor-default ${getStyleClasses()}`}
      >
        {getIcon()}
        <span>{info.label}</span>

        {info.reason && (
          <HelpCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-current opacity-70 ml-0.5" />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Meta API Error / Rejection Tooltip with BaseTooltip standard */}
      <BaseTooltip
        visible={showTooltip && Boolean(info.reason)}
        title="Detalhe de Veiculação (Meta API):"
        titleIcon={<AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
        content={info.reason || ''}
      />
    </div>
  );
});

DeliveryBadge.displayName = 'DeliveryBadge';
```
