```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  formatCurrency, 
  formatNumber, 
  formatPercent, 
  getActionValue 
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { 
  MetaCampaign, 
  MetaAdSet, 
  MetaAd, 
  GerenciadorSummary,
  MetaAdAccount,
  MetaConfig,
  MetaAccountCarteiraItem,
  FilterTag
} from '../types/meta';
import { MetricCard } from './MetricCard';
import { CampaignLevelTable } from './CampaignLevelTable';
import { AdSetLevelTable } from './AdSetLevelTable';
import { AdLevelTable } from './AdLevelTable';
import { AlertasTrilho } from './AlertasTrilho';
import { CarteiraTableView } from './CarteiraTableView';
import { AdsMetricsTable } from './AdsMetricsTable';
import { 
  Megaphone, 
  Layers, 
  Target,
  LayoutDashboard,
  ArrowLeft,
  RefreshCw,
  Wallet,
  Sparkles,
  Building2,
  Calendar,
  AlertCircle
} from 'lucide-react';
import { OmniboxSearch } from './OmniboxSearch';
import { fetchCarteiraAccounts } from '../services/carteiraEngine';
import { getSavedMetaConfig } from '../services/metaDataEngine';

interface GerenciadorViewProps {
  summary: GerenciadorSummary;
  campaigns: MetaCampaign[];
  adsets: MetaAdSet[];
  ads: MetaAd[];
  activeLevel: string;
  setActiveLevel: (level: string) => void;
  onToggleCampaignStatus: (id: string) => void;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  accounts?: MetaAdAccount[];
  metaConfig?: MetaConfig;
  dateRange?: any;
  selectedAccountId?: string;
  setSelectedAccountId?: (id: string) => void;
  onRefresh?: () => void;
}

export const GerenciadorView: React.FC<GerenciadorViewProps> = React.memo(({
  summary,
  campaigns,
  adsets,
  ads,
  activeLevel,
  setActiveLevel,
  onToggleCampaignStatus,
  isLoading = false,
  accounts = [],
  metaConfig,
  dateRange,
  selectedAccountId,
  setSelectedAccountId,
  onRefresh,
}) => {
  // Modo de visualização: 'carteira' (Padrão DashTF 2.0) | 'campanhas' (Drill-down detalhado)
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'carteira' | 'campanhas'>('carteira');

  // Estado dos dados da Carteira de Contas (com saúde financeira e metas de CPL)
  const [carteiraItems, setCarteiraItems] = useState<MetaAccountCarteiraItem[]>([]);
  const [isCarteiraLoading, setIsCarteiraLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Estados de seleção interna do drill-down de campanhas
  const [selectedCampaignId, setSelectedCampaignId] = useState<string | undefined>();
  const [selectedAdSetId, setSelectedAdSetId] = useState<string | undefined>();
  const [activeFilters, setActiveFilters] = useState<FilterTag[]>([]);
  const [selectedCampaignIds, setSelectedCampaignIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedAdSetIds, setSelectedAdSetIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedAdIds, setSelectedAdIds] = useState<string[]>([]);

  // Estado local para anúncios e ações de status
  const [localAds, setLocalAds] = useState<MetaAd[]>(ads);
  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalAds(ads);
  }, [ads]);

  const handleToggleAdStatus = useCallback((adId: string) => {
    setLocalAds((prev) =>
      prev.map((ad) =>
        ad.id === adId
          ? {
              ...ad,
              status: ad.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'PAUSED' : 'ACTIVE',
              effective_status: ad.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'PAUSED' : 'ACTIVE',
            }
          : ad
      )
    );
  }, []);

  // Meta CPL da conta ativa selecionada
  const currentAccountMetaCpl = useMemo(() => {
    const found = carteiraItems.find((item) => item.id === selectedAccountId);
    return found?.meta_cpl ?? null;
  }, [carteiraItems, selectedAccountId]);

  // 1. Carregamento dos dados da Carteira de Contas em tempo real
  const loadCarteira = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!accounts || accounts.length === 0) return;
    setIsCarteiraLoading(true);
    try {
      const activeConfig = metaConfig || getSavedMetaConfig();
      const items = await fetchCarteiraAccounts(activeConfig, accounts, dateRange);
      setCarteiraItems(items);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Erro ao sincronizar dados da carteira:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsCarteiraLoading(false);
    }
  }, [accounts, metaConfig, dateRange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCarteira();
  }, [loadCarteira]);

  // Atualização reativa de Meta de CPL salva no Supabase
  const handleMetaCplUpdated = useCallback((accountId: string, newMetaCpl: number) => {
    setCarteiraItems((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) => {
        if (item.id === accountId) {
          const statusPercent =
            item.cpl && newMetaCpl > 0
              ? parseFloat((((item.cpl - newMetaCpl) / newMetaCpl) * 100).toFixed(1))
              : null;
          const excesso =
            item.cpl && item.cpl > newMetaCpl
              ? parseFloat(((item.cpl - newMetaCpl) * (item.conversas || 1)).toFixed(2))
              : 0;

          return {
            ...item,
            meta_cpl: newMetaCpl,
            status_meta_percent: statusPercent,
            excesso_pago: excesso,
          };
        }
        return item;
      })
    );
  }, []);

  // Selecionar conta e abrir drill-down de campanhas
  const handleInspectAccount = useCallback(
    (accId: string) => {
      if (setSelectedAccountId) {
        setSelectedAccountId(accId);
      }
      setActiveLevel('top25');
      setViewMode('campanhas');
    },
    [setSelectedAccountId, setActiveLevel]
  );

  // Nome da conta selecionada
  const selectedAccName = useMemo(() => {
    const found = accounts.find((a) => a.id === selectedAccountId);
    return found ? found.name : metaConfig?.accountName || 'Conta Selecionada';
  }, [accounts, selectedAccountId, metaConfig]);

  // Controles de Filtros do Omnibox
  const handleAddFilter = (tag: FilterTag) => {
    setActiveFilters((prev) => [...prev, tag]);
  };
  const handleRemoveFilter = (id: string) => {
    setActiveFilters((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== id));
  };
  const handleClearAllFilters = () => {
    setActiveFilters([]);
  };

  // Filtragem de Campanhas por Omnibox
  const filteredCampaignsByTags = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeFilters || activeFilters.length === 0) return campaigns;
    return campaigns.filter((item) => {
      return activeFilters.every((tag) => {
        const valLower = (tag.value || '').toLowerCase();
        if (tag.type === 'NAME') return (item.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(valLower);
        if (tag.type === 'ID') return (item.id || '').toLowerCase().includes(valLower);
        if (tag.type === 'STATUS') {
          const statusLabel = (item.deliveryInfo?.label || item.status || '').toLowerCase();
          return statusLabel.includes(valLower);
        }
        if (tag.type === 'SPEND') {
          const itemSpend = item.spend ?? 0;
          return itemSpend > (parseFloat(valLower) || 0);
        }
        return true;
      });
    });
  }, [campaigns, activeFilters]);

  // Toggle Handlers de Seleção
  const handleToggleSelectCampaign = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setSelectedCampaignIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  }, []);

  const handleToggleSelectAllCampaigns = useCallback((visibleIds: string[]) => {
    setSelectedCampaignIds((prev) => {
      const allSelected = visibleIds.every((id) => prev.includes(id));
      if (allSelected) {
        return prev.filter((id) => !visibleIds.includes(id));
      } else {
        return Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...visibleIds]));
      }
    });
  }, []);

  const handleToggleSelectAdSet = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setSelectedAdSetIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  }, []);

  const handleToggleSelectAllAdSets = useCallback((visibleIds: string[]) => {
    setSelectedAdSetIds((prev) => {
      const allSelected = visibleIds.every((id) => prev.includes(id));
      if (allSelected) {
        return prev.filter((id) => !visibleIds.includes(id));
      } else {
        return Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...visibleIds]));
      }
    });
  }, []);

  const handleToggleSelectAd = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setSelectedAdIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  }, []);

  const handleToggleSelectAllAds = useCallback((visibleIds: string[]) => {
    setSelectedAdIds((prev) => {
      const allSelected = visibleIds.every((id) => prev.includes(id));
      if (allSelected) {
        return prev.filter((id) => !visibleIds.includes(id));
      } else {
        return Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...visibleIds]));
      }
    });
  }, []);

  const handleSelectCampaign = (campaignId: string) => {
    setSelectedCampaignId(campaignId);
    setSelectedCampaignIds([campaignId]);
    setSelectedAdSetId(undefined);
    setSelectedAdSetIds([]);
    setActiveLevel('conjuntos');
  };

  const handleSelectAdSet = (adsetId: string) => {
    setSelectedAdSetId(adsetId);
    setSelectedAdSetIds([adsetId]);
    setActiveLevel('anuncios');
  };

  // Filtragem em cascata para conjuntos e anúncios
  const filteredAdSetsForTab = useMemo(() => {
    let list = adsets;
    const selCampIds = selectedCampaignIds.map((id) => String(id));
    if (selCampIds.length > 0) {
      list = list.filter((as) => selCampIds.includes(String(as.campaign_id)));
    }
    if (!activeFilters || activeFilters.length === 0) return list;
    return list.filter((item) => {
      return activeFilters.every((tag) => {
        const valLower = (tag.value || '').toLowerCase();
        if (tag.type === 'NAME') return (item.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(valLower);
        if (tag.type === 'ID') return String(item.id).toLowerCase().includes(valLower);
        if (tag.type === 'STATUS') {
          const statusLabel = (item.deliveryInfo?.label || item.status || '').toLowerCase();
          return statusLabel.includes(valLower);
        }
        if (tag.type === 'SPEND') {
          const itemSpend = item.spend ?? 0;
          return itemSpend > (parseFloat(valLower) || 0);
        }
        return true;
      });
    });
  }, [adsets, selectedCampaignIds, activeFilters]);

  const filteredAdsForTab = useMemo(() => {
    let list = ads;
    const selAdSetIds = selectedAdSetIds.map((id) => String(id));
    const selCampIds = selectedCampaignIds.map((id) => String(id));

    if (selAdSetIds.length > 0) {
      list = list.filter((ad) => selAdSetIds.includes(String(ad.adset_id)));
    } else if (selCampIds.length > 0) {
      list = list.filter((ad) => selCampIds.includes(String(ad.campaign_id)));
    }

    if (!activeFilters || activeFilters.length === 0) return list;

    return list.filter((item) => {
      return activeFilters.every((tag) => {
        const valLower = (tag.value || '').toLowerCase();
        if (tag.type === 'NAME') return (item.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(valLower);
        if (tag.type === 'ID') return String(item.id).toLowerCase().includes(valLower);
        if (tag.type === 'STATUS') {
          const statusLabel = (item.deliveryInfo?.label || item.status || '').toLowerCase();
          return statusLabel.includes(valLower);
        }
        if (tag.type === 'SPEND') {
          const itemSpend = item.spend ?? 0;
          return itemSpend > (parseFloat(valLower) || 0);
        }
        return true;
      });
    });
  }, [ads, selectedAdSetIds, selectedCampaignIds, activeFilters]);

  // Itens visíveis para KPIs de campanha
  const activeVisibleItems = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeLevel === 'conjuntos') return filteredAdSetsForTab;
    if (activeLevel === 'anuncios') return filteredAdsForTab;
    return filteredCampaignsByTags;
  }, [activeLevel, filteredCampaignsByTags, filteredAdSetsForTab, filteredAdsForTab]);

  // Agregação de métricas para a tela de campanhas
  const aggregatedKPIs = useMemo<GerenciadorSummary>(() => {
    const items = activeVisibleItems && activeVisibleItems.length > 0 ? activeVisibleItems : campaigns;

    let spendSum = 0;
    let impressionsSum = 0;
    let totalLinkClicks = 0;
    let totalLpViews = 0;
    let leadsSum = 0;

    items.forEach((item: any) => {
      if (item.spend !== null && item.spend !== undefined) {
        spendSum += parseFloat(item.spend || 0);
      }
      if (item.impressions !== null && item.impressions !== undefined) {
        impressionsSum += parseInt(item.impressions || 0);
      }

      const actionsArray =
        item.actions ||
        item.rawRecord?.insights?.data?.[0]?.actions ||
        item.rawRecord?.actions ||
        [];
      let lpViews = getActionValue(actionsArray, 'landing_page_view');
      if (!lpViews && item.landingPageViews) {
        lpViews = parseInt(item.landingPageViews, 10);
      }

      let linkClicks =
        item.inline_link_clicks !== undefined && item.inline_link_clicks !== null
          ? parseInt(item.inline_link_clicks as any, 10)
          : getActionValue(actionsArray, 'link_click') ||
            (item.clicks ? parseInt(item.clicks as any, 10) : 0);

      if (!linkClicks && item.clicks) {
        linkClicks = parseInt(item.clicks as any, 10);
      }

      if (!lpViews && linkClicks > 0) {
        lpViews = Math.round(linkClicks * 0.8511);
      }

      totalLinkClicks += linkClicks;
      totalLpViews += lpViews;

      if (item.conversions !== null && item.conversions !== undefined) {
        leadsSum += parseInt(item.conversions || 0);
      }
    });

    if (spendSum === 0 && summary && summary.investimentoTotal) {
      spendSum = summary.investimentoTotal;
      impressionsSum = summary.impressioesTotal || 0;
      totalLinkClicks = summary.cliquesTotal || 0;
      totalLpViews = summary.landingPageViewsTotal || Math.round(totalLinkClicks * 0.8511);
      leadsSum = summary.leadsTotal || 0;
    }

    const cpmMedio = impressionsSum > 0 ? parseFloat(((spendSum / impressionsSum) * 1000).toFixed(2)) : 0;
    const ctrMedio = impressionsSum > 0 ? parseFloat(((totalLinkClicks / impressionsSum) * 100).toFixed(2)) : 0;
    const globalConnectRate =
      totalLinkClicks > 0 ? parseFloat(((totalLpViews / totalLinkClicks) * 100).toFixed(2)) : 0;
    const cpcMedio = totalLinkClicks > 0 ? parseFloat((spendSum / totalLinkClicks).toFixed(2)) : null;
    const cpaMedio = leadsSum > 0 ? parseFloat((spendSum / leadsSum).toFixed(2)) : null;

    return {
      investimentoTotal: spendSum,
      cpmMedio,
      ctrMedio,
      connectRate: globalConnectRate,
      impressioesTotal: impressionsSum,
      cliquesTotal: totalLinkClicks,
      landingPageViewsTotal: totalLpViews,
      cpcMedio,
      leadsTotal: leadsSum > 0 ? leadsSum : null,
      cpaMedio,
    };
  }, [activeVisibleItems, campaigns, summary]);

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto">
      {/* SELETOR DE MODO SUPERIOR (CARTEIRA DE CONTAS VS DETALHES DA CONTA) */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-800">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/10 border border-brand-neon/20 text-brand-neon shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/5">
            <Building2 className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>{viewMode === 'carteira' ? 'Carteira de Contas' : selectedAccName}</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/30">
                DashTF 2.0
              </span>
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
              {viewMode === 'carteira'
                ? 'Saúde financeira, alertas de saldo e acompanhamento de metas de CPL em tempo real'
                : 'Métricas detalhadas, funil de performance e inspeção em nível de campanhas'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Botões de Alternância de Visão */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-900/90 p-1 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800">
          <button
            onClick={() => setViewMode('carteira')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
              viewMode === 'carteira'
                ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20'
                : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800'
            }`}
          >
            <LayoutDashboard className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Visão de Carteira ({carteiraItems.length})</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setViewMode('campanhas')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
              viewMode === 'campanhas'
                ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20'
                : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800'
            }`}
          >
            <Megaphone className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Detalhes da Conta</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              loadCarteira();
              if (onRefresh) onRefresh();
            }}
            disabled={isCarteiraLoading || isLoading}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors ml-1"
            title="Atualizar dados da carteira"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isCarteiraLoading || isLoading ? 'animate-spin text-brand-neon' : ''}`} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ============================================================== */}
      {/* MODO 1: VISÃO DE CARTEIRA (FASE 1 - SAÚDE FINANCEIRA & METAS) */}
      {/* ============================================================== */}
      {viewMode === 'carteira' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* 1. INDICADORES SUPERIORES (TRILHO DE ALERTAS) */}
          <AlertasTrilho
            items={carteiraItems}
            onSelectAccount={(accId) => handleInspectAccount(accId)}
          />

          {/* 2. REFATORAÇÃO DA TABELA DE CONTAS (VISÃO DE CARTEIRA) */}
          <CarteiraTableView
            items={carteiraItems}
            isLoading={isCarteiraLoading}
            selectedAccountId={selectedAccountId}
            onSelectAccount={setSelectedAccountId}
            onDrillDown={(accId) => handleInspectAccount(accId)}
            onMetaCplUpdated={handleMetaCplUpdated}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============================================================== */}
      {/* MODO 2: DETALHES DA CONTA (CAMPANHAS, CONJUNTOS, ANÚNCIOS)    */}
      {/* ============================================================== */}
      {viewMode === 'campanhas' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Barra de Navegação de Retorno */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-900/60 p-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800">
            <button
              onClick={() => setViewMode('carteira')}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>← Voltar para Carteira de Contas</span>
            </button>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-400">
              <span>Conta ativa:</span>
              <strong className="text-white">{selectedAccName}</strong>
              <span className="font-mono text-zinc-500">({selectedAccountId})</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 6 Top Metric KPI Cards (Funil de Performance Real) */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4">
            <MetricCard
              title="Investimento"
              mainValue={formatCurrency(aggregatedKPIs.investimentoTotal)}
              showDollarIcon={true}
              isLoading={isLoading}
            />
            <MetricCard
              title="CPM"
              mainValue={
                aggregatedKPIs.cpmMedio !== null && aggregatedKPIs.cpmMedio !== undefined
                  ? formatCurrency(aggregatedKPIs.cpmMedio)
                  : 'R$ 0,00'
              }
              showDollarIcon={true}
              isLoading={isLoading}
            />
            <MetricCard
              title="CTR"
              mainValue={formatPercent(aggregatedKPIs.ctrMedio)}
              showDollarIcon={false}
              isLoading={isLoading}
            />
            <MetricCard
              title="Connect Rate"
              mainValue={formatPercent(aggregatedKPIs.connectRate)}
              valueClassName={
                (aggregatedKPIs.connectRate ?? 0) >= 70 ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-red-400'
              }
              showDollarIcon={false}
              isLoading={isLoading}
            />
            <MetricCard
              title="Leads"
              mainValue={
                aggregatedKPIs.leadsTotal !== null && aggregatedKPIs.leadsTotal !== undefined
                  ? formatNumber(aggregatedKPIs.leadsTotal)
                  : '0'
              }
              showDollarIcon={false}
              isLoading={isLoading}
            />
            <MetricCard
              title="Custo por Lead"
              mainValue={
                aggregatedKPIs.cpaMedio !== null && aggregatedKPIs.cpaMedio !== undefined
                  ? formatCurrency(aggregatedKPIs.cpaMedio)
                  : aggregatedKPIs.leadsTotal && aggregatedKPIs.investimentoTotal
                  ? formatCurrency(aggregatedKPIs.investimentoTotal / aggregatedKPIs.leadsTotal)
                  : '—'
              }
              showDollarIcon={true}
              isLoading={isLoading}
            />
          </div>

          {/* Omnibox Smart Search */}
          <div className="bg-brand-card p-4 rounded-2xl border border-brand-border shadow-lg">
            <OmniboxSearch
              activeFilters={activeFilters}
              onAddFilter={handleAddFilter}
              onRemoveFilter={handleRemoveFilter}
              onClearAllFilters={handleClearAllFilters}
            />
          </div>

          {/* 3 Level Navigation Tabs */}
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-brand-border pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveLevel('top25')}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    activeLevel === 'top25'
                      ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black font-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20'
                      : 'bg-brand-card text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Top 25 Anúncios ({Math.min(25, localAds.length)})</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveLevel('campanhas')}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    activeLevel === 'campanhas'
                      ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20'
                      : 'bg-brand-card text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Megaphone className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Campanhas ({filteredCampaignsByTags.length})</span>
                  {selectedCampaignIds.length > 0 && (
                    <span className="ml-1 bg-blue-600 text-white text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                      {selectedCampaignIds.length}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveLevel('conjuntos')}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    activeLevel === 'conjuntos'
                      ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20'
                      : 'bg-brand-card text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Layers className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Conjuntos de Anúncios ({filteredAdSetsForTab.length})</span>
                  {selectedAdSetIds.length > 0 ? (
                    <span className="ml-1 bg-blue-600 text-white text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                      {selectedAdSetIds.length}
                    </span>
                  ) : selectedCampaignIds.length > 0 ? (
                    <span className="ml-1 bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                      Filtrado por {selectedCampaignIds.length} camp.
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveLevel('anuncios')}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    activeLevel === 'anuncios'
                      ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20'
                      : 'bg-brand-card text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Target className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Anúncios ({filteredAdsForTab.length})</span>
                  {selectedAdIds.length > 0 ? (
                    <span className="ml-1 bg-blue-600 text-white text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                      {selectedAdIds.length}
                    </span>
                  ) : selectedAdSetIds.length > 0 ? (
                    <span className="ml-1 bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                      Filtrado por {selectedAdSetIds.length} conj.
                    </span>
                  ) : selectedCampaignIds.length > 0 ? (
                    <span className="ml-1 bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                      Filtrado por {selectedCampaignIds.length} camp.
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Selection Banner */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                {selectedCampaignIds.length > 0 && (
                  <span className="bg-blue-950/60 border border-blue-500/40 text-blue-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2 font-medium">
                    <span>
                      Filtrado por <strong>{selectedCampaignIds.length}</strong>{' '}
                      {selectedCampaignIds.length === 1 ? 'campanha selecionada' : 'campanhas selecionadas'}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setSelectedCampaignIds([])}
                      className="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold transition-all"
                      title="Limpar seleção de campanhas"
                    >
                      Limpar
                    </button>
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Tabelas de Detalhes por Nível */}
            {activeLevel === 'top25' && (
              <AdsMetricsTable
                ads={localAds}
                adsets={adsets}
                metaCpl={currentAccountMetaCpl}
                accountName={selectedAccName}
                onToggleAdStatus={handleToggleAdStatus}
                isLoading={isLoading}
              />
            )}

            {activeLevel === 'campanhas' && (
              <CampaignLevelTable
                campaigns={filteredCampaignsByTags}
                selectedCampaignIds={selectedCampaignIds}
                onToggleSelectCampaign={handleToggleSelectCampaign}
                onToggleSelectAllCampaigns={handleToggleSelectAllCampaigns}
                onSelectCampaign={handleSelectCampaign}
                onToggleStatus={onToggleCampaignStatus}
                isLoading={isLoading}
              />
            )}

            {activeLevel === 'conjuntos' && (
              <AdSetLevelTable
                adsets={filteredAdSetsForTab}
                selectedCampaignId={selectedCampaignId}
                selectedAdSetIds={selectedAdSetIds}
                onToggleSelectAdSet={handleToggleSelectAdSet}
                onToggleSelectAllAdSets={handleToggleSelectAllAdSets}
                onSelectAdSet={handleSelectAdSet}
                onClearCampaignFilter={() => {
                  setSelectedCampaignId(undefined);
                  setSelectedCampaignIds([]);
                }}
                isLoading={isLoading}
              />
            )}

            {activeLevel === 'anuncios' && (
              <AdLevelTable
                ads={filteredAdsForTab}
                selectedAdSetId={selectedAdSetId}
                selectedAdIds={selectedAdIds}
                onToggleSelectAd={handleToggleSelectAd}
                onToggleSelectAllAds={handleToggleSelectAllAds}
                isLoading={isLoading}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/GestaoTarefasView.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { 
  MetaAdAccount 
} from '../types/meta';
import { 
  getCurrentWeekDays, 
  getCountdownToNextMonday, 
  checkLateStatus,
  getFortalezaTodayDate,
  WeekDayInfo
} from '../utils/tarefasTime';
import { 
  fetchWeeklyCheckinsMap, 
  upsertCheckin, 
  clearWeeklyCheckins,
  fetchEncaminhamentos,
  createEncaminhamento,
  updateEncaminhamentoStatus,
  deleteEncaminhamento,
  Encaminhamento,
  WeeklyCheckinState
} from '../services/gestaoTarefasService';
import { 
  fetchAgencyPortfolio, 
  AgencyPortfolioItem 
} from '../services/agencyPortfolioService';
import { 
  CalendarCheck, 
  Clock, 
  RotateCcw, 
  Plus, 
  Check, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Trash2, 
  Sparkles, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Calendar,
  Building,
  ArrowRight,
  Filter,
  CheckSquare,
  Calculator,
  Palette,
  X
} from 'lucide-react';

interface GestaoTarefasViewProps {
  accounts?: MetaAdAccount[];
}

export const GestaoTarefasView: React.FC<GestaoTarefasViewProps> = ({ accounts = [] }) => {
  // 1. Calendário e Virada Automática (Fortaleza)
  const weekDays = useMemo(() => getCurrentWeekDays(), []);
  const todayStr = useMemo(() => getFortalezaTodayDate(), []);
  const startDate = weekDays[0]?.date || todayStr;
  const endDate = weekDays[weekDays.length - 1]?.date || todayStr;

  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState(getCountdownToNextMonday());

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setCountdown(getCountdownToNextMonday());
    }, 60000); // Atualiza a cada minuto
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  // 2. Lista de Clientes da Carteira da Agência (Supabase agency_portfolio)
  const [portfolioClients, setPortfolioClients] = useState<AgencyPortfolioItem[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAgencyPortfolio().then(items => {
      if (items && items.length > 0) {
        setPortfolioClients(items);
      }
    });
  }, []);

  const activeClients = useMemo(() => {
    // 1. Prioriza a carteira oficial de clientes salva no Supabase
    if (portfolioClients && portfolioClients.length > 0) {
      return portfolioClients.map(p => ({
        id: p.account_id,
        name: p.account_name,
        raw_id: `act_${p.account_id}`,
        account_status: 1
      }));
    }
    // 2. Utiliza accounts recebidas via props
    if (accounts && accounts.length > 0) {
      const active = accounts.filter(a => a.account_status === 1);
      return (active.length > 0 ? active : accounts).map(a => ({
        id: a.id,
        name: a.name,
        raw_id: a.raw_id || `act_${a.id}`,
        account_status: a.account_status ?? 1
      }));
    }
    // 3. Fallback inicial
    return [
      { id: '1115861513053539', name: 'CA02 - FA', account_status: 1, raw_id: 'act_1115861513053539' },
      { id: '858751867277029', name: 'CA04 - Paraíso da Baleia', account_status: 1, raw_id: 'act_858751867277029' },
      { id: '977087437378962', name: 'CA01 - Dot Kayo', account_status: 1, raw_id: 'act_977087437378962' },
      { id: '448128631941716', name: 'Silvia Bastos Almeida (#advogadoce)', account_status: 1, raw_id: 'act_448128631941716' }
    ];
  }, [portfolioClients, accounts]);

  // 3. Estado dos Check-ins da Semana
  const [checkinsMap, setCheckinsMap] = useState<Record<string, WeeklyCheckinState>>({});
  const [isCheckinsLoading, setIsCheckinsLoading] = useState(true);

  const loadCheckins = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsCheckinsLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await fetchWeeklyCheckinsMap(startDate, endDate);
      setCheckinsMap(data);
    } finally {
      setIsCheckinsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [startDate, endDate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCheckins();
  }, [loadCheckins]);

  // Manipulador de clique no Checkbox (Criativo ou Calculadora)
  const handleToggleCheckin = useCallback(async (
    clientId: string,
    date: string,
    type: 'criativo' | 'calculadora'
  ) => {
    const key = `${clientId}_${date}`;
    const current = checkinsMap[key] || { criativo_done: false, calculadora_done: false };
    
    const updated: WeeklyCheckinState = {
      ...current,
      [type === 'criativo' ? 'criativo_done' : 'calculadora_done']: !current[type === 'criativo' ? 'criativo_done' : 'calculadora_done']
    };

    // Atualização Otimista Imediata
    setCheckinsMap(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: updated }));

    // Persistência no Supabase
    await upsertCheckin(clientId, date, updated.criativo_done, updated.calculadora_done);
  }, [checkinsMap]);

  // 4. Progresso de Contas em Dia (do Dia Atual)
  const progressStats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = activeClients.length;
    if (total === 0) return { inDayCount: 0, total: 0, percent: 0 };

    let inDayCount = 0;
    activeClients.forEach(client => {
      const key = `${client.id}_${todayStr}`;
      const state = checkinsMap[key];
      // Conta em dia = Criativo e Calculadora marcados para o dia de hoje
      if (state?.criativo_done && state?.calculadora_done) {
        inDayCount++;
      }
    });

    const percent = Math.round((inDayCount / total) * 100);
    return { inDayCount, total, percent };
  }, [activeClients, checkinsMap, todayStr]);

  // 5. Modal de Confirmação: Zerar Semana
  const [isResetModalOpen, setIsResetModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isResetting, setIsResetting] = useState(false);

  const handleConfirmResetWeek = async () => {
    setIsResetting(true);
    try {
      await clearWeeklyCheckins(startDate, endDate);
      setCheckinsMap({});
      setIsResetModalOpen(false);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Falha ao zerar semana:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsResetting(false);
    }
  };

  // 6. Estado dos Encaminhamentos (Tarefas Avulsas)
  const [encaminhamentos, setEncaminhamentos] = useState<Encaminhamento[]>([]);
  const [isTasksLoading, setIsTasksLoading] = useState(true);

  // Form de Novo Encaminhamento
  const [newClientId, setNewClientId] = useState('');
  const [newDescription, setNewDescription] = useState('');
  const [newDueDate, setNewDueDate] = useState(todayStr);
  const [newStatus, setNewStatus] = useState<Encaminhamento['status']>('A fazer');
  const [isAddingTask, setIsAddingTask] = useState(false);

  // Inicializa select com o primeiro cliente
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeClients.length > 0 && !newClientId) {
      setNewClientId(activeClients[0].id);
    }
  }, [activeClients, newClientId]);

  const loadTasks = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsTasksLoading(true);
    try {
      const list = await fetchEncaminhamentos();
      setEncaminhamentos(list);
    } finally {
      setIsTasksLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadTasks();
  }, [loadTasks]);

  const handleCreateTask = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newDescription.trim() || !newClientId || !newDueDate) return;

    setIsAddingTask(true);
    try {
      const created = await createEncaminhamento({
        client_id: newClientId,
        description: newDescription.trim(),
        due_date: newDueDate,
        status: newStatus
      });
      setEncaminhamentos(prev => [created, ...prev]);
      setNewDescription('');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Falha ao criar encaminhamento:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsAddingTask(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateStatus = async (id: string, nextStatus: Encaminhamento['status']) => {
    setEncaminhamentos(prev =>
      prev.map(t => (t.id === id ? { ...t, status: nextStatus } : t))
    );
    await updateEncaminhamentoStatus(id, nextStatus);
  };

  const handleDeleteTask = async (id: string) => {
    setEncaminhamentos(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== id));
    await deleteEncaminhamento(id);
  };

  // Helpers para encontrar nome do cliente
  const getClientName = useCallback((clientId: string) => {
    const found = activeClients.find(c => c.id === clientId);
    return found ? found.name : `Conta ${clientId}`;
  }, [activeClients]);

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-8 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto select-none">
      
      {/* HEADER SUPERIOR: TÍTULO, VIRADA AUTOMÁTICA E RESET */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-800">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/30 shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/10">
            <CalendarCheck className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>Gestão de Tarefas</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-brand-neon text-black">
                F.A. Operação
              </span>
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
              Cronograma semanal de Criativo & Calculadora e central de encaminhamentos
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Contador de Virada e Botão Zerar Semana */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {/* Contador de Virada Automática (Segunda-feira 00:00 Fortaleza) */}
          <div className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
            <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
            <span className="text-zinc-400">Virada automática em:</span>
            <strong className="text-brand-neon font-black font-mono">
              {countdown.formatted}
            </strong>
          </div>

          {/* Botão Outline "Zerar semana" */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsResetModalOpen(true)}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-red-400 hover:text-white border border-red-500/30 hover:bg-red-500/20 hover:border-red-500/50 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5"
            title="Reiniciar os check-ins da semana corrente"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Zerar semana</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ============================================================== */}
      {/* SEÇÃO 1: CRONOGRAMA DA SEMANA (MATRIZ DE CHECK-INS)            */}
      {/* ============================================================== */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        
        {/* Barra de Progresso no Topo */}
        <div className="bg-zinc-900/80 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/10 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/20">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white block">
                Progresso do Dia Atual ({weekDays.find(d => d.isToday)?.name || 'Hoje'})
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                <strong className="text-brand-neon">{progressStats.inDayCount}</strong> de <strong className="text-white">{progressStats.total}</strong> contas em dia ({progressStats.percent}%)
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Barra visual de progresso */}
          <div className="flex-1 max-w-md w-full">
            <div className="w-full bg-zinc-800 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden border border-zinc-700/60">
              <div
                className="h-full bg-brand-neon rounded-full transition-all duration-500 shadow-sm shadow-brand-neon/40"
                style={{ width: `${Math.max(3, progressStats.percent)}%` }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hidden sm:block">
            Meta diária: 100% dos clientes com Criativo e Calculadora checados
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tabela / Grid da Semana */}
        <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-zinc-900/90 text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-800 uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 min-w-[240px]">
                    Cliente / Conta ({activeClients.length})
                  </th>
                  {weekDays.map(day => (
                    <th 
                      key={day.date} 
                      className={`py-3 px-3 text-center min-w-[170px] ${
                        day.isToday ? 'bg-brand-neon/10 border-b-2 border-b-brand-neon text-brand-neon font-black' : ''
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                        <span>{day.name}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">({day.formatted})</span>
                        {day.isToday && (
                          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[9px] font-black bg-brand-neon text-black">
                            HOJE
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-800/60 font-medium">
                {activeClients.map(client => {
                  return (
                    <tr key={client.id} className="hover:bg-zinc-900/50 transition-colors">
                      {/* Coluna do Cliente */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4">
                        <div className="font-bold text-white text-xs truncate max-w-[230px]" title={client.name}>
                          {client.name}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono mt-0.5">
                          ID: {client.id}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Colunas dos 5 Dias Úteis */}
                      {weekDays.map(day => {
                        const key = `${client.id}_${day.date}`;
                        const state = checkinsMap[key] || { criativo_done: false, calculadora_done: false };
                        const isDayComplete = state.criativo_done && state.calculadora_done;

                        return (
                          <td 
                            key={day.date} 
                            className={`py-3 px-3 text-center transition-colors ${
                              day.isToday ? 'bg-brand-neon/[0.03]' : ''
                            }`}
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                              {/* Toggle Criativo */}
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleToggleCheckin(client.id, day.date, 'criativo')}
                                className={`px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold border transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 ${
                                  state.criativo_done
                                    ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black border-brand-neon shadow-sm shadow-brand-neon/30 font-black'
                                    : 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-700/80 hover:border-zinc-500'
                                }`}
                                title="Check-in de Criativo do dia"
                              >
                                <Palette className="w-3 h-3" />
                                <span>Criativo</span>
                                {state.criativo_done && <Check className="w-3 h-3 stroke-[3]" />}
                              </button>

                              {/* Toggle Calculadora */}
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleToggleCheckin(client.id, day.date, 'calculadora')}
                                className={`px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold border transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 ${
                                  state.calculadora_done
                                    ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black border-brand-neon shadow-sm shadow-brand-neon/30 font-black'
                                    : 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-700/80 hover:border-zinc-500'
                                }`}
                                title="Check-in de Calculadora de Métricas do dia"
                              >
                                <Calculator className="w-3 h-3" />
                                <span>Calculadora</span>
                                {state.calculadora_done && <Check className="w-3 h-3 stroke-[3]" />}
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        );
                      })}
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {/* Footer da Matriz */}
          <div className="p-3 bg-zinc-900/60 border-t border-zinc-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded bg-brand-neon" />
                <span>Check-in concluído</span>
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-700" />
                <span>Pendente</span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-zinc-500">
              Sincronização global automática em tempo real para toda a equipe
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ============================================================== */}
      {/* SEÇÃO 2: ENCAMINHAMENTOS (TAREFAS AVULSAS)                      */}
      {/* ============================================================== */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        
        {/* Header da Seção */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-base font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>Encaminhamentos</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">(Tarefas Avulsas por Cliente)</span>
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
              Acompanhamento de prazos, entregáveis e encaminhamentos operacionais
            </p>
          </div>

          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-400">
            Total: <strong className="text-white">{encaminhamentos.length}</strong> tarefas
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Formulário de Criação Rápida de Tarefa */}
        <form 
          onSubmit={handleCreateTask}
          className="bg-zinc-900/80 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3"
        >
          {/* Select de Cliente */}
          <div className="min-w-[200px] flex-1">
            <select
              value={newClientId}
              onChange={(e) => setNewClientId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white outline-none"
            >
              {activeClients.map(c => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                  {c.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Descrição da Tarefa */}
          <div className="min-w-[280px] flex-[2]">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={newDescription}
              onChange={(e) => setNewDescription(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Descreva a tarefa ou encaminhamento (ex: Subir criativos novos)..."
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Prazo (Data) */}
          <div className="w-[140px]">
            <input
              type="date"
              value={newDueDate}
              onChange={(e) => setNewDueDate(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon rounded-xl text-xs font-mono text-white outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Status Inicial */}
          <div className="w-[140px]">
            <select
              value={newStatus}
              onChange={(e) => setNewStatus(e.target.value as any)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white outline-none"
            >
              <option value="A fazer">A fazer</option>
              <option value="Em andamento">Em andamento</option>
              <option value="Aguardando">Aguardando</option>
              <option value="Concluído">Concluído</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Botão Adicionar Tarefa */}
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isAddingTask || !newDescription.trim()}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-black bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-50 shrink-0"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Adicionar Tarefa</span>
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* Tabela de Encaminhamentos */}
        <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-zinc-900/90 text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-800 uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 min-w-[200px]">Conta / Cliente</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 min-w-[320px]">Descrição da Tarefa</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 min-w-[160px]">Prazo</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 min-w-[150px]">Status</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 w-[60px] text-center">Ações</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-800/60 font-medium">
                {isTasksLoading ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={5} className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-500">
                      Carregando encaminhamentos...
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : encaminhamentos.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={5} className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-500">
                      Nenhum encaminhamento registrado. Adicione um encaminhamento no formulário acima.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  encaminhamentos.map(task => {
                    const lateInfo = checkLateStatus(task.due_date, task.status);

                    return (
                      <tr 
                        key={task.id} 
                        className={`hover:bg-zinc-900/50 transition-colors ${
                          task.status === 'Concluído' ? 'opacity-60' : ''
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* Conta / Cliente */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold text-white text-xs truncate max-w-[200px]">
                          {getClientName(task.client_id)}
                        </td>

                        {/* Descrição */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-zinc-200">
                          <span className={task.status === 'Concluído' ? 'line-through text-zinc-500' : ''}>
                            {task.description}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* Prazo com Alerta de Atraso */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className={`font-mono text-xs ${
                              lateInfo.isLate ? 'text-red-400 font-black' : 'text-zinc-300'
                            }`}>
                              {task.due_date ? task.due_date.split('-').reverse().join('/') : '—'}
                            </span>

                            {lateInfo.isLate && (
                              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-extrabold bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30 flex items-center gap-1">
                                <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3" />
                                <span>Atrasado ({lateInfo.daysLate}d)</span>
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Status Editável */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-3">
                          <select
                            value={task.status}
                            onChange={(e) => handleUpdateStatus(task.id, e.target.value as any)}
                            className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border transition-colors outline-none cursor-pointer ${
                              task.status === 'Concluído'
                                ? 'bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border-brand-neon/40'
                                : task.status === 'Em andamento'
                                ? 'bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30'
                                : task.status === 'Aguardando'
                                ? 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30'
                                : 'bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 border-zinc-700'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <option value="A fazer">A fazer</option>
                            <option value="Em andamento">Em andamento</option>
                            <option value="Aguardando">Aguardando</option>
                            <option value="Concluído">Concluído</option>
                          </select>
                        </td>

                        {/* Ações (Excluir) */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteTask(task.id)}
                            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/10 transition-colors"
                            title="Excluir encaminhamento"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ============================================================== */}
      {/* MODAL DE SEGURANÇA: CONFIRMAR ZERAMENTO DA SEMANA              */}
      {/* ============================================================== */}
      {isResetModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in">
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-red-500/40 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl relative select-none">
            
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3.5">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30 shrink-0">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-black text-white">
                  Confirmar Zeramento da Semana
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-1.5 leading-relaxed">
                  Tem certeza que deseja zerar os check-ins da semana de <strong>{startDate}</strong> a <strong>{endDate}</strong>?
                </p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-red-400 font-semibold mt-2">
                  Esta ação limpará as marcações de Criativo e Calculadora para toda a equipe.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-6 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-zinc-800">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsResetModalOpen(false)}
                disabled={isResetting}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 hover:text-white bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-700/80 transition-colors"
              >
                Cancelar
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleConfirmResetWeek}
                disabled={isResetting}
                className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-black bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                {isResetting ? (
                  <>
                    <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                    <span>Zerando...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Sim, Zerar Semana</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/Header.tsx`

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { 
  ChevronDown, 
  RefreshCw 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { DateRangePicker, DateRange } from './DateRangePicker';
import { MetaAdAccount, MetaConfig } from '../types/meta';

interface HeaderProps {
  activeTab: string;
  metaConfig: MetaConfig;
  accounts: MetaAdAccount[];
  selectedAccountId: string;
  setSelectedAccountId: (id: string) => void;
  dateRange: DateRange;
  setDateRange: (range: DateRange) => void;
  onRefresh: () => void;
  isLoading: boolean;
  searchQuery: string;
  setSearchQuery: (q: string) => void;
  onOpenDebug: () => void;
  lastUpdatedTime?: string;
  session?: any;
}

export const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  activeTab,
  metaConfig,
  accounts,
  selectedAccountId,
  setSelectedAccountId,
  dateRange,
  setDateRange,
  onRefresh,
  isLoading,
  searchQuery,
  setSearchQuery,
  onOpenDebug,
  lastUpdatedTime,
  session
}) => {
  const displayTimestamp = lastUpdatedTime || new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR');

  const user = session?.user;
  const userEmail: string = user?.email || '';
  const userName: string = user?.user_metadata?.name || user?.name || (userEmail ? userEmail.split('@')[0] : 'Usuário');
  
  // Format username (e.g. antonio.neto, viniciusmarinhods)
  const displayUsername = userEmail ? userEmail.split('@')[0] : (userName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ''));
  
  // Format initials (e.g. AN for Antonio Neto, VM for Vinicius Marinho)
  const userInitials = (() => {
    if (user?.user_metadata?.name || user?.name) {
      const parts = (user.user_metadata?.name || user.name).trim().split(/\s+/);
      if (parts.length >= 2) {
        return (parts[0][0] + parts[parts.length - 1][0]).toUpperCase();
      }
      return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    }
    if (userEmail) {
      const prefix = userEmail.split('@')[0];
      const dotParts = prefix.split(/[\._\-]/);
      if (dotParts.length >= 2) {
        return (dotParts[0][0] + dotParts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
      }
      return prefix.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    }
    return 'AN';
  })();

  const userRole = (user?.user_metadata?.role || user?.role || 'admin').toLowerCase();
  const isSuper = userEmail.toLowerCase().includes('viniciusmarinhods');
  const isAdmin = userRole === 'admin' || userEmail.toLowerCase().includes('dottech.ai') || isSuper;
  const roleSubtitle = isSuper ? 'Supervisor' : isAdmin ? 'Administrador' : 'Gestor de Tráfego';

  return (
    <header className="bg-brand-sidebar border-b border-brand-border px-6 py-4 space-y-4">
      {/* Top Utility Bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Title & Subtitle */}
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-3">
            {activeTab === 'gerenciador' && 'Visão Geral'}
            {activeTab === 'tarefas' && 'Gestão de Tarefas'}
            {activeTab === 'financeiro' && 'Financeiro & Abastecimentos'}
            {activeTab === 'integracoes' && 'Integrações Meta'}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-brand-textMuted mt-0.5">
            {activeTab === 'gerenciador'
              ? `Acompanhe suas métricas principais em um só lugar • Última atualização: ${displayTimestamp}`
              : activeTab === 'tarefas'
              ? 'Cronograma de check-ins da semana e encaminhamentos operacionais da equipe'
              : activeTab === 'financeiro'
              ? 'Controle de saldo, recargas e fluxo orçamentário'
              : 'Conecte sua conta de anúncios do Facebook Ads e sincronize dados reais da sua operação'}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Right Action Icons & User Profile */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          {/* Dynamic User Profile */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-brand-neon to-emerald-400 text-black font-black flex items-center justify-center text-xs shadow-md">
              {userInitials}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col text-left">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white">
                {displayUsername}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{roleSubtitle}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Control Bar */}
      {activeTab === 'gerenciador' && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {/* Interactive Date Range Picker */}
            <DateRangePicker 
              value={dateRange} 
              onChange={setDateRange} 
              timezone={accounts.find(a => a.id === selectedAccountId)?.timezone_name || 'America/Sao_Paulo'}
            />

            {/* Neon Green Filtrar Button */}
            <button 
              onClick={onRefresh}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold text-xs px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-brand-neonHover transition-all shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              <span>Filtrar</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
};

const FilterPill: React.FC<{ label: string }> = ({ label }) => (
  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-card border border-brand-border text-xs text-zinc-300 cursor-pointer hover:border-zinc-700 transition-colors">
    <span>{label}</span>
    <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500" />
  </div>
);
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/InstagramAvatar.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { cleanInstagramHandle } from '../services/instagramScraperService';

interface InstagramAvatarProps {
  avatarUrl?: string;
  handle?: string;
  name: string;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';
  className?: string;
}

export const InstagramAvatar: React.FC<InstagramAvatarProps> = ({
  avatarUrl,
  handle,
  name,
  size = 'md',
  className = ''
}) => {
  const [imgSrc, setImgSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hasError, setHasError] = useState(false);
  const [retryStage, setRetryStage] = useState(0); // 0: primary, 1: unavatar, 2: wsrv proxy, 3: initials

  const cleanHandle = handle ? cleanInstagramHandle(handle).cleanHandle : '';

  useEffect(() => {
    setHasError(false);
    setRetryStage(0);
    
    if (avatarUrl && avatarUrl.trim()) {
      setImgSrc(avatarUrl.trim());
    } else if (cleanHandle) {
      setImgSrc(`https://unavatar.io/instagram/${cleanHandle}`);
    } else {
      setImgSrc(null);
    }
  }, [avatarUrl, cleanHandle]);

  const handleError = () => {
    if (retryStage === 0) {
      setRetryStage(1);
      // Se tinha avatarUrl customizado, tenta via proxy wsrv.nl para contornar bloqueios de CORS/hotlink
      if (avatarUrl && avatarUrl.trim() && !avatarUrl.includes('wsrv.nl')) {
        setImgSrc(`https://wsrv.nl/?url=${encodeURIComponent(avatarUrl.trim())}&w=160&h=160&fit=cover&output=webp`);
        return;
      }
      // Se não, tenta unavatar via handle
      if (cleanHandle && imgSrc !== `https://unavatar.io/instagram/${cleanHandle}`) {
        setImgSrc(`https://unavatar.io/instagram/${cleanHandle}`);
        return;
      }
    } else if (retryStage === 1) {
      setRetryStage(2);
      if (cleanHandle && !imgSrc?.includes('wsrv.nl')) {
        setImgSrc(`https://wsrv.nl/?url=${encodeURIComponent(`https://unavatar.io/instagram/${cleanHandle}`)}&w=160&h=160&fit=cover&output=webp`);
        return;
      }
    }

    setHasError(true);
  };

  const sizeClasses = {
    sm: 'w-8 h-8 text-[10px]',
    md: 'w-10 h-10 text-xs',
    lg: 'w-12 h-12 text-sm',
    xl: 'w-16 h-16 text-base'
  };

  const initials = (name || 'CL')
    .trim()
    .split(' ')
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map(w => w[0])
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase() || 'CL';

  return (
    <div className={`relative shrink-0 ${className}`}>
      {imgSrc && !hasError ? (
        <div className="relative p-0.5 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-pink-500 via-rose-500 to-amber-400 shadow-md inline-block">
          <img
            src={imgSrc}
            alt={name}
            referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
            crossOrigin="anonymous"
            loading="lazy"
            onError={handleError}
            className={`${sizeClasses[size]} rounded-full object-cover border-2 border-brand-sidebar bg-zinc-900`}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={`${sizeClasses[size]} rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-brand-neon to-emerald-400 text-black font-black flex items-center justify-center border border-zinc-700 shadow-inner`}>
          {initials}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
```
