```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import axios from 'axios';
import { MetaConfig, MetaAdAccount } from '../types/meta';
import { 
  saveMetaConfig, 
  fetchAdAccounts,
  ADMIN_META_TOKEN,
  BM_ACCOUNTS_DICTIONARY
} from '../services/metaDataEngine';
import { 
  saveUserMetaToken, 
  maskToken 
} from '../services/userIntegrationService';
import { 
  fetchAgencyPortfolio, 
  syncAgencyPortfolio, 
  AgencyPortfolioItem 
} from '../services/agencyPortfolioService';
import { 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Lock, 
  Plus, 
  CreditCard, 
  Check, 
  Search, 
  Users, 
  Sparkles, 
  Copy, 
  Trash2, 
  Eye, 
  EyeOff, 
  Filter, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  ShieldAlert,
  Building2, 
  Info,
  CheckSquare,
  X
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface IntegrationsViewProps {
  session?: any;
  metaConfig: MetaConfig;
  setMetaConfig: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<MetaConfig>>;
  accounts: MetaAdAccount[];
  setAccounts: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<MetaAdAccount[]>>;
  onRefreshData: () => void;
  onPortfolioUpdated?: (portfolio: AgencyPortfolioItem[]) => void;
}

export const IntegrationsView: React.FC<IntegrationsViewProps> = ({
  session,
  metaConfig,
  setMetaConfig,
  accounts,
  setAccounts,
  onRefreshData,
  onPortfolioUpdated
}) => {
  // Token de Acesso da Meta
  const [tokenInput, setTokenInput] = useState(metaConfig.accessToken || ADMIN_META_TOKEN);
  const [showToken, setShowToken] = useState(false);

  // Carteira de clientes salva no Supabase (agency_portfolio)
  const [savedPortfolio, setSavedPortfolio] = useState<AgencyPortfolioItem[]>([]);
  
  // Set de IDs das contas selecionadas para a carteira
  const [selectedAccountIds, setSelectedAccountIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // Contas disponíveis para seleção
  const [availableAccounts, setAvailableAccounts] = useState<MetaAdAccount[]>(() => {
    const defaults = BM_ACCOUNTS_DICTIONARY['1098475893049001'] || [];
    const map = new Map<string, MetaAdAccount>();
    defaults.forEach(a => map.set(a.id, a));
    if (accounts && accounts.length > 0) {
      accounts.forEach(a => map.set(a.id, a));
    }
    return Array.from(map.values());
  });

  const [isLoadingAccounts, setIsLoadingAccounts] = useState(false);
  const [accountSearch, setAccountSearch] = useState('');
  const [filterTab, setFilterTab] = useState<'all' | 'selected' | 'unselected'>('all');

  // Adicionar Conta Manualmente
  const [manualIdInput, setManualIdInput] = useState('');
  const [manualNameInput, setManualNameInput] = useState('');
  const [isAddingManual, setIsAddingManual] = useState(false);
  const [manualNotice, setManualNotice] = useState<{
    type: 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';
    message: string;
    details?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Estados de feedback
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);

  // Extrai token efetivo desmascarado
  const getEffectiveToken = useCallback(() => {
    if (tokenInput.includes('...') && metaConfig.accessToken) {
      return metaConfig.accessToken;
    }
    return tokenInput.trim() || ADMIN_META_TOKEN;
  }, [tokenInput, metaConfig.accessToken]);

  // Carrega contas do Supabase e sincroniza a lista inicial
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAgencyPortfolio().then((items) => {
      setSavedPortfolio(items);
      const ids = new Set(items.map((i) => i.account_id));
      setSelectedAccountIds(ids);

      // Garante que todas as contas já salvas no Supabase constem na lista de disponíveis
      setAvailableAccounts(prev => {
        const map = new Map<string, MetaAdAccount>();
        prev.forEach(a => map.set(a.id, a));
        items.forEach(p => {
          if (!map.has(p.account_id)) {
            map.set(p.account_id, {
              id: p.account_id,
              raw_id: `act_${p.account_id}`,
              name: p.account_name,
              account_status: 1,
              currency: 'BRL',
              timezone_name: 'America/Sao_Paulo'
            });
          }
        });
        return Array.from(map.values());
      });
    });
  }, []);

  // Busca contas de anúncios diretamente via Meta Graph API (GET /v19.0/me/adaccounts)
  const handleSyncMetaAccounts = useCallback(async () => {
    const token = getEffectiveToken();
    if (!token || token.length < 10) {
      setToastMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: 'Insira um Token de Acesso da Meta válido para sincronizar.'
      });
      return;
    }

    setIsLoadingAccounts(true);
    setToastMessage(null);

    try {
      const fetched = await fetchAdAccounts(token);
      if (fetched && fetched.length > 0) {
        setAvailableAccounts(prev => {
          const map = new Map<string, MetaAdAccount>();
          prev.forEach(a => map.set(a.id, a));
          fetched.forEach(a => map.set(a.id, a));
          return Array.from(map.values());
        });
        setAccounts(fetched);

        setToastMessage({
          type: 'success',
          text: `Sincronização concluída! ${fetched.length} contas de anúncio identificadas na Meta Graph API.`
        });
      } else {
        setToastMessage({
          type: 'error',
          text: 'Nenhuma conta foi retornada para este token. Você pode cadastrar contas manualmente abaixo.'
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('Erro ao sincronizar contas com a Meta:', err);
      setToastMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: 'Não foi possível buscar as contas via Meta Graph API. Verifique o token ou adicione pelo ID.'
      });
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingAccounts(false);
    }
  }, [getEffectiveToken, setAccounts]);

  // Inserção Manual de Conta por ID com tratamento inteligente
  const handleManualAdd = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const rawVal = manualIdInput.trim();
    const customName = manualNameInput.trim();

    if (!rawVal) {
      setManualNotice({
        type: 'error',
        message: 'Informe o ID da conta de anúncios (ex: 570728878165179 ou act_570728878165179).'
      });
      return;
    }

    const cleanNumbers = rawVal.replace(/^act_/i, '').replace(/\D/g, '').trim();
    if (!cleanNumbers) {
      setManualNotice({
        type: 'error',
        message: 'ID inválido. Utilize apenas os números da conta de anúncios.'
      });
      return;
    }

    const formattedId = `act_${cleanNumbers}`;
    const numericId = cleanNumbers;

    // Se já estiver na lista, apenas marca na carteira
    if (availableAccounts.some(a => a.id === numericId)) {
      setSelectedAccountIds(prev => new Set(prev).add(numericId));
      setManualNotice({
        type: 'success',
        message: `A conta (ID: ${numericId}) já constava na lista e foi marcada na sua carteira!`
      });
      setManualIdInput('');
      setManualNameInput('');
      return;
    }

    setIsAddingManual(true);
    setManualNotice(null);

    const token = getEffectiveToken();

    try {
      // 1. Tenta validar diretamente na Meta Graph API
      const url = `https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/${formattedId}`;
      const res = await axios.get(url, {
        params: {
          fields: 'name,account_status,currency,timezone_name',
          access_token: token
        },
        timeout: 12000
      });

      if (res.status === 200 && res.data && res.data.name) {
        const realData = res.data;
        const newAccount: MetaAdAccount = {
          id: numericId,
          raw_id: formattedId,
          name: customName || realData.name,
          account_status: realData.account_status ?? 1,
          currency: realData.currency || 'BRL',
          timezone_name: realData.timezone_name || 'America/Sao_Paulo'
        };

        setAvailableAccounts(prev => [newAccount, ...prev]);
        setSelectedAccountIds(prev => new Set(prev).add(numericId));

        setManualNotice({
          type: 'success',
          message: `Conta "${newAccount.name}" validada e incluída na carteira com sucesso!`
        });
        setManualIdInput('');
        setManualNameInput('');
      } else {
        throw new Error('Conta sem nome válido retornado.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('Meta API retorno para conta manual:', err?.response?.data || err?.message);
      const metaError = err?.response?.data?.error;
      const isPermissionError = metaError?.code === 200 || metaError?.error_subcode === 1349141;

      // Resiliência para Agência: Se o usuário especificou um nome ou se for restrição de permissão (#200)
      // Permite adicionar a conta para compor a gestão sem travar a agência
      const fallbackName = customName || `Conta ${numericId}`;
      const newAccount: MetaAdAccount = {
        id: numericId,
        raw_id: formattedId,
        name: fallbackName,
        account_status: 1,
        currency: 'BRL',
        timezone_name: 'America/Sao_Paulo'
      };

      setAvailableAccounts(prev => [newAccount, ...prev]);
      setSelectedAccountIds(prev => new Set(prev).add(numericId));

      if (isPermissionError) {
        setManualNotice({
          type: 'warning',
          message: `Conta "${fallbackName}" adicionada à carteira! (Permissão de leitura pendente na Meta)`,
          details: 'Dica: assim que a permissão for liberada no Meta Business Manager, as métricas passarão a sincronizar automaticamente.'
        });
      } else {
        setManualNotice({
          type: 'warning',
          message: `Conta "${fallbackName}" adicionada manualmente à carteira.`,
          details: metaError?.message || 'Verificação offline realizada.'
        });
      }

      setManualIdInput('');
      setManualNameInput('');
    } finally {
      setIsAddingManual(false);
    }
  };

  // Alterna a seleção de uma conta
  const handleToggleAccount = (accountId: string) => {
    setSelectedAccountIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(accountId)) {
        next.delete(accountId);
      } else {
        next.add(accountId);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Remove uma conta da lista de disponíveis
  const handleRemoveAccount = (accountId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setAvailableAccounts(prev => prev.filter(a => a.id !== accountId));
    setSelectedAccountIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      next.delete(accountId);
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Copia o ID da conta para a área de transferência
  const handleCopyId = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(id);
    setCopiedId(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2000);
  };

  // Seleciona todas as contas filtradas
  const handleSelectAllVisible = () => {
    setSelectedAccountIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      filteredAccounts.forEach(acc => next.add(acc.id));
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Desmarca todas as contas filtradas
  const handleDeselectAllVisible = () => {
    setSelectedAccountIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      filteredAccounts.forEach(acc => next.delete(acc.id));
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Filtra as contas por aba e texto de busca
  const filteredAccounts = useMemo(() => {
    return availableAccounts.filter(acc => {
      const matchesSearch = 
        acc.name.toLowerCase().includes(accountSearch.toLowerCase()) ||
        acc.id.includes(accountSearch);

      if (!matchesSearch) return false;

      const isSelected = selectedAccountIds.has(acc.id);
      if (filterTab === 'selected') return isSelected;
      if (filterTab === 'unselected') return !isSelected;
      return true;
    });
  }, [availableAccounts, accountSearch, filterTab, selectedAccountIds]);

  // Contagem para os badges de aba
  const selectedCountTotal = selectedAccountIds.size;
  const unselectedCountTotal = availableAccounts.filter(a => !selectedAccountIds.has(a.id)).length;

  // Salva a Carteira de Clientes no Supabase (agency_portfolio)
  const handleSavePortfolio = async () => {
    if (selectedAccountIds.size === 0) {
      setToastMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: 'Selecione ao menos 1 conta de anúncios para compor sua Carteira de Clientes.'
      });
      return;
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    setToastMessage(null);

    const selectedList: Array<{ account_id: string; account_name: string }> = [];

    availableAccounts.forEach(acc => {
      if (selectedAccountIds.has(acc.id)) {
        selectedList.push({ account_id: acc.id, account_name: acc.name });
      }
    });

    // Garante que contas salvas anteriormente continuem salvas se marcadas
    savedPortfolio.forEach(p => {
      if (selectedAccountIds.has(p.account_id) && !selectedList.some(s => s.account_id === p.account_id)) {
        selectedList.push({ account_id: p.account_id, account_name: p.account_name });
      }
    });

    const finalToken = getEffectiveToken();
    if (session?.user?.id) {
      await saveUserMetaToken(session.user.id, finalToken);
    }

    // Grava no Supabase (agency_portfolio) e no cache local
    await syncAgencyPortfolio(selectedList);

    const nowStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR') + ' ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR');
    const primaryAccount = selectedList[0];

    const updatedConfig: MetaConfig = {
      ...metaConfig,
      accessToken: finalToken,
      selectedAccountId: primaryAccount?.account_id || metaConfig.selectedAccountId,
      accountName: primaryAccount?.account_name || metaConfig.accountName,
      currency: 'BRL',
      isConnected: true,
      lastSyncedAt: nowStr,
      lastValidationAt: nowStr
    };

    setMetaConfig(updatedConfig);
    saveMetaConfig(updatedConfig);

    const freshPortfolio = await fetchAgencyPortfolio();
    setSavedPortfolio(freshPortfolio);

    const updatedAccountsList: MetaAdAccount[] = freshPortfolio.map(item => {
      const match = availableAccounts.find(a => a.id === item.account_id);
      return match || {
        id: item.account_id,
        raw_id: `act_${item.account_id}`,
        name: item.account_name,
        account_status: 1,
        currency: 'BRL',
        timezone_name: 'America/Sao_Paulo'
      };
    });
    setAccounts(updatedAccountsList);

    if (onPortfolioUpdated) {
      onPortfolioUpdated(freshPortfolio);
    }

    setIsSaving(false);
    setToastMessage({
      type: 'success',
      text: `Carteira de Clientes salva com sucesso! ${selectedList.length} contas selecionadas agora alimentam todo o sistema.`
    });

    onRefreshData();
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      {/* 1. HEADER MODERNO COM STATS DA CARTEIRA */}
      <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800/80 rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-brand-neon/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-6 relative z-10">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/30">
                <Users className="w-5 h-5" />
              </span>
              <h1 className="text-xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
                Central de Integrações & Carteira de Clientes
              </h1>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-1 max-w-2xl">
              Selecione quais contas de anúncios compõem a gestão ativa da agência. Todas as métricas de saúde financeira, CPL e tarefas serão calculadas a partir desta seleção.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Stat Badges */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <div className="bg-zinc-900 border border-brand-neon/30 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                Clientes na Carteira
              </div>
              <div className="text-lg font-black text-brand-neon mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span>{selectedCountTotal}</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400 font-normal">contas ativas</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl">
              <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                Contas Disponíveis
              </div>
              <div className="text-lg font-black text-white mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span>{availableAccounts.length}</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-zinc-500 font-normal">identificadas</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* TOAST GLOBAL DE FEEDBACK */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border text-xs flex items-center justify-between shadow-lg transition-all animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2 ${
          toastMessage.type === 'success'
            ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300'
            : 'bg-rose-500/10 border-rose-500/30 text-rose-300'
        }`}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            {toastMessage.type === 'success' ? (
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            ) : (
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
            )}
            <span className="font-semibold">{toastMessage.text}</span>
          </div>
          <button 
            onClick={() => setToastMessage(null)}
            className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. LAYOUT EM DUAS COLUNAS */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
        
        {/* COLUNA ESQUERDA: TOKEN & ADICIONAR CONTA (4 COLS) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
          
          {/* CARD DE TOKEN DA META */}
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800/80 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-800/80 pb-3">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-neon" />
                <span>Token de Acesso da Meta</span>
              </h3>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSyncMetaAccounts}
                disabled={isLoadingAccounts}
                className="text-[11px] text-brand-neon hover:text-brand-neonHover font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                title="Buscar todas as contas vinculadas a este token via /me/adaccounts"
              >
                <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isLoadingAccounts ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                <span>{isLoadingAccounts ? 'Sincronizando...' : 'Sincronizar Meta'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={showToken ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  value={showToken ? maskToken(tokenInput) : tokenInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setTokenInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Cole seu token de acesso da Meta (EAAB...)"
                  className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700/80 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 font-mono outline-none focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon transition-all"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowToken(!showToken)}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
                  title={showToken ? 'Ocultar' : 'Exibir token'}
                >
                  {showToken ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                <span>Token salvo com segurança no Supabase</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* CARD DE ADICIONAR CONTA MANUALMENTE */}
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800/80 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            <div className="border-b border-zinc-800/80 pb-3">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-neon" />
                <span>Adicionar Conta à Carteira</span>
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 mt-1">
                Adicione contas pelo ID numérico. Se a permissão no BM estiver pendente, você pode definir um apelido e adicioná-la mesmo assim.
              </p>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleManualAdd} className="space-y-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 mb-1">
                  ID da Conta de Anúncios <span className="text-brand-neon">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={manualIdInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setManualIdInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ex: 570728878165179 ou act_570728878165179"
                  className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700/80 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 font-mono outline-none focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon transition-all"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 mb-1">
                  Nome / Apelido do Cliente <span className="text-zinc-500">(Opcional)</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={manualNameInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setManualNameInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ex: Construtora Solar / Dra Mariella"
                  className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700/80 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 outline-none focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon transition-all"
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isAddingManual || !manualIdInput.trim()}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-850 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/40 hover:border-brand-neon transition-all shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/10 disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isAddingManual ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-brand-neon" />
                    <span>Validando na Meta Graph API...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Adicionar à Carteira</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </form>

            {/* Notificação Contextual da Inserção Manual */}
            {manualNotice && (
              <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs space-y-1 ${
                manualNotice.type === 'success'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300'
                  : manualNotice.type === 'warning'
                  ? 'bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300'
                  : 'bg-rose-500/10 border-rose-500/30 text-rose-300'
              }`}>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold">
                  {manualNotice.type === 'success' && <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />}
                  {manualNotice.type === 'warning' && <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />}
                  {manualNotice.type === 'error' && <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />}
                  <span>{manualNotice.message}</span>
                </div>
                {manualNotice.details && (
                  <p className="text-[11px] opacity-90 pl-6 leading-relaxed">
                    {manualNotice.details}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* RESUMO DAS CONTAS SELECIONADAS */}
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800/80 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3 shadow-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-neon" />
                <span>Carteira Selecionada</span>
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-brand-neon font-bold">
                {selectedCountTotal} conta(s)
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {availableAccounts
                .filter(a => selectedAccountIds.has(a.id))
                .map(acc => (
                  <span
                    key={acc.id}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 border border-brand-neon/30 text-[11px] text-white"
                  >
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-brand-neon" />
                    <span className="font-semibold truncate max-w-[150px]">{acc.name}</span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleToggleAccount(acc.id)}
                      className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-rose-400 transition-colors ml-0.5"
                      title="Remover da carteira"
                    >
                      <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                  </span>
                ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* COLUNA DIREITA: SELETOR DE CONTAS DA CARTEIRA (7 COLS) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800/80 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            
            {/* TOOLBAR SUPERIOR: ABAS DE FILTRO & BUSCA */}
            <div className="space-y-3 border-b border-zinc-800/80 pb-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                {/* Abas Rápidas */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-zinc-900 p-1 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setFilterTab('all')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      filterTab === 'all'
                        ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20'
                        : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    Todas ({availableAccounts.length})
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setFilterTab('selected')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      filterTab === 'selected'
                        ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20'
                        : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    Na Carteira ({selectedCountTotal})
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setFilterTab('unselected')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      filterTab === 'unselected'
                        ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20'
                        : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    Disponíveis ({unselectedCountTotal})
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Atalhos Rápidos */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleSelectAllVisible}
                    className="text-[11px] text-brand-neon hover:text-brand-neonHover font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    ✓ Marcar Todas
                  </button>
                  <span className="text-zinc-700">•</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleDeselectAllVisible}
                    className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    ✕ Desmarcar
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Barra de Pesquisa */}
              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-500" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Pesquisar por nome do cliente ou ID da conta..."
                  value={accountSearch}
                  onChange={(e) => setAccountSearch(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl pl-9 pr-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 outline-none focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon font-sans transition-all"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* LISTA DE CONTAS COM CHECKBOX VERDE NEON */}
            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[460px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {isLoadingAccounts ? (
                <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2.5">
                  <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-brand-neon" />
                  <span>Sincronizando contas de anúncios com a Meta...</span>
                </div>
              ) : filteredAccounts.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 space-y-2">
                  <Info className="w-6 h-6 text-zinc-600 mx-auto" />
                  <p>Nenhuma conta encontrada com o filtro atual.</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-600">
                    Você pode adicionar qualquer conta colando o ID no card à esquerda.
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                filteredAccounts.map((acc) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedAccountIds.has(acc.id);
                  const isCopied = copiedId === acc.id;

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={acc.id}
                      onClick={() => handleToggleAccount(acc.id)}
                      className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer select-none group ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'bg-brand-neon/10 border-brand-neon/40 text-white shadow-sm shadow-brand-neon/5'
                          : 'bg-zinc-900/60 border-zinc-800/80 text-zinc-300 hover:border-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-900'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5 min-w-0">
                        {/* Checkbox Verde Neon */}
                        <div
                          className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center border transition-all shrink-0 ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-brand-neon border-brand-neon text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/30'
                              : 'bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-700 text-transparent group-hover:border-zinc-500'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[3]" />
                        </div>

                        {/* Informações da Conta */}
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white truncate max-w-[280px]">
                              {acc.name}
                            </span>
                            {acc.account_status === 1 ? (
                              <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 shrink-0">
                                Ativa
                              </span>
                            ) : acc.account_status === 3 ? (
                              <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/20 shrink-0">
                                Em Liquidação
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 shrink-0">
                                Status {acc.account_status}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>

                          <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 font-mono mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="text-zinc-500">ID: {acc.id}</span>
                            <button
                              onClick={(e) => handleCopyId(acc.id, e)}
                              className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-white p-0.5 transition-colors"
                              title="Copiar ID"
                            >
                              {isCopied ? (
                                <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                              ) : (
                                <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                              )}
                            </button>
                            <span>•</span>
                            <span>{acc.currency || 'BRL'}</span>
                            {acc.timezone_name && (
                              <>
                                <span>•</span>
                                <span className="text-zinc-500 truncate max-w-[120px]">
                                  {acc.timezone_name.replace('America/', '')}
                                </span>
                              </>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Ações da Conta */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 pl-3">
                        <span
                          className={`text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl transition-all ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20'
                              : 'bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-white group-hover:bg-zinc-750'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isSelected ? '✓ Na Carteira' : '+ Incluir'}
                        </span>

                        <button
                          onClick={(e) => handleRemoveAccount(acc.id, e)}
                          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-600 hover:text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-500/10 transition-colors opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"
                          title="Remover conta da lista"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>

            {/* BARRA FIXA DE SALVAR CARTEIRA */}
            <div className="pt-4 border-t border-zinc-800/80 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                <span>Total selecionado para monitoramento: </span>
                <strong className="text-brand-neon font-black">{selectedCountTotal} conta(s)</strong>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSavePortfolio}
                disabled={isSaving || selectedCountTotal === 0}
                className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black font-extrabold text-xs px-6 py-3 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-xl shadow-brand-neon/20 hover:scale-[1.01] active:scale-[0.99] disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isSaving ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-black" />
                    <span>Salvando Carteira...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Check className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[3]" />
                    <span>SALVAR CARTEIRA DE CLIENTES</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/LegalLayout.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { Logo } from './Logo';

export type LegalPage = 'termos' | 'privacidade';

export interface LegalBlock {
  type: 'p' | 'ul';
  text?: string;
  items?: string[];
}

export interface LegalSection {
  title: string;
  blocks: LegalBlock[];
}

export const LEGAL_LAST_UPDATED = '3 de setembro de 2026';

interface LegalLayoutProps {
  title: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  intro: string;
  sections: LegalSection[];
  onBack: () => void;
  crossLinkLabel: string;
  onCrossLink: () => void;
}

/** Casca visual compartilhada pelas páginas de Termos e de Privacidade. */
export const LegalLayout: React.FC<LegalLayoutProps> = ({
  title,
  updatedAt,
  intro,
  sections,
  onBack,
  crossLinkLabel,
  onCrossLink
}) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }, [title]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-brand-bg text-zinc-300 selection:bg-brand-neon selection:text-black">
      {/* Barra superior */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-brand-bg/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-brand-border">
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-5 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between">
          <button
            onClick={onBack}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            Voltar
          </button>
          <Logo />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Conteúdo */}
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-5 py-10">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">{title}</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mt-1">Última atualização: {updatedAt}</p>

        <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed mt-6">{intro}</p>

        <div className="mt-8 space-y-8">
          {sections.map((section) => (
            <section key={section.title}>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wide">{section.title}</h2>
              <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                {section.blocks.map((block, i) =>
                  block.type === 'p' ? (
                    <p key={i} className="text-sm leading-relaxed">
                      {block.text}
                    </p>
                  ) : (
                    <ul key={i} className="space-y-1.5 pl-1">
                      {block.items?.map((item, j) => (
                        <li key={j} className="text-sm leading-relaxed flex gap-2.5">
                          <span className="text-brand-neon mt-1.5 w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-brand-neon shrink-0" />
                          <span>{item}</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  )
                )}
              </div>
            </section>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Rodapé de navegação entre documentos */}
        <div className="mt-12 pt-6 border-t border-brand-border flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={onCrossLink}
            className="text-xs font-semibold text-brand-neon hover:underline"
          >
            Ler também: {crossLinkLabel}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onBack}
            className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
          >
            Voltar
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/LoginView.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { Lock, Mail, Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, AlertCircle, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Logo } from './Logo';
import { validateSystemUser, setLocalAuthUser } from '../services/systemUsers';
import { navigate } from '../lib/router';

interface LoginViewProps {
  onLoginSuccess: () => void;
}

export const LoginView: React.FC<LoginViewProps> = ({ onLoginSuccess }) => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!email || !password) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, preencha o e-mail e a senha.');
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      // 1. Check if user is a pre-configured system/admin user
      const systemUser = validateSystemUser(email, password);
      if (systemUser) {
        console.log('✅ Authenticated as System User:', systemUser.email);
        setLocalAuthUser(systemUser);
        
        // Background attempt to sync with Supabase session without blocking
        supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
          email: email.trim(),
          password
        }).catch(() => {});

        onLoginSuccess();
        return;
      }

      // 2. Try standard sign-in with Supabase
      const { data: signInData, error: signInError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
        email: email.trim(),
        password
      });

      if (!signInError && signInData.session) {
        console.log('✅ Logged in successfully via Supabase:', signInData.user?.email);
        onLoginSuccess();
        return;
      }

      // 3. Intercept "Invalid login credentials" or user not found to auto-signup behind scenes
      if (signInError && (
        signInError.message.toLowerCase().includes('invalid login credentials') ||
        signInError.message.toLowerCase().includes('user not found') ||
        signInError.status === 400
      )) {
        console.log('🚀 User not found on signIn, executing auto-signUp behind scenes...');
        const { data: signUpData, error: signUpError } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
          email: email.trim(),
          password
        });

        if (signUpError) {
          throw signUpError;
        }

        // If signup returned session or user created
        if (signUpData.session || signUpData.user) {
          console.log('✅ Auto-signup & login successful for:', signUpData.user?.email);
          
          if (!signUpData.session) {
            const { error: secondSignInErr } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
              email: email.trim(),
              password
            });
            if (secondSignInErr) throw secondSignInErr;
          }
          
          onLoginSuccess();
          return;
        }
      }

      if (signInError) {
        throw signInError;
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Authentication Error:', err);
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Falha na autenticação. Verifique suas credenciais.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-brand-bg flex items-center justify-center p-4 selection:bg-brand-neon selection:text-black relative overflow-hidden">
      {/* Background Decorative Blur Orbs */}
      <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/3 w-96 h-96 bg-brand-neon/10 rounded-full blur-[128px] pointer-events-none" />
      <div className="absolute bottom-1/4 right-1/3 w-96 h-96 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-full blur-[128px] pointer-events-none" />

      {/* Main Glassmorphic Login Card */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-brand-card/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-brand-border/80 rounded-2xl p-8 shadow-2xl relative z-10 space-y-6">
        
        {/* Top Header with Brand Logo */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-brand-sidebar border border-brand-border rounded-xl shadow-inner">
            <Logo />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Acesso ao Gerenciador</h1>
        </div>

        {/* Error Feedback Banner */}
        {errorMessage && (
          <div className="bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 rounded-xl p-3.5 flex items-start gap-3 text-red-400 text-xs animate-fadeIn">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="flex-1">{errorMessage}</div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Login Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          {/* Email Field */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-300 block">
              E-mail corporativo
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-zinc-500">
                <Mail className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <input
                type="email"
                required
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="seu.email@empresa.com"
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 bg-brand-sidebar/80 border border-brand-border focus:border-brand-neon/60 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon/60 rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 outline-none transition-all"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Password Field */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-300 block">
              Senha de acesso
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-zinc-500">
                <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <input
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                required
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-10 py-2.5 bg-brand-sidebar/80 border border-brand-border focus:border-brand-neon/60 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon/60 rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 outline-none transition-all"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-3.5 flex items-center text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-300 transition-colors"
                tabIndex={-1}
              >
                {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Primary Action Button */}
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isLoading}
            className="w-full mt-2 py-3 px-4 bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover active:scale-[0.99] text-black font-extrabold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/20 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:transform-none"
          >
            {isLoading ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-black" />
                <span>Autenticando...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <span>Entrar no Gerenciador</span>
                <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* Consentimento / Links legais */}
        <p className="text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 leading-relaxed">
          Ao acessar o painel, você concorda com os{' '}
          <a
            href="/termos"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              navigate('/termos');
            }}
            className="text-brand-neon hover:underline font-semibold"
          >
            Termos de Serviço
          </a>{' '}
          e a{' '}
          <a
            href="/privacidade"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              navigate('/privacidade');
            }}
            className="text-brand-neon hover:underline font-semibold"
          >
            Política de Privacidade
          </a>
          .
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```typescript
import React, { useState, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';

import { CompetitorDetails } from './MiningView';
import { generateDynamicAdsForPage } from '../services/metaDataEngine';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

export interface LibraryAd {
  id: string;
  libraryId: string;
  status: 'Ativo' | 'Inativo';
  startDate: string;
  daysActive?: number;
  platforms: ('facebook' | 'instagram' | 'messenger' | 'audience')[];
  variationsCount: number;
  adCountText?: string;
  partnerPage?: string;
  advertiser?: string;
  sponsored?: string;
  copy?: string;
  adCopy: string;
  mediaType: 'video' | 'image';
  mediaUrl?: string;
  videoUrl: string;
  thumbnailUrl: string;
  videoDuration?: string;
  classification?: 'ESCALADO' | 'TESTE';
  cta?: string;
  ctaText: string;
  linkDisplay?: string;
  targetDomain: string;
  impressionsRange?: string;
}

interface MetaAdsLibraryViewProps {
  competitor: CompetitorDetails;
  savedSwipes: (string | LibraryAd)[];
  onToggleSwipe: (id: string, fullAd?: LibraryAd) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  onOpenTransparency: () => void;
}

// Helper to generate dynamic initials for avatar fallback
export function getInitials(name: string): string {
  if (!name) return 'C';
  const clean = name.trim().replace(/^@/, '');
  const parts = clean.split(/[\s._-]+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  return (parts[0][0] + (parts[1]?.[0] || '')).toUpperCase();
}

// Componente de Player de Vídeo HTML5 Real com Ref e Controles Nativos
const VideoPlayerCard: React.FC<{
  videoUrl: string;
  thumbnailUrl: string;
  videoDuration?: string;
}> = ({ videoUrl, thumbnailUrl, videoDuration }) => {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);

  const handlePlayClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    if (isPlaying) {
      videoRef.current.pause();
      setIsPlaying(false);
    } else {
      videoRef.current.play();
      setIsPlaying(true);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div 
      className="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black aspect-[4/5] border border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center group/media cursor-pointer"
      onClick={handlePlayClick}
    >
      <video
        ref={videoRef}
        src={videoUrl}
        poster={thumbnailUrl}
        controls={isPlaying}
        playsInline
        onPlay={() => setIsPlaying(true)}
        onPause={() => setIsPlaying(false)}
        onEnded={() => setIsPlaying(false)}
        className="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-xl"
      />

      {/* Botão de Play Central */}
      {!isPlaying && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/30 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-black/80 border border-white/40 flex items-center justify-center backdrop-blur-xs group-hover/media:scale-110 group-hover/media:border-brand-neon transition-all shadow-xl">
            <Play className="w-5 h-5 text-brand-neon fill-brand-neon ml-0.5" />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Botão Flutuante de Download */}
      <a
        href={videoUrl}
        target="_blank"
        rel="noreferrer"
        download="criativo.mp4"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold text-[10px] px-2 py-1 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 shadow-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer z-10"
        title="Baixar criativo MP4"
      >
        <Download className="w-3 h-3" />
        <span>Download</span>
      </a>

      {/* Badge de Duração */}
      {videoDuration && !isPlaying && (
        <span className="absolute bottom-2 left-2 bg-black/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-mono text-white font-semibold pointer-events-none">
          {videoDuration}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const MetaAdsLibraryView: React.FC<MetaAdsLibraryViewProps> = ({
  competitor,
  savedSwipes,
  onToggleSwipe,
  onBack,
  onOpenTransparency
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'anuncios' | 'sobre'>('anuncios');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [platformFilter, setPlatformFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'facebook' | 'instagram'>('ALL');
  const [mediaTypeFilter, setMediaTypeFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'video' | 'image'>('ALL');
  const [selectedAdForModal, setSelectedAdForModal] = useState<LibraryAd | null>(null);
  const [activeStatusOnline, setActiveStatusOnline] = useState(true);
  const [onlySavedFilter, setOnlySavedFilter] = useState(false);
  const [savingAdId, setSavingAdId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; message: string } | null>(null);

  // 100% Dynamic profile variables extracted from competitor prop
  const profileName = competitor.name || 'Cliente Monitorado';
  const profileCategory = competitor.category || 'Página Meta Ads';
  const profileDescription = competitor.description || `Anúncios e campanhas ativas no Meta Ads para ${profileName}.`;

  // Read ads dynamically from competitor object
  const libraryAds = useMemo<LibraryAd[]>(() => {
    if (competitor.ads && competitor.ads.length > 0) {
      return competitor.ads;
    }
    return generateDynamicAdsForPage(profileName, competitor.facebookId || 'page');
  }, [competitor, profileName]);

  // Helper to check if an ad is saved in swipe file
  const isAdSaved = (adId: string) => {
    return savedSwipes.some(s => (typeof s === 'string' ? s === adId : s.id === adId));
  };

  // Count how many ads from this library are saved
  const savedCountInLibrary = useMemo(() => {
    return libraryAds.filter(a => isAdSaved(a.id)).length;
  }, [libraryAds, savedSwipes]);

  // Filtered Ads
  const filteredAds = useMemo(() => {
    return libraryAds.filter(ad => {
      if (activeStatusOnline && ad.status !== 'Ativo') return false;
      if (onlySavedFilter && !isAdSaved(ad.id)) return false;
      if (mediaTypeFilter !== 'ALL' && ad.mediaType !== mediaTypeFilter) return false;
      if (platformFilter !== 'ALL' && !ad.platforms.includes(platformFilter)) return false;

      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        const copyText = (ad.copy || ad.adCopy || '').toLowerCase();
        const matchCopy = copyText.includes(query);
        const matchId = (ad.libraryId || ad.id).includes(query);
        const matchDomain = (ad.targetDomain || ad.linkDisplay || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchAdv = (ad.advertiser || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
        if (!matchCopy && !matchId && !matchDomain && !matchAdv) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [libraryAds, searchQuery, mediaTypeFilter, platformFilter, activeStatusOnline, onlySavedFilter, savedSwipes]);

  // Processo de Download e Upload Permanente para Supabase Storage
  const handleSaveToSwipePermanent = async (ad: LibraryAd) => {
    if (isAdSaved(ad.id)) {
      onToggleSwipe(ad.id);
      setToast({
        type: 'success',
        message: 'Item removido do Swipe File.'
      });
      setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
      return;
    }

    setSavingAdId(ad.id);
    setToast(null);

    let permanentVideoUrl = ad.videoUrl;

    if (ad.videoUrl) {
      try {
        // 1. Fetch da URL original do vídeo e conversão para Blob
        const response = await fetch(ad.videoUrl);
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(`Falha no download do vídeo (${response.status})`);
        }
        const blob = await response.blob();

        // 2. Geração de nome de arquivo único
        const cleanId = (ad.libraryId || ad.id).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '');
        const fileName = `swipe_${cleanId}_${Date.now()}.mp4`;

        // 3. Upload para o bucket 'swipe_videos' do Supabase
        const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
          .from('swipe_videos')
          .upload(fileName, blob, {
            contentType: 'video/mp4',
            upsert: true
          });

        if (uploadError) {
          console.warn('Upload Supabase Storage aviso:', uploadError.message);
        } else {
          // 4. Obtenção da URL pública permanente
          const { data: publicUrlData } = supabase.storage
            .from('swipe_videos')
            .getPublicUrl(fileName);

          if (publicUrlData?.publicUrl) {
            permanentVideoUrl = publicUrlData.publicUrl;
          }
        }
      } catch (corsErr: any) {
        console.warn('Erro ao baixar vídeo para storage:', corsErr);
        setToast({
          type: 'error',
          message: 'Erro ao baixar o vídeo original. Proteção CORS ativa.'
        });
        setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000);
      }
    }

    // 5. Consolidação do Swipe com a URL permanente
    const consolidatedAd: LibraryAd = {
      ...ad,
      videoUrl: permanentVideoUrl
    };

    onToggleSwipe(consolidatedAd.id, consolidatedAd);

    setToast({
      type: 'success',
      message: '✓ Criativo salvo permanentemente no cofre!'
    });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
    setSavingAdId(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fadeIn relative">
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {toast && (
        <div className={`fixed top-5 right-5 z-50 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-2 border text-xs font-extrabold animate-bounce ${
          toast.type === 'success' 
            ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black border-black/20 shadow-brand-neon/20' 
            : 'bg-rose-500 text-white border-rose-600 shadow-rose-500/20'
        }`}>
          {toast.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[2.5]" />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[2.5]" />
          )}
          <span>{toast.message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 1. Top Meta Ads Navigation Bar */}
      <div className="bg-brand-sidebar border border-brand-border rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 shadow-lg">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onBack}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-card hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold border border-brand-border transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm active:scale-95"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-neon" />
            <span>Voltar para Mineração</span>
          </button>

          {/* Meta Brand Badge */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pl-3 border-l border-brand-border text-xs text-zinc-400">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-white">
              <svg className="w-4 h-4 fill-blue-500" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path d="M24 12.073c0-6.627-5.373-12-12-12s-12 5.373-12 12c0 5.99 4.388 10.954 10.125 11.854v-8.385H7.078v-3.47h3.047V9.43c0-3.007 1.792-4.669 4.533-4.669 1.312 0 2.686.235 2.686.235v2.953H15.83c-1.491 0-1.956.925-1.956 1.874v2.25h3.328l-.532 3.47h-2.796v8.385C19.612 23.027 24 18.062 24 12.073z"/>
              </svg>
              Biblioteca de Anúncios Meta
            </span>
            <span className="text-zinc-600">•</span>
            <span className="bg-zinc-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] text-zinc-300 font-medium">
              Brasil 🇧🇷
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Global Meta Search Bar */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 max-w-md">
          <div className="relative w-full">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-500" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={profileName}
              readOnly
              className="w-full bg-brand-bg border border-brand-border rounded-xl pl-9 pr-8 py-1.5 text-xs text-white font-semibold cursor-default truncate"
            />
            <span className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[10px] text-brand-neon bg-brand-neon/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold border border-brand-neon/20">
              Página Ativa
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Competitor Profile Banner & Tab Switcher (Dynamic) */}
      <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xl space-y-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          {/* Profile Header */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            {competitor.avatarUrl ? (
              <img
                src={competitor.avatarUrl}
                alt={profileName}
                className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full object-cover border-2 border-zinc-700 shadow-md"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-brand-neon via-emerald-400 to-teal-500 text-black font-black text-lg flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-brand-neon/60 shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/10 shrink-0">
                {getInitials(profileName)}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex flex-col">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
                {profileName}
                <span className="text-[11px] bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-blue-500/20">
                  {profileCategory}
                </span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                {profileDescription}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action to open Meta Page Transparency Modal */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onOpenTransparency}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-800/80 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-200 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold border border-zinc-700 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm active:scale-95"
          >
            <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon" />
            <span>Ver Transparência da Página</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tabs: Anúncios & Sobre */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-brand-border/70 pt-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-8">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('anuncios')}
              className={`text-sm font-bold pb-2 relative transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'anuncios'
                  ? 'text-white after:content-[""] after:absolute after:left-0 after:right-0 after:-bottom-[17px] after:h-[3px] after:bg-brand-neon'
                  : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
              }`}
            >
              Anúncios
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setActiveTab('sobre');
                onOpenTransparency();
              }}
              className={`text-sm font-semibold pb-2 relative transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'sobre'
                  ? 'text-white font-bold after:content-[""] after:absolute after:left-0 after:right-0 after:-bottom-[17px] after:h-[3px] after:bg-brand-neon'
                  : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
              }`}
            >
              Sobre
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Results counter */}
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-400">
            ~{filteredAds.length} resultados encontrados
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Filter and Search Toolbar */}
      <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-md flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          {/* Keyword Search Input */}
          <div className="relative w-72">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-500" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Palavra-chave (ex: ofertas, escala...)"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-brand-bg border border-brand-border rounded-xl pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon transition-all"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Media Type Filter */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-brand-bg border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-1 text-xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMediaTypeFilter('ALL')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                mediaTypeFilter === 'ALL'
                  ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-white shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
              }`}
            >
              Todos
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMediaTypeFilter('video')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                mediaTypeFilter === 'video'
                  ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-brand-neon shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
              }`}
            >
              Vídeos
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMediaTypeFilter('image')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                mediaTypeFilter === 'image'
                  ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-brand-neon shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
              }`}
            >
              Imagens
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Active Filter Pill & Saved Swipe Filter */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setOnlySavedFilter(!onlySavedFilter)}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              onlySavedFilter
                ? 'bg-lime-400/15 border-lime-400 text-lime-400 shadow-sm shadow-lime-400/10'
                : 'bg-zinc-800/80 border-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white hover:border-zinc-500'
            }`}
          >
            <Bookmark className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${onlySavedFilter ? 'fill-lime-400 text-lime-400' : 'text-zinc-400'}`} />
            <span>Salvos no Swipe ({savedCountInLibrary})</span>
          </button>

          {activeStatusOnline && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveStatusOnline(false)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-zinc-800/90 border border-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-zinc-700 transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" />
              <span>Status online: Anúncios ativos</span>
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white ml-0.5" />
            </button>
          )}
          {!activeStatusOnline && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveStatusOnline(true)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-700 text-zinc-400 text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>+ Filtrar por ativos</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4. Multi-Column Grid of Dynamic Meta Ads Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
        {filteredAds.map((ad) => {
          const isSaved = isAdSaved(ad.id);
          const isSaving = savingAdId === ad.id;
          const copyText = ad.copy || ad.adCopy;
          const displayAdvertiser = ad.advertiser || profileName;

          return (
            <div
              key={ad.id}

            >
              {/* Card Meta Header */}
              <div className="space-y-2 border-b border-brand-border/70 pb-3">
                {/* Status and Action Dots */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                      <svg className="w-2.5 h-2.5 fill-white" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path d="M24 12.073c0-6.627-5.373-12-12-12s-12 5.373-12 12c0 5.99 4.388 10.954 10.125 11.854v-8.385H7.078v-3.47h3.047V9.43c0-3.007 1.792-4.669 4.533-4.669 1.312 0 2.686.235 2.686.235v2.953H15.83c-1.491 0-1.956.925-1.956 1.874v2.25h3.328l-.532 3.47h-2.796v8.385C19.612 23.027 24 18.062 24 12.073z"/>
                      </svg>

                  {ad.platforms.includes('instagram') && (
                    <div className="w-4 h-4 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#FD1D1D] via-[#E1306C] to-[#833AB4] flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
                      <svg className="w-2.5 h-2.5 fill-white" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path d="M12 2.163c3.204 0 3.584.012 4.85.07 3.252.148 4.771 1.691 4.919 4.919.058 1.265.069 1.645.069 4.849 0 3.205-.012 3.584-.069 4.849-.149 3.225-1.664 4.771-4.919 4.919-1.266.058-1.644.07-4.85.07-3.204 0-3.584-.012-4.849-.07-3.26-.149-4.771-1.699-4.919-4.92-.058-1.265-.07-1.644-.07-4.849 0-3.204.013-3.583.07-4.849.149-3.227 1.664-4.771 4.919-4.919 1.266-.057 1.645-.069 4.849-.069zm0-2.163c-3.259 0-3.667.014-4.947.072-4.358.2-6.78 2.618-6.98 6.98-.059 1.281-.073 1.689-.073 4.948 0 3.259.014 3.668.072 4.948.2 4.358 2.618 6.78 6.98 6.98 1.281.058 1.689.072 4.948.072 3.259 0 3.668-.014 4.948-.072 4.354-.2 6.782-2.618 6.979-6.98.059-1.28.073-1.689.073-4.948 0-3.259-.014-3.667-.072-4.947-.196-4.354-2.617-6.78-6.979-6.98-1.281-.059-1.69-.073-4.949-.073zm0 5.838c-3.403 0-6.162 2.759-6.162 6.162s2.759 6.163 6.162 6.163 6.162-2.759 6.162-6.163c0-3.403-2.759-6.162-6.162-6.162zm0 10.162c-2.209 0-4-1.79-4-4 0-2.209 1.791-4 4-4s4 1.791 4 4c0 2.21-1.791 4-4 4zm6.406-11.845c-.796 0-1.441.645-1.441 1.44s.645 1.44 1.441 1.44c.795 0 1.439-.645 1.439-1.44s-.644-1.44-1.439-1.44z"/>
                      </svg>

                <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 font-medium pt-1">

                </div>

                {/* Top Action Buttons */}

                  {/* Botão de Salvar no Swipe com Upload para Supabase Storage */}
                  <button

                  <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
                    <span className="font-bold text-white text-[11px] truncate">
                      {displayAdvertiser}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-400">{ad.sponsored || 'Patrocinado'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Primary Copy Text */}
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3 select-text">
                  {copyText}
                </p>

                {/* Creative Media Preview with Real HTML5 Video Player */}
                <VideoPlayerCard
                  videoUrl={ad.videoUrl}

                />

                {/* Post Footer Call to Action */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-brand-border/60 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                  <span className="font-mono truncate">{ad.linkDisplay || ad.targetDomain}</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-zinc-200 bg-zinc-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                    {ad.cta || ad.ctaText}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {filteredAds.length === 0 && (
        <div className="py-16 text-center text-zinc-500 text-xs bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-2xl">
          Nenhum anúncio encontrado para os filtros selecionados.

      {/* 5. Detailed Ad Modal */}
      {selectedAdForModal && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn"

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-brand-border pb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
```
