```typescript
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                  ID da Biblioteca: {selectedAdForModal.libraryId || selectedAdForModal.id}
                </span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedAdForModal(null)}
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Body with Real Video Player */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 items-start">
              {/* Real Video Player Box */}
              <div className="relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-black aspect-[4/5] border border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xl">
                <video
                  src={selectedAdForModal.videoUrl}
                  poster={selectedAdForModal.thumbnailUrl}
                  controls
                  autoPlay
                  playsInline
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-2xl"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Ad Info & Full Copy */}
              <div className="space-y-4 flex flex-col justify-between h-full">
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    {competitor.avatarUrl ? (
                      <img
                        src={competitor.avatarUrl}
                        alt={profileName}
                        className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover border border-zinc-700"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-brand-neon to-emerald-400 text-black font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center border border-zinc-700 shrink-0">
                        {getInitials(profileName)}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-white text-sm">
                        {selectedAdForModal.advertiser || profileName}
                      </h4>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">Veiculação iniciada em {selectedAdForModal.startDate}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-brand-neon">Texto do Anúncio (Copy)</span>
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-200 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line select-text">
                      {selectedAdForModal.copy || selectedAdForModal.adCopy}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Ad Meta Specs */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                    <div className="bg-brand-card/70 border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-3">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 block font-semibold uppercase">Formato</span>
                      <span className="font-bold text-white uppercase">{selectedAdForModal.mediaType}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-brand-card/70 border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-3">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 block font-semibold uppercase">Classificação</span>
                      <span className={`font-bold ${selectedAdForModal.classification === 'ESCALADO' ? 'text-orange-400' : 'text-zinc-300'}`}>
                        {selectedAdForModal.classification || 'ESCALADO'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Modal Footer Actions */}
                <div className="space-y-2 pt-4 border-t border-brand-border">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={savingAdId === selectedAdForModal.id}
                    onClick={() => handleSaveToSwipePermanent(selectedAdForModal)}
                    className={`w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-60 ${
                      isAdSaved(selectedAdForModal.id)
                        ? 'bg-lime-400/15 border border-lime-400 text-lime-400 shadow-md'
                        : 'bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black font-extrabold shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {savingAdId === selectedAdForModal.id ? (
                      <>
                        <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-current" />
                        <span>Salvando...</span>
                      </>
                    ) : isAdSaved(selectedAdForModal.id) ? (
                      <>
                        <Bookmark className="w-4 h-4 fill-lime-400 text-lime-400" />
                        <span>SALVO NO SWIPE FILE</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Bookmark className="w-4 h-4 fill-black text-black" />
                        <span>SALVAR NO SWIPE FILE</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <a
                      href={selectedAdForModal.videoUrl}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      download="criativo.mp4"
                      className="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                    >
                      <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Baixar Vídeo (MP4)</span>
                    </a>

                    <a
                      href={`https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=${selectedAdForModal.libraryId || selectedAdForModal.id}`}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      className="bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-200 hover:text-white font-semibold py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 text-xs transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                    >
                      <span>Biblioteca Meta</span>
                      <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/MetaDebugModal.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  Terminal, 
  Database, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Search,
  Cpu,
  Play,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  BookOpen,
  Loader2,
  RefreshCw,
  Zap
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getAllRawAuditRecords } from '../services/metaDataEngine';
import { MetaConfig } from '../types/meta';
import { METRIC_DICTIONARY } from '../services/meta/metricDictionary';
import { runMetaDataEngineUnitTests, UnitTestResult } from '../services/meta/unitTests';
import { runInitialBackfillScript } from '../services/meta/dailyInsightsEngine';

interface MetaDebugModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  config: MetaConfig;
}

export const MetaDebugModal: React.FC<MetaDebugModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  config
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'audit' | 'actions' | 'tests' | 'dictionary' | 'backfill' | 'config'>('audit');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [selectedRecordId, setSelectedRecordId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState<UnitTestResult[]>([]);

  // Backfill 60-Day State
  const [isBackfilling, setIsBackfilling] = useState(false);
  const [backfillResult, setBackfillResult] = useState<{ success: boolean; message: string; totalRecords: number } | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const records = getAllRawAuditRecords();
  const filteredRecords = records.filter(r => 
    r.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
    JSON.stringify(r.raw).toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const selectedAudit = records.find(r => r.id === selectedRecordId) || records[0];

  // Extract all distinct Action Types found in audit store
  const actionInspectorRows: Array<{ action_type: string; value: string; level: string; recordId: string }> = [];
  records.forEach(r => {
    const actions = r.raw?.insights?.data?.[0]?.actions || [];
    actions.forEach((act: any) => {
      actionInspectorRows.push({
        action_type: act.action_type,
        value: act.value,
        level: r.lineage?.level || 'UNKNOWN',
        recordId: r.id
      });
    });
  });

  const handleRunTests = () => {
    const res = runMetaDataEngineUnitTests();
    setTestResults(res);
  };

  const handleExecuteBackfill = async () => {
    setIsBackfilling(true);
    setBackfillResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await runInitialBackfillScript(config, '2026-07-01', '2026-08-18');
      setBackfillResult(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setBackfillResult({ success: false, totalRecords: 0, message: err.message || 'Erro no processamento' });
    } finally {
      setIsBackfilling(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-[#121214] border border-brand-border rounded-2xl w-full max-w-5xl h-[88vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
        
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-brand-border bg-brand-sidebar flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-brand-neon/10 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/20">
              <Cpu className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                META DATA DEBUG & AUDIT ENGINE
                <span className="text-xs bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-500/30 font-mono">
                  ZERO ESTIMATES STRICT
                </span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                Auditoria completa da resposta RAW da Meta Marketing API v19.0
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-card hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Navigation */}
        <div className="px-6 py-2.5 border-b border-brand-border/60 bg-brand-bg flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs font-semibold">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('audit')}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                activeTab === 'audit' ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Database className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>RAW & Linhagem ({records.length})</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('actions')}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                activeTab === 'actions' ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Action Inspector ({actionInspectorRows.length})</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('backfill')}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                activeTab === 'backfill' ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Zap className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-neon group-hover:text-black" />
              <span>Carga Inicial (Backfill 60d)</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('dictionary')}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                activeTab === 'dictionary' ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Dicionário de Métricas</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('tests')}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                activeTab === 'tests' ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Testes de Integridade</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('config')}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                activeTab === 'config' ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Terminal className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Status API</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <span>Graph API: <strong className="text-brand-neon">v19.0</strong></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden p-6">
          {activeTab === 'audit' && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 h-full">
              {/* Record List */}
              <div className="flex flex-col border border-brand-border rounded-xl bg-brand-card overflow-hidden">
                <div className="p-3 border-b border-brand-border bg-brand-sidebar">
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-500" />
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="Filtrar por ID ou Payload..."
                      value={searchTerm}
                      onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-brand-bg border border-brand-border rounded-lg pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon font-mono"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-zinc-900/80">
                  {filteredRecords.length > 0 ? (
                    filteredRecords.map((r) => {
                      const isSelected = selectedAudit?.id === r.id;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={r.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setSelectedRecordId(r.id)}
                          className={`w-full text-left p-3 text-xs flex flex-col gap-1 transition-colors ${
                            isSelected ? 'bg-brand-neon/15 border-l-2 border-brand-neon text-white' : 'hover:bg-zinc-800/40 text-zinc-300'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-mono">
                            <span className="font-bold text-brand-neon">{r.id}</span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 px-1.5 rounded">
                              {r.lineage?.reconciliationStatus || 'VALID'}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono truncate">
                            Endpoint: {r.lineage?.endpoint}
                          </span>
                        </button>
                      );
                    })
                  ) : (
                    <div className="p-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 italic">
                      Nenhum registro RAW em memória. Conecte sua conta Meta para ingestão.
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Inspector JSON Viewer */}
              <div className="md:col-span-2 flex flex-col border border-brand-border rounded-xl bg-[#0B0B0D] overflow-hidden">
                <div className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-brand-border bg-brand-sidebar flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-xs">
                  <span className="text-brand-neon font-bold">
                    {selectedAudit ? selectedAudit.id : 'SELECIONE UM REGISTRO'}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-zinc-500 text-[10px]">
                    {selectedAudit?.lineage?.fetchedAt}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 font-mono text-[11px] text-emerald-400 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed select-text bg-[#09090b]">
                  {selectedAudit ? JSON.stringify(selectedAudit.raw, null, 2) : '// Nenhum payload RAW selecionado'}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'actions' && (
            <div className="flex flex-col border border-brand-border rounded-xl bg-brand-card overflow-hidden h-full">
              <div className="p-3 border-b border-brand-border bg-brand-sidebar flex items-center justify-between">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Inspeção de Action Types Normalizados ({actionInspectorRows.length})
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                  Preservação individual sem somar ações semanticamente distintas
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse font-mono text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-brand-bg border-b border-brand-border text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-textMuted uppercase">
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4">Action Type</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right">Valor / Ocorrências</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-center">Nível</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4">Record ID</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-800">
                    {actionInspectorRows.length > 0 ? (
                      actionInspectorRows.map((row, idx) => (
                        <tr key={idx} className="hover:bg-zinc-800/40">
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-4 font-bold text-brand-neon">{row.action_type}</td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right font-bold text-white">{row.value}</td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-center">
                            <span className="bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]">
                              {row.level}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-zinc-400 truncate max-w-[200px]">{row.recordId}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    ) : (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={4} className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-500 italic">
                          Nenhum action_type registrado no momento.
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'dictionary' && (
            <div className="flex flex-col border border-brand-border rounded-xl bg-brand-card overflow-hidden h-full">
              <div className="p-3 border-b border-brand-border bg-brand-sidebar">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Dicionário Central de Métricas (Central Metric Dictionary)
                </h3>
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-3">
                {Object.values(METRIC_DICTIONARY).map((def) => (
                  <div key={def.key} className="p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-brand-border bg-brand-bg flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-white">
                        <span>{def.displayName}</span>
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold ${
                          def.source === 'DIRECT_API' ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30' : 'bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30'
                        }`}>
                          {def.source}
                        </span>
                        {def.isPrimaryResult && (
                          <span className="bg-brand-neon/20 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]">
                            RESULTADO PRINCIPAL
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-zinc-400 text-[11px] mt-1">{def.description}</p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-right shrink-0">
                      {def.formula && (
                        <div className="text-brand-neon">Fórmula: <code>{def.formula}</code></div>
                      )}
                      {def.metaField && (
                        <div className="text-zinc-400">Campo Meta: <code>{def.metaField}</code></div>
                      )}
                      {def.actionType && (
                        <div className="text-zinc-400">Action Type: <code>{def.actionType}</code></div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'tests' && (
            <div className="flex flex-col border border-brand-border rounded-xl bg-brand-card overflow-hidden h-full p-4 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-brand-border pb-3">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">Bateria Automatizada de Testes de Integridade</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                    Executa validações rigorosas de paginação, idempotência, ações e tolerância zero a nulos/divisões por zero.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleRunTests}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-brand-neon text-black font-bold text-xs px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-brand-neonHover transition-all shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20"
                >
                  <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-black" />
                  <span>Executar Testes Agora</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-2">
                {testResults.length > 0 ? (
                  testResults.map((t, i) => (
                    <div
                      key={i}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-lg border flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono ${
                        t.passed ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300' : 'bg-rose-500/10 border-rose-500/30 text-rose-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        {t.passed ? <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" /> : <X className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400" />}
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-bold text-white">{t.name} <span className="text-[10px] opacity-60">[{t.category}]</span></div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] opacity-90 mt-0.5">{t.message}</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold uppercase ${
                        t.passed ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400'
                      }`}>
                        {t.passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <div className="p-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 italic">
                    Clique em "Executar Testes Agora" para rodar a bateria de testes de integridade.
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'backfill' && (
            <div className="space-y-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
              <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-6 space-y-5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/30">
                    <Zap className="w-6 h-6" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-base font-extrabold text-white">
                      Carga Inicial de Dados Históricos (Backfill de 60 Dias)
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                      Baixa todos os snapshots diários (`time_increment=1`) de <strong>01/07/2026 até 18/08/2026</strong> da Meta API e grava em lote no <strong>Supabase PostgreSQL</strong>.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-brand-sidebar border border-brand-border/80 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2 text-xs font-mono text-zinc-300">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-zinc-500">Período de Varredura:</span>
                    <span className="text-brand-neon font-bold">01/07/2026 ➔ 18/08/2026 (49 dias)</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-zinc-500">Modo de Agregação:</span>
                    <span className="text-white font-bold">time_increment=1 (Quebra Diária Nativa)</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-zinc-500">Destino de Gravação:</span>
                    <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">Supabase (`meta_daily_insights`) + Cache Local</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Toast Result Feedback Banner */}
                {backfillResult && (
                  <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex items-start gap-3 text-xs ${
                    backfillResult.success ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300' : 'bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/30 text-red-300'
                  }`}>
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-bold text-sm text-white">
                        {backfillResult.success ? 'Carga Inicial Concluída!' : 'Erro na Carga Inicial'}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-1 font-mono">{backfillResult.message}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Primary Action Button */}
                <button
                  onClick={handleExecuteBackfill}
                  disabled={isBackfilling}
                  className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black font-black text-xs rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/20 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  {isBackfilling ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-black" />
                      <span>Baixando histórico de 60 dias da Meta API e gravando no Supabase...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />
                      <span>Executar Carga Inicial de 60 Dias (Supabase DB)</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'config' && (
            <div className="space-y-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
              <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                  Estado da Conexão com a Meta Graph API
                </h3>

                <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
                  <div className="flex justify-between py-2 border-b border-zinc-800">
                    <span className="text-zinc-400">Status da Conexão:</span>
                    <span className={config.isConnected ? 'text-emerald-400 font-bold' : 'text-yellow-400 font-bold'}>
                      {config.isConnected ? 'CONECTADO (LIVE API)' : 'PENDENTE DE TOKEN DA META'}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-between py-2 border-b border-zinc-800">
                    <span className="text-zinc-400">Conta Selecionada:</span>
                    <span className="text-white font-bold">{config.selectedAccountId}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-between py-2 border-b border-zinc-800">
                    <span className="text-zinc-400">Versão da API:</span>
                    <span className="text-brand-neon font-bold">{config.apiVersion}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-between py-2">
                    <span className="text-zinc-400">Última Sincronização:</span>
                    <span className="text-white">{config.lastSyncedAt || 'Não realizada'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/MetricCard.tsx`

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { DollarSign } from 'lucide-react';

interface MetricCardProps {
  title: string;
  mainValue: string;
  extraInfoLabel?: string;
  extraInfoValue?: string;
  showDollarIcon?: boolean;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  valueClassName?: string;
}

export const MetricCard: React.FC<MetricCardProps> = React.memo(({
  title,
  mainValue,
  extraInfoLabel,
  extraInfoValue,
  showDollarIcon = true,
  isLoading = false,
  valueClassName,
}) => {
  return (
    <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-brand-neon/40 transition-all shadow-sm group sharp-card">
      {/* Card Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {showDollarIcon && (
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-neon shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 tracking-tight uppercase group-hover:text-white transition-colors">
            {title}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Metric Value / Skeleton Loader */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="h-8 w-28 rounded skeleton-shimmer my-1" />
      ) : (
        <div className={`text-2xl font-black tracking-tight my-1 ${valueClassName || 'text-white'}`}>
          {mainValue}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Extra Info (e.g. CPA / CAC for Leads) */}
      {extraInfoLabel && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs border-t border-brand-border/60 pt-2.5 mt-2">
          <span className="text-zinc-400 font-medium">{extraInfoLabel}:</span>
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="h-4 w-12 rounded skeleton-shimmer" />
          ) : (
            <span className="font-bold text-brand-neon">{extraInfoValue}</span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

MetricCard.displayName = 'MetricCard';

```

```typescript
  <div className="w-4 h-4 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#FD1D1D] via-[#E1306C] to-[#833AB4] flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs shrink-0" title="Instagram">
    <svg className="w-2.5 h-2.5 fill-white" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
      <path d="M12 2.163c3.204 0 3.584.012 4.85.07 3.252.148 4.771 1.691 4.919 4.919.058 1.265.069 1.645.069 4.849 0 3.205-.012 3.584-.069 4.849-.149 3.225-1.664 4.771-4.919 4.919-1.266.058-1.644.07-4.85.07-3.204 0-3.584-.012-4.849-.07-3.26-.149-4.771-1.699-4.919-4.92-.058-1.265-.07-1.644-.07-4.849 0-3.204.013-3.583.07-4.849.149-3.227 1.664-4.771 4.919-4.919 1.266-.057 1.645-.069 4.849-.069zm0-2.163c-3.259 0-3.667.014-4.947.072-4.358.2-6.78 2.618-6.98 6.98-.059 1.281-.073 1.689-.073 4.948 0 3.259.014 3.668.072 4.948.2 4.358 2.618 6.78 6.98 6.98 1.281.058 1.689.072 4.948.072 3.259 0 3.668-.014 4.948-.072 4.354-.2 6.782-2.618 6.979-6.98.059-1.28.073-1.689.073-4.948 0-3.259-.014-3.667-.072-4.947-.196-4.354-2.617-6.78-6.979-6.98-1.281-.059-1.69-.073-4.949-.073zm0 5.838c-3.403 0-6.162 2.759-6.162 6.162s2.759 6.163 6.162 6.163 6.162-2.759 6.162-6.163c0-3.403-2.759-6.162-6.162-6.162zm0 10.162c-2.209 0-4-1.79-4-4 0-2.209 1.791-4 4-4s4 1.791 4 4c0 2.21-1.791 4-4 4zm6.406-11.845c-.796 0-1.441.645-1.441 1.44s.645 1.44 1.441 1.44c.795 0 1.439-.645 1.439-1.44s-.644-1.44-1.439-1.44z"/>
    </svg>
  </div>
);

export const MiningView: React.FC<MiningViewProps> = ({ onNavigateToGerenciador }) => {
  const isDev = import.meta.env.DEV;

  // Feature Flag: Em produção (!isDev), exibe tela de "Em Desenvolvimento"
  if (!isDev) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full min-h-[70vh] text-center space-y-6 p-6 animate-fadeIn">
        <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-3xl bg-lime-400/10 border-2 border-lime-400/30 flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl shadow-lime-400/10">
          <Construction className="text-lime-400 w-16 h-16 stroke-[1.75]" />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2 max-w-md">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
            Módulo de Mineração em Desenvolvimento
          </h2>
          <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm leading-relaxed">
            Estamos construindo uma ferramenta avançada de inteligência competitiva e extração de criativos. Em breve esta funcionalidade estará liberada no seu dashboard.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            if (onNavigateToGerenciador) {
              onNavigateToGerenciador();
            } else {
              window.location.hash = '#gerenciador';
              window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('navigate-tab', { detail: 'gerenciador' }));
            }
          }}
          className="bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black font-extrabold text-xs px-6 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-black stroke-[2.5]" />
          <span>Voltar para Visão Geral</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const [searchUrl, setSearchUrl] = useState('');
  const [isMining, setIsMining] = useState(false);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; message: string } | null>(null);
  
  // Persistent Competitor Folders loaded from localStorage
  const [competitorFolders, setCompetitorFolders] = useState<MonitoredCompetitorFolder[]>(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_FOLDERS_KEY);
      if (stored !== null) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      }
      return [
        {
          id: 'folder-pietro-boscardin',
          competitor: DEFAULT_SAMPLE_COMPETITOR,
          addedAt: new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')
        }
      ];
    } catch {
      return [
        {
          id: 'folder-pietro-boscardin',
          competitor: DEFAULT_SAMPLE_COMPETITOR,
          addedAt: new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')
        }
      ];
    }
  });

  // Persistent Saved Swipes loaded from localStorage
  const [savedSwipes, setSavedSwipes] = useState<(string | LibraryAd)[]>(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_SAVED_SWIPES_KEY);
      return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  const [selectedCompetitor, setSelectedCompetitor] = useState<CompetitorDetails | null>(null);
  const [activeLibraryCompetitor, setActiveLibraryCompetitor] = useState<CompetitorDetails | null>(null);

  // Sync state to localStorage on changes
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SAVED_SWIPES_KEY, JSON.stringify(savedSwipes));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Error saving swipes to localStorage', e);
    }
  }, [savedSwipes]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_FOLDERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(competitorFolders));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Error saving competitor folders to localStorage', e);
    }
  }, [competitorFolders]);

  // Close modal on ESC key
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setSelectedCompetitor(null);
      }
    };
    if (selectedCompetitor) {
      window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [selectedCompetitor]);

  // Dynamic KPI Metrics calculated from all folders
  const kpiMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    const foldersCount = competitorFolders.length;
    if (foldersCount === 0) {
      return {
        monitoredCompetitors: 0,
        totalCreatives: 0,
        newCreatives7Days: 0,
        scaledCreatives: 0,
        testingCreatives: 0,
        avgDaysTesting: '-- dias'
      };
    }

    let totalAds = 0;
    let scaledAds = 0;
    let testingAds = 0;

    competitorFolders.forEach(folder => {
      const ads = folder.competitor.ads || [];
      const count = ads.length > 0 ? ads.length : 5;
      totalAds += count;
      scaledAds += Math.ceil(count * 0.4);
      testingAds += Math.floor(count * 0.6);
    });

    return {
      monitoredCompetitors: foldersCount,
      totalCreatives: totalAds,
      newCreatives7Days: Math.min(totalAds, foldersCount * 3),
      scaledCreatives: scaledAds,
      testingCreatives: testingAds,
      avgDaysTesting: '9 dias'
    };
  }, [competitorFolders]);

  // Handle URL Add & API Search (100% Dynamic)
  const handleMonitorSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!searchUrl.trim() || isMining) return;

    setIsMining(true);
    setToast(null);

    try {
      const metaConfig = getSavedMetaConfig();
      const token = metaConfig.accessToken || ADMIN_META_TOKEN;

      const result = await searchCompetitorAds(searchUrl, token);

      const competitorName = result.pageName || `Página ${result.pageId}`;
      const initials = getInitials(competitorName);

      const newFolder: MonitoredCompetitorFolder = {
        id: `folder-${result.pageId}-${Date.now()}`,
        competitor: {
          name: competitorName,
          handle: `@${competitorName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')}`,
          avatarInitials: initials,
          avatarUrl: result.avatarUrl || undefined,
          category: result.category || 'Página Meta Ads',
          description: `Anúncios e campanhas ativas no Meta Ads para ${competitorName}.`,
          facebookId: result.pageId,
          facebookFollowers: 'Seguidores verificados',
          facebookCategory: result.category || 'Página Meta Ads',
          instagramHandle: `@${competitorName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')}`,
          instagramFollowers: 'Seguidores Meta',
          mergedPagesCount: 0,
          nameChangedCount: 0,
          creationDate: 'Página Ativa',
          organizations: 'Nenhuma',
          primaryLocation: 'Brazil',
          pageUrl: searchUrl,
          ads: result.ads
        },
        addedAt: new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')
      };

      setCompetitorFolders(prev => {
        const filtered = prev.filter(f => f.competitor.facebookId !== result.pageId);
        const updated = [newFolder, ...filtered];
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_FOLDERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
        }
        return updated;
      });

      setToast({ 
        type: 'success', 
        message: `✓ Concorrente "${competitorName}" adicionado com sucesso!` 
      });
      setSearchUrl('');
      setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erro na mineração do concorrente:', err);
      setToast({ 
        type: 'error', 
        message: 'Falha ao rastrear concorrente. Verifique o link e o token.' 
      });
      setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 5000);
    } finally {
      setIsMining(false);
    }
  };

  // Toggle Save to Swipe File (Consolidated Object & Persistence)
  const handleToggleSwipe = (id: string, fullAd?: LibraryAd) => {
    setSavedSwipes(prev => {
      const isAlreadySaved = prev.some(item => (typeof item === 'string' ? item === id : item.id === id));
      let updated: (string | LibraryAd)[];
      if (isAlreadySaved) {
        updated = prev.filter(item => (typeof item === 'string' ? item !== id : item.id !== id));
      } else {
        updated = [...prev, fullAd || id];
      }
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SAVED_SWIPES_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Erro ao salvar swipes no localStorage:', err);
      }
      return updated;
    });
  };

  // Remove competitor folder immediately
  const handleRemoveCompetitorFolder = (folderId: string, competitorName: string) => {
    setCompetitorFolders(prev => {
      const updated = prev.filter(f => f.id !== folderId && f.competitor.name !== competitorName);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_FOLDERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Erro ao salvar no localStorage:', err);
      }
      return updated;
    });

    setToast({
      type: 'success',
      message: `✓ Pasta de "${competitorName}" deletada com sucesso!`
    });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
  };

  // If a competitor folder is opened, render the dynamic Meta Ads Library View
  if (activeLibraryCompetitor) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 max-w-[1700px] mx-auto">
        <MetaAdsLibraryView
          competitor={activeLibraryCompetitor}
          savedSwipes={savedSwipes}
          onToggleSwipe={handleToggleSwipe}
          onBack={() => setActiveLibraryCompetitor(null)}
          onOpenTransparency={() => setSelectedCompetitor(activeLibraryCompetitor)}
        />

        {/* Modal de Transparência da Página */}
        {selectedCompetitor && (
          <CompetitorTransparencyModal
            competitor={selectedCompetitor}
            onClose={() => setSelectedCompetitor(null)}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 max-w-[1700px] mx-auto animate-fadeIn relative">
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {toast && (
        <div className={`fixed top-5 right-5 z-50 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-2 border text-xs font-extrabold animate-bounce ${
          toast.type === 'success' 
            ? 'bg-brand-neon text-black border-black/20 shadow-brand-neon/20' 
            : 'bg-rose-500 text-white border-rose-600 shadow-rose-500/20'
        }`}>
          {toast.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[2.5]" />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[2.5]" />
          )}
          <span>{toast.message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 1. Área de Input (Monitoramento Dinâmico) */}
      <div className="bg-brand-card/90 border border-brand-border rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-sm">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          <label className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon" />
            Adicionar URL da Biblioteca de Anúncios p/ Monitorar Cliente
          </label>
          <form onSubmit={handleMonitorSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="relative flex-1">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchUrl}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchUrl(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?view_all_page_id=..."
                disabled={isMining}
                className="w-full bg-brand-bg border border-brand-border rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
              />
            </div>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={!searchUrl.trim() || isMining}
              className="bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover disabled:opacity-50 text-black font-extrabold text-xs px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              {isMining ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 text-black animate-spin" />
                  <span>Minerando...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-black stroke-[3]" />
                  <span>Monitorar</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Grid de KPIs (6 Cards) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3.5">
        <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-brand-neon/40 transition-all shadow-sm group">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-tight truncate">
              Concorrentes Monitorados
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
            {kpiMetrics.monitoredCompetitors}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-brand-neon/40 transition-all shadow-sm group">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-tight truncate">
              Criativos Totais
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
            {kpiMetrics.totalCreatives}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-brand-neon/40 transition-all shadow-sm group">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-tight truncate">
              Novos (Últ. 7 Dias)
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
            {kpiMetrics.newCreatives7Days}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-brand-neon/40 transition-all shadow-sm group">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <Flame className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400 fill-orange-400/20 shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-tight truncate">
              Criativos Escalados
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
            {kpiMetrics.scaledCreatives}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-brand-neon/40 transition-all shadow-sm group">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <FlaskConical className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-tight truncate">
              Criativos em Teste
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
            {kpiMetrics.testingCreatives}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-brand-neon/40 transition-all shadow-sm group">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-tight truncate">
              Dias Ativos Médios
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
            {kpiMetrics.avgDaysTesting}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Pastas de Clientes Monitorados (Meta Ads Library) */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-extrabold text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
            <FolderOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-neon" />
            <span>Pastas de Clientes Monitorados (Meta Ads Library)</span>
          </h3>
          <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
            {competitorFolders.length} {competitorFolders.length === 1 ? 'cliente monitorado' : 'clientes monitorados'}
          </span>
        </div>

        {competitorFolders.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-2xl p-12 text-center shadow-lg">
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 text-zinc-500 max-w-md mx-auto">
              <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-zinc-800/60 border border-zinc-700 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-400 shadow-inner">
                <FolderSearch className="w-7 h-7 stroke-[1.75]" />
              </div>
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">Nenhum cliente em monitoramento</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed">
                Insira a URL da Biblioteca de Anúncios do Meta Ads no campo acima para criar a pasta do cliente com todos os anúncios reais e vídeos reproduzíveis.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {competitorFolders.map((item) => {
              const comp = item.competitor;
              const adsCount = comp.ads?.length || 5;
              const scaledCount = Math.ceil(adsCount * 0.4);
              const testingCount = Math.floor(adsCount * 0.6);

              return (
                <div
                  key={item.id}
                  className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border hover:border-brand-neon/60 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4 transition-all group relative overflow-hidden"
                >
                  <div className="absolute -top-10 -right-10 w-28 h-28 bg-brand-neon/5 rounded-full blur-2xl group-hover:bg-brand-neon/15 transition-all" />

                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      {comp.avatarUrl ? (
                        <img
                          src={comp.avatarUrl}
                          alt={comp.name}
                          className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover border-2 border-zinc-700 shadow-md group-hover:border-brand-neon transition-colors shrink-0"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-brand-neon via-emerald-400 to-teal-500 text-black font-black text-sm flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-brand-neon/60 shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/10 shrink-0">
                          {getInitials(comp.name)}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <h4 className="font-extrabold text-white text-sm group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate">
                          {comp.name}
                        </h4>
                        <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400 block truncate">
                          {comp.category || 'Página Meta Ads'}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono mt-0.5 block truncate">
                          ID: {comp.facebookId}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Botão de Deletar Pasta */}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        e.preventDefault();
                        handleRemoveCompetitorFolder(item.id, comp.name);
                      }}
                      className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-red-400 p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-red-500/10 border border-transparent hover:border-red-500/20 transition-all cursor-pointer z-10 shrink-0"
                      title="Deletar pasta do cliente"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 py-2 border-y border-brand-border/60 text-center">
                    <div className="bg-brand-sidebar/80 rounded-lg p-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 block uppercase font-bold">Total</span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-black text-white">~{adsCount} ads</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-brand-sidebar/80 rounded-lg p-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-orange-400 block uppercase font-bold">Escalados</span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-black text-orange-400">{scaledCount}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-brand-sidebar/80 rounded-lg p-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 block uppercase font-bold">Em Teste</span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-black text-zinc-300">{testingCount}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Botão de Ação Dinâmico: Abrir Biblioteca Meta Ads */}
                  <div className="pt-1">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setActiveLibraryCompetitor(comp)}
                      className="w-full bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black font-extrabold text-xs py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer active:scale-98"
                    >
                      <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                      <span>Abrir Biblioteca Meta Ads</span>
                      <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Modal de Transparência da Página */}
      {selectedCompetitor && (
        <CompetitorTransparencyModal
          competitor={selectedCompetitor}
          onClose={() => setSelectedCompetitor(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// Sub-component: Competitor Transparency Modal
export const CompetitorTransparencyModal: React.FC<{
  competitor: CompetitorDetails;
  onClose: () => void;
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/NexusSyncIndicator.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { RefreshCw, Loader2, CheckCircle2, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { fetchNexusSyncStatus, triggerManualNexusSync, NexusSyncStatus } from '../services/meta/nexusSyncEngine';
import { clearInsightsCache } from '../services/metaDataEngine';

interface NexusSyncIndicatorProps {
  onRefresh?: () => void;
}

export const NexusSyncIndicator: React.FC<NexusSyncIndicatorProps> = ({ onRefresh }) => {
  const [syncStatus, setSyncStatus] = useState<NexusSyncStatus>({
    id: 1,
    engine_name: 'Nexus Sync',
    last_run: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: 'SUCCESS',
    message: 'Sincronização profunda concluída com sucesso'
  });

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<any>(null);

  // Debounced Hover Bridge Helpers
  const cancelCloseTimer = () => {
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }
  };

  const scheduleCloseTimer = () => {
    cancelCloseTimer();
    timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsOpen(false);
    }, 250); // 250ms Hover Bridge safe transition window
  };

  const handleMouseEnter = () => {
    cancelCloseTimer();
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    scheduleCloseTimer();
  };

  const handleToggleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    cancelCloseTimer();
    setIsOpen(prev => !prev);
  };

  // Close on Click-Outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        cancelCloseTimer();
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      cancelCloseTimer();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const loadStatus = async () => {
      const res = await fetchNexusSyncStatus();
      if (isMounted && !isSyncing) {
        setSyncStatus(res);
      }
    };

    loadStatus();
    const interval = setInterval(loadStatus, 30000);
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [isSyncing]);

  const handleManualSync = async (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (isSyncing) return;

    cancelCloseTimer();
    setIsSyncing(true);
    setToastMessage(null);
    setSyncStatus(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      status: 'RUNNING',
      message: 'Sincronização profunda Nexus Sync em execução...'
    }));

    try {
      const res = await triggerManualNexusSync();
      
      const freshStatus = await fetchNexusSyncStatus();
      setSyncStatus(freshStatus);

      if (res.success) {
        setToastMessage('Auditoria de métricas concluída! Banco de dados atualizado.');
        setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 4000);

        // Invalidate local insights cache & refresh table data
        clearInsightsCache();
        if (onRefresh) {
          onRefresh();
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSyncStatus(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        status: 'ERROR',
        message: err.message || 'Erro ao forçar sincronização'
      }));
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  const formatTime = (isoString: string) => {
    try {
      const d = new Date(isoString);
      return d.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    } catch {
      return '03:00';
    }
  };

  const getLedStyle = () => {
    if (syncStatus.status === 'RUNNING' || isSyncing) {
      return 'bg-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_#f59e0b] animate-pulse';
    }
    if (syncStatus.status === 'ERROR') {
      return 'bg-rose-500 shadow-[0_0_8px_#f43f5e] animate-pulse';
    }
    return 'bg-brand-neon shadow-[0_0_8px_#ccff00]';
  };

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef}
      className="relative flex items-center cursor-pointer group select-none"
      onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
      onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
    >
      {/* 6px Glowing LED Dot Button Trigger */}
      <div 
        onClick={handleToggleClick}
        className={`flex items-center gap-2 py-1 px-2.5 rounded-full bg-brand-card/80 border transition-all ${
          isOpen ? 'border-brand-neon bg-brand-neon/10 text-white shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/15' : 'border-brand-border/60 hover:border-brand-neon/40 text-zinc-300'
        }`}
      >
        <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${getLedStyle()}`} />
        <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold">Nexus Sync</span>
      </div>

      {/* Ultra-Clean Dark Popover (Hover Bridge + Click-to-Open + CSS Safe Area Bridge) */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div 
          onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
          onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
          className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-2 z-50 w-72 p-4 bg-[#161618] border border-brand-border rounded-xl shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 text-left before:content-[''] before:absolute before:-top-3 before:left-0 before:w-full before:h-3"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-brand-border/60 pb-2.5 mb-2.5">
            <span className="text-xs font-extrabold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${getLedStyle()}`} />
              {syncStatus.engine_name}
            </span>
            <span className={`text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded uppercase ${
              (syncStatus.status === 'RUNNING' || isSyncing) ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400' :
              syncStatus.status === 'ERROR' ? 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400' : 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400'
            }`}>
              {isSyncing ? 'RUNNING' : syncStatus.status}
            </span>
          </div>

          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300 font-sans leading-relaxed">
            {(syncStatus.status === 'SUCCESS' && !isSyncing)
              ? `Última sincronização profunda concluída com sucesso às ${formatTime(syncStatus.last_run)}.`
              : syncStatus.message}
          </p>

          {/* Toast feedback banner */}
          {toastMessage && (
            <div className="mt-2.5 p-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300 text-[11px] font-mono flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>{toastMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Manual Trigger Action Button */}
          <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-brand-border/40 space-y-2">
            <button
              onClick={handleManualSync}
              disabled={isSyncing}
              className="w-full py-2 px-3 bg-brand-card hover:bg-brand-neon hover:text-black text-brand-neon font-bold text-xs rounded-lg border border-brand-neon/40 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              {isSyncing ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Sincronizando...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Forçar Sincronização</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 pt-1">
              <span>Automação PG_CRON: 03:00 AM</span>
              <span>60d Retention</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/OmniboxSearch.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Search, X, Tag, Filter } from 'lucide-react';
import { FilterTag } from '../types/meta';

interface OmniboxSearchProps {
  activeFilters: FilterTag[];
  onAddFilter: (tag: FilterTag) => void;
  onRemoveFilter: (id: string) => void;
  onClearAllFilters: () => void;
}

export const OmniboxSearch: React.FC<OmniboxSearchProps> = ({
  activeFilters,
  onAddFilter,
  onRemoveFilter,
  onClearAllFilters
}) => {
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');
  const [isDropdownOpen, setIsDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Close autocomplete on click outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputValue.trim()) {
      e.preventDefault();
      createFilterFromInput(inputValue.trim());
    } else if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !inputValue && activeFilters.length > 0) {
      // Remove last filter on backspace if input is empty
      onRemoveFilter(activeFilters[activeFilters.length - 1].id);
    }
  };

  const createFilterFromInput = (val: string, forcedType?: 'NAME' | 'ID' | 'STATUS') => {
    const isDigits = /^\d+$/.test(val);
    const type = forcedType || (isDigits ? 'ID' : 'NAME');
    const label = type === 'ID' ? 'ID da campanha' : 'Nome contém';

    const newTag: FilterTag = {
      id: `filter_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      type,
      label,
      value: val
    };

    onAddFilter(newTag);
    setInputValue('');
    setIsDropdownOpen(false);
  };

  const getSuggestions = () => {
    if (!inputValue.trim()) return [];
    const val = inputValue.trim();
    const isNum = /^\d+$/.test(val);
    const lower = val.toLowerCase();

    const suggestions = [];

    if (isNum) {
      suggestions.push({
        type: 'ID' as const,
        title: `Filtrar por ID da Campanha: "${val}"`,
        subtitle: 'Busca direta por ID numérico'
      });
    }

    suggestions.push({
      type: 'NAME' as const,
      title: `Nome da campanha contém: "${val}"`,
      subtitle: 'Filtro por palavra-chave (Case Insensitive)'
    });

    if ('ativo'.includes(lower)) {
      suggestions.push({
        type: 'STATUS' as const,
        value: 'Ativo',
        title: 'Veiculação: "Ativo"',
        subtitle: 'Filtra campanhas com veiculação verde'
      });
    }

    if ('pausado'.includes(lower)) {
      suggestions.push({
        type: 'STATUS' as const,
        value: 'Pausado',
        title: 'Veiculação: "Pausado"',
        subtitle: 'Filtra campanhas pausadas pelo usuário'
      });
    }

    return suggestions;
  };

  const suggestions = getSuggestions();

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className="relative w-full">
      {/* Omnibox Input Container with Active Filter Tags */}
      <div
        className="w-full min-h-[42px] bg-brand-sidebar border border-brand-border focus-within:border-blue-500 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 shadow-inner transition-all cursor-text"
        onClick={() => setIsDropdownOpen(true)}
      >
        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />

        {/* Render Active Filter Tags (Pills) */}
        {activeFilters.map((tag) => (
          <span
            key={tag.id}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-blue-950/70 border border-blue-500/50 text-blue-300 text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg shadow-sm animate-fadeIn"
          >
            <Tag className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{tag.label}: <strong className="text-white font-bold">{tag.value}</strong></span>
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onRemoveFilter(tag.id);
              }}
              className="hover:text-red-400 p-0.5 rounded transition-colors"
              title="Remover filtro"
            >
              <X className="w-3 h-3" />
            </button>
          </span>
        ))}

        {/* Main Text Input */}
        <input
          type="text"
          value={inputValue}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setInputValue(e.target.value);
            setIsDropdownOpen(true);
          }}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          onFocus={() => setIsDropdownOpen(true)}
          placeholder={activeFilters.length === 0 ? "Pesquise para filtrar por: nome, identificação ou métrica" : "Adicionar outro filtro..."}
          className="flex-1 min-w-[200px] bg-transparent text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none py-1"
        />

        {activeFilters.length > 0 && (
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onClearAllFilters();
            }}
            className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-red-400 font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-zinc-700/60 transition-colors shrink-0"
          >
            Limpar tudo
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Autocomplete Dropdown */}
      {isDropdownOpen && suggestions.length > 0 && (
        <div className="absolute top-full left-0 right-0 mt-1.5 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-xl shadow-2xl z-50 overflow-hidden divide-y divide-zinc-800 animate-fadeIn">
          {suggestions.map((sug, idx) => (
            <div
              key={idx}
              onClick={() => createFilterFromInput(sug.value || inputValue.trim(), sug.type)}
              className="p-3 hover:bg-blue-600/20 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between group transition-colors"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <Filter className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
                <div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white group-hover:text-blue-300">
                    {sug.title}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                    {sug.subtitle}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 group-hover:bg-blue-500 group-hover:text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono">
                Enter ↵
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

```
