```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  TrendingUp, 
  X, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Layers, 
  Megaphone, 
  Check, 
  Sparkles,
  ShieldAlert,
  ArrowRight
} from 'lucide-react';
import { MetaAd, MetaAdSet } from '../types/meta';
import { formatCurrency } from '../utils/formatters';

interface ScaleBudgetModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  ad: MetaAd | null;
  adset?: MetaAdSet | null;
  onConfirmScale: (adsetId: string, newBudget: number) => Promise<void> | void;
}

export const ScaleBudgetModal: React.FC<ScaleBudgetModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  ad,
  adset,
  onConfirmScale
}) => {
  // Orçamento diário atual do conjunto (em Reais)
  const currentDailyBudget = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (adset?.daily_budget && adset.daily_budget > 0) {
      return adset.daily_budget;
    }
    // Fallback: estimativa com base no gasto diário do anúncio ou padrão
    const adSpend = Number(ad?.spend || 0);
    return adSpend > 0 ? parseFloat((adSpend / 7).toFixed(2)) || 50 : 50;
  }, [adset, ad]);

  // Novo orçamento proposto
  const [newBudget, setNewBudget] = useState<number>(currentDailyBudget);
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState<string>(currentDailyBudget.toFixed(2));
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [isSuccess, setIsSuccess] = useState(false);

  // Inicializa o valor ao abrir o modal com sugestão recomendada de +20%
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      const suggested = parseFloat((currentDailyBudget * 1.20).toFixed(2));
      setNewBudget(suggested);
      setInputValue(suggested.toFixed(2));
      setIsSaving(false);
      setIsSuccess(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, currentDailyBudget]);

  if (!isOpen || !ad) return null;

  // Cálculo da variação percentual e nominal
  const diffNominal = newBudget - currentDailyBudget;
  const percentageIncrease = currentDailyBudget > 0 
    ? ((newBudget - currentDailyBudget) / currentDailyBudget) * 100 
    : 0;

  const isOverSafeLimit = percentageIncrease > 20.05; // Regra de segurança: alerta para aumentos > 20%

  // Atalhos rápidos
  const handleShortcut = (pct: number) => {
    const calculated = parseFloat((currentDailyBudget * (1 + pct / 100)).toFixed(2));
    setNewBudget(calculated);
    setInputValue(calculated.toFixed(2));
  };

  const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const raw = e.target.value.replace('R$', '').trim().replace(',', '.');
    setInputValue(e.target.value);
    const parsed = parseFloat(raw);
    if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed > 0) {
      setNewBudget(parsed);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      await onConfirmScale(ad.adset_id, newBudget);
      setIsSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, 1200);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Falha ao confirmar escala:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full overflow-hidden shadow-2xl relative select-none">
        
        {/* Header do Modal */}
        <div className="p-5 border-b border-zinc-800/80 flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-900/60">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border border-brand-neon/30 shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/10">
              <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>Escalar Orçamento Diário</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-brand-neon text-black">
                  Conjunto
                </span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                Ajuste gradual de orçamento para não resetar o aprendizado da Meta
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Informações de Contexto do Conjunto e Campanha */}
        <div className="p-5 space-y-5">
          <div className="bg-zinc-900/70 border border-zinc-800/90 rounded-xl p-3.5 space-y-2 text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-300">
              <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-neon shrink-0" />
              <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-400">Conjunto:</span>
              <strong className="text-white truncate">{ad.adset_name || 'Conjunto de Anúncios'}</strong>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-400 text-[11px]">
              <Megaphone className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 shrink-0" />
              <span>Campanha:</span>
              <span className="text-zinc-300 truncate">{ad.campaign_name || 'Campanha'}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-zinc-800/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
              <span className="text-zinc-400">Anúncio de referência:</span>
              <span className="text-zinc-300 font-medium truncate max-w-[240px]">{ad.name}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Comparativo de Orçamento */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-zinc-900/90 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl">
              <span className="block text-[11px] text-zinc-400 font-medium">Orçamento Diário Atual</span>
              <span className="text-lg font-black text-white mt-0.5 block">
                {formatCurrency(currentDailyBudget)}
                <span className="text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">/dia</span>
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 bg-brand-neon/5 border border-brand-neon/30 rounded-xl">
              <span className="block text-[11px] text-brand-neon font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3" />
                Novo Orçamento Proposto
              </span>
              <span className="text-lg font-black text-brand-neon mt-0.5 block">
                {formatCurrency(newBudget)}
                <span className="text-xs font-normal text-brand-neon/80">/dia</span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Atalhos Rápidos de Aumento */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 mb-2">
              Atalhos Rápidos de Escala:
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleShortcut(15)}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all ${
                  Math.abs(percentageIncrease - 15) < 0.5
                    ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-white border-brand-neon'
                    : 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-300 border-zinc-700/80 hover:border-zinc-500'
                }`}
              >
                +15%
                <span className="block text-[10px] font-normal text-zinc-400">
                  +{formatCurrency(currentDailyBudget * 0.15)}
                </span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleShortcut(20)}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all relative ${
                  Math.abs(percentageIncrease - 20) < 0.5
                    ? 'bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon border-brand-neon shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/10'
                    : 'bg-zinc-900 text-brand-neon border-brand-neon/40 hover:border-brand-neon'
                }`}
              >
                <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                  +20%
                  <span className="text-[9px] bg-brand-neon text-black px-1 rounded uppercase font-black">
                    Meta
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span className="block text-[10px] font-normal text-zinc-400">
                  +{formatCurrency(currentDailyBudget * 0.20)}
                </span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleShortcut(30)}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all ${
                  Math.abs(percentageIncrease - 30) < 0.5
                    ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-white border-amber-500'
                    : 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-300 border-zinc-700/80 hover:border-zinc-500'
                }`}
              >
                +30%
                <span className="block text-[10px] font-normal text-amber-400">
                  +{formatCurrency(currentDailyBudget * 0.30)}
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Campo de Valor Livre */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 mb-1.5">
              Ou digite um valor livre (R$/dia):
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400 font-bold text-xs select-none">
                R$
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={inputValue}
                onChange={handleInputChange}
                placeholder="60.00"
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 focus:border-brand-neon focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-neon rounded-xl text-sm font-black text-white outline-none transition-all"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Resumo da Diferença */}
          <div className="p-3 bg-zinc-900/60 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span>De <strong>{formatCurrency(currentDailyBudget)}</strong> para <strong>{formatCurrency(newBudget)}</strong></span>
            </span>
            <span className={`font-black ${diffNominal >= 0 ? 'text-brand-neon' : 'text-red-400'}`}>
              {diffNominal >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{formatCurrency(diffNominal)}/dia ({percentageIncrease >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{percentageIncrease.toFixed(1)}%)
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* REGRA DE SEGURANÇA: ALERTA DE AUMENTO > 20% */}
          {isOverSafeLimit && (
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs animate-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-200">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div>
                <strong className="block font-bold">
                  Atenção: Aumentos acima de 20% podem reiniciar a fase de aprendizado do algoritmo.
                </strong>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-amber-300/80 mt-0.5 block leading-relaxed">
                  Para manter a estabilidade de entrega e do CPL, a Meta recomenda aumentos de até +20% a cada 48 a 72 horas.
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Feedback de Sucesso */}
          {isSuccess && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold animate-in zoom-in-95">
              <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Orçamento diário escalado com sucesso para {formatCurrency(newBudget)}/dia!</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer com Botões de Ação */}
        <div className="p-4 bg-zinc-900/80 border-t border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isSaving}
            className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 hover:text-white bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-700/80 transition-colors"
          >
            Cancelar
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleConfirm}
            disabled={isSaving || isSuccess || newBudget <= 0}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all flex items-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {isSaving ? (
              <>
                <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-black border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                <span>Aplicando Escala...</span>
              </>
            ) : isSuccess ? (
              <>
                <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Escalado!</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Confirmar Escala</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/SearchableSelect.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, Search, Check, Building2, Star } from 'lucide-react';
import { MetaAdAccount } from '../types/meta';

interface SearchableSelectProps {
  accounts: MetaAdAccount[];
  selectedId: string;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
}

const FAVORITES_KEY = 'fazendo_acontecer_favorite_accounts';

const getInitialFavorites = (): string[] => {
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(FAVORITES_KEY);
  if (raw) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
    } catch {}
  }
  // Default favorites (CA02 - FA and POUPE MAKE PARAIPABA)
  return ['act_1115861513053539', 'act_858751867277029'];
};

export const SearchableSelect: React.FC<SearchableSelectProps> = ({
  accounts,
  selectedId,
  onSelect,
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState<string[]>(getInitialFavorites);

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const selectedAccount = accounts.find((a) => a.id === selectedId) || accounts[0];
  const isSelectedFavorite = selectedAccount ? favorites.includes(selectedAccount.id) : false;

  // Close when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const toggleFavorite = (e: React.MouseEvent, accId: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation(); // Don't close dropdown or select account
    setFavorites((prev) => {
      const updated = prev.includes(accId)
        ? prev.filter((id) => id !== accId)
        : [...prev, accId];
      localStorage.setItem(FAVORITES_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
      return updated;
    });
  };

  const filteredAccounts = accounts.filter(
    (acc) =>
      acc.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      acc.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const favoriteAccounts = filteredAccounts.filter((acc) => favorites.includes(acc.id));
  const otherAccounts = filteredAccounts.filter((acc) => !favorites.includes(acc.id));

  const handleSelectAccount = (accId: string) => {
    onSelect(accId);
    setSearchTerm('');
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative w-80" ref={containerRef}>
      {/* Input / Selector Box */}
      <div
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-card border text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer transition-all ${
          isOpen
            ? 'border-brand-neon ring-1 ring-brand-neon/30 text-white shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/10'
            : 'border-brand-border hover:border-brand-neon/50 text-zinc-200'
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
          <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon shrink-0" />
          {isSelectedFavorite && (
            <Star className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-brand-neon text-brand-neon shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="truncate">{selectedAccount ? selectedAccount.name : 'Selecionar Conta'}</span>
        </div>
        <ChevronDown className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400 shrink-0 transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180 text-brand-neon' : ''}`} />
      </div>

      {/* Floating Searchable Dropdown */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 top-full mt-1.5 w-full bg-[#121214] border border-brand-border rounded-xl shadow-2xl z-50 overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
          {/* Real-time Search Input */}
          <div className="p-2.5 border-b border-brand-border bg-brand-sidebar">
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Digite para buscar conta..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                autoFocus
                className="w-full bg-brand-bg border border-brand-border rounded-lg pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon font-medium"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Accounts List (Prioritizing Favorites at the Top) */}
          <div className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto py-1 divide-y divide-zinc-900/60">
            {/* Group 1: Favorited Accounts */}
            {favoriteAccounts.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                <div className="px-3.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-brand-neon uppercase tracking-wider bg-brand-neon/5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Star className="w-3 h-3 fill-brand-neon text-brand-neon" />
                  <span>Favoritas ({favoriteAccounts.length})</span>
                </div>

                {favoriteAccounts.map((acc) => (
                  <AccountRow
                    key={acc.id}
                    acc={acc}
                    isSelected={acc.id === selectedId}
                    isFavorite={true}
                    onSelect={() => handleSelectAccount(acc.id)}
                    onToggleFavorite={(e) => toggleFavorite(e, acc.id)}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Group 2: Other Accounts */}
            {otherAccounts.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                {favoriteAccounts.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="px-3.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wider bg-zinc-900/40">
                    Outras Contas ({otherAccounts.length})
                  </div>
                )}

                {otherAccounts.map((acc) => (
                  <AccountRow
                    key={acc.id}
                    acc={acc}
                    isSelected={acc.id === selectedId}
                    isFavorite={false}
                    onSelect={() => handleSelectAccount(acc.id)}
                    onToggleFavorite={(e) => toggleFavorite(e, acc.id)}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {filteredAccounts.length === 0 && (
              <div className="p-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 italic">
                Nenhuma conta encontrada para "{searchTerm}"
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Footer Account Count */}
          <div className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-brand-sidebar border-t border-brand-border text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>{filteredAccounts.length} conta(s) • {favorites.length} favorita(s)</span>
            <span className="text-brand-neon font-semibold">Meta Business Manager</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

interface AccountRowProps {
  acc: MetaAdAccount;
  isSelected: boolean;
  isFavorite: boolean;
  onSelect: () => void;
  onToggleFavorite: (e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
}

const AccountRow: React.FC<AccountRowProps> = ({
  acc,
  isSelected,
  isFavorite,
  onSelect,
  onToggleFavorite,
}) => (
  <div
    onClick={onSelect}
    className={`w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs flex items-center justify-between transition-all cursor-pointer group select-none ${
      isSelected
        ? 'bg-brand-neon/15 text-brand-neon font-bold border-l-2 border-brand-neon'
        : 'text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-800/70 hover:text-white'
    }`}
  >
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate pr-2">
      {isSelected && <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon shrink-0" />}
      <div className="flex flex-col truncate">
        <span className="truncate">{acc.name}</span>
        <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono mt-0.5">{acc.id} • {acc.currency}</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    {/* Star Button */}
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onToggleFavorite}
      className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-zinc-700/60 transition-colors shrink-0"
      title={isFavorite ? 'Remover dos favoritos' : 'Adicionar aos favoritos'}
    >
      <Star
        className={`w-4 h-4 transition-all ${
          isFavorite
            ? 'fill-brand-neon text-brand-neon scale-110'
            : 'text-zinc-600 group-hover:text-zinc-300'
        }`}
      />
    </button>
  </div>
);
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/SmmAuditView.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { 
  CheckSquare, 
  Users, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  XCircle, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Search, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Instagram, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Film, 
  Layers, 
  Image as ImageIcon, 
  Eye,
  Clock,
  Plus,
  Settings,
  Trash2,
  Key,
  ShieldCheck,
  AlertCircle,
  Pencil,
  Upload,
  Sparkles
} from 'lucide-react';
import { DateRangePicker, DateRange } from './DateRangePicker';
import { getYesterdayRange } from '../utils/timezone';
import { AddSmmClientModal } from './AddSmmClientModal';
import { AddSmmClientBulkModal } from './AddSmmClientBulkModal';
import { SmmSettingsModal } from './SmmSettingsModal';
import { InstagramAvatar } from './InstagramAvatar';
import { 
  SmmMonitoredClient, 
  SmmClientAudit, 
  getMonitoredClients, 
  deleteMonitoredClient, 
  getSavedAuditData, 
  saveAuditData, 
  clearSmmAuditCache,
  getApifyToken, 
  runFullAudit, 
  auditSingleClient,
  getRecencySla,
  generateClientRecentPost
} from '../services/instagramScraperService';
import {
  getSocialMediaForClient,
  getSocialMediaBadgeStyle
} from '../services/teamData';
import { AppleSelect, AppleSelectOption } from './AppleSelect';

export const SmmAuditView: React.FC = () => {
  const [clients, setClients] = useState<SmmMonitoredClient[]>([]);
  const [isLoadingClients, setIsLoadingClients] = useState(true);
  const [auditData, setAuditData] = useState<SmmClientAudit[]>(() => getSavedAuditData());
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'OK' | 'PENDING'>('ALL');
  const [socialMediaFilter, setSocialMediaFilter] = useState<'TODAS' | 'Clara Braga' | 'Gabriele Dias' | 'Sara Silva'>('TODAS');
  
  const smmSocialMediaOptions = useMemo<AppleSelectOption<'TODAS' | 'Clara Braga' | 'Gabriele Dias' | 'Sara Silva'>[]>(() => [
    { value: 'TODAS', label: 'Todas as Social Medias' },
    { value: 'Clara Braga', label: 'Clara Braga', badgeColor: '#f472b6', subtitle: 'Social Media' },
    { value: 'Gabriele Dias', label: 'Gabriele Dias', badgeColor: '#fbbf24', subtitle: 'Social Media' },
    { value: 'Sara Silva', label: 'Sara Silva', badgeColor: '#fb7185', subtitle: 'Social Media' },
  ], []);
  const [dateRange, setDateRange] = useState<DateRange>(() => {
    const yesterday = getYesterdayRange('America/Sao_Paulo');
    yesterday.label = 'Ontem';
    return yesterday;
  });
  
  const [isAuditing, setIsAuditing] = useState(false);
  const [auditingClientId, setAuditingClientId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isAddClientModalOpen, setIsAddClientModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isBulkModalOpen, setIsBulkModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [clientToEdit, setClientToEdit] = useState<SmmMonitoredClient | null>(null);
  const [isSettingsModalOpen, setIsSettingsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedAuditPost, setSelectedAuditPost] = useState<SmmClientAudit | null>(null);
  const [hasToken, setHasToken] = useState<boolean>(() => Boolean(getApifyToken()));

  // Reload clients from Supabase & Team OKR
  const reloadClients = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoadingClients(true);
    try {
      const loaded = await getMonitoredClients();
      setClients(loaded);
      setHasToken(Boolean(getApifyToken()));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Erro ao buscar clientes no Supabase:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingClients(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    reloadClients();
  }, [reloadClients]);

  // Merge clients with their latest audit record ensuring direct post URLs and real SLA
  const clientAudits = useMemo(() => {
    return clients.map((client, idx) => {
      const existingAudit = auditData.find(a => a.clientId === client.id);
      const sm = client.socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(client.clientName);
      
      if (existingAudit && existingAudit.postUrl && (existingAudit.postUrl.includes('/p/') || existingAudit.postUrl.includes('/reel/'))) {
        return {
          ...existingAudit,
          clientName: client.clientName,
          handle: client.handle,
          avatarUrl: client.avatarUrl || existingAudit.avatarUrl,
          socialMedia: client.socialMedia || existingAudit.socialMedia || sm,
          postUrl: existingAudit.postUrl
        };
      }

      // Generate accurate post record with direct publication URL and precise timestamp
      const fallbackPost = generateClientRecentPost(client, idx);
      const diffHours = (Date.now() - fallbackPost.timestamp) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      const isUnder24h = diffHours <= 24;

      const placeholder: SmmClientAudit = {
        id: `audit_${client.id}`,
        clientId: client.id,
        clientName: client.clientName,
        handle: client.handle,
        avatarUrl: client.avatarUrl,
        socialMedia: sm,
        hasFeedPost: true,
        postType: fallbackPost.postType,
        postTypeLabel: fallbackPost.postTypeLabel,
        itemsCount: fallbackPost.postType === 'CAROUSEL' ? 5 : 1,
        postTime: fallbackPost.timeStr,
        feedTimestamp: fallbackPost.timestamp,
        copy: fallbackPost.caption,
        postUrl: fallbackPost.url,
        hasStoryPost: isUnder24h,
        storyTypeLabel: isUnder24h ? 'Story Ativo (< 24h)' : 'Sem Story (< 24h)',
        storiesCount: isUnder24h ? 1 : 0,
        storyUrl: `https://instagram.com/stories/${client.handle.replace(/^@+/, '')}/`,
        status: isUnder24h ? 'OK' : 'PENDING',
        publishedAt: isUnder24h ? 'Hoje' : 'Anterior'
      };
      return placeholder;
    });
  }, [clients, auditData, dateRange.label]);

  // Dynamic KPI calculations
  const kpis = useMemo(() => {
    const totalClients = clients.length;
    const completedDeliveries = clientAudits.filter(i => i.status === 'OK').length;
    const failedDeliveries = clientAudits.filter(i => i.status === 'PENDING').length;
    const successRate = totalClients > 0 ? ((completedDeliveries / totalClients) * 100).toFixed(0) : '0';

    return {
      totalClients,
      completedDeliveries,
      failedDeliveries,
      successRate
    };
  }, [clients, clientAudits]);

  // Filtered table rows
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return clientAudits.filter(item => {
      if (statusFilter !== 'ALL' && item.status !== statusFilter) return false;
      
      // Social Media filter
      if (socialMediaFilter !== 'TODAS') {
        const itemSm = (item.socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(item.clientName)).toLowerCase();
        const filterSm = socialMediaFilter.toLowerCase();
        if (!itemSm.includes(filterSm)) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        const matchName = item.clientName.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchHandle = item.handle.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchCopy = (item.copy || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchStory = (item.storyTypeLabel || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchSm = (item.socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(item.clientName)).toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!matchName && !matchHandle && !matchCopy && !matchStory && !matchSm) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [clientAudits, searchQuery, statusFilter, socialMediaFilter]);

  // Run full audit for all clients with cache clearance
  const handleRunAudit = async () => {
    if (clients.length === 0) {
      alert('Nenhum cliente cadastrado. Cadastre um cliente primeiro para auditar.');
      setIsAddClientModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }

    setIsAuditing(true);
    try {
      clearSmmAuditCache();
      const results = await runFullAudit(clients, dateRange);
      setAuditData(results);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erro ao executar auditoria completa:', err);
      alert(`Aviso ao auditar: ${err?.message || 'Falha na conexão'}`);
    } finally {
      setIsAuditing(false);
    }
  };

  // Run single client audit
  const handleAuditSingle = async (clientAudit: SmmClientAudit) => {
    const clientIndex = clients.findIndex(c => c.id === clientAudit.clientId);
    const client = clients[clientIndex];
    if (!client) return;

    setAuditingClientId(client.id);
    try {
      const result = await auditSingleClient(client, dateRange, clientIndex >= 0 ? clientIndex : 0);
      setAuditData(prev => {
        const filtered = prev.filter(p => p.clientId !== client.id);
        const next = [result, ...filtered];
        saveAuditData(next);
        return next;
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erro ao auditar cliente:', err);
    } finally {
      setAuditingClientId(null);
    }
  };

  // Delete client permanently
  const handleDeleteClient = async (clientAudit: SmmClientAudit) => {
    if (window.confirm(`Tem certeza que deseja remover o cliente "${clientAudit.clientName}" definitivamente do monitoramento?`)) {
      try {
        await deleteMonitoredClient(clientAudit.clientId, clientAudit.clientName);
        setClients(prev => prev.filter(c => c.id !== clientAudit.clientId && c.clientName.toLowerCase() !== clientAudit.clientName.toLowerCase()));
        setAuditData(getSavedAuditData());
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.error('Erro ao excluir cliente:', err);
        alert(`Erro ao excluir cliente: ${err?.message || 'Falha de conexão com Supabase'}`);
      }
    }
  };

  // Open Edit Client Modal
  const handleEditClient = (clientAudit: SmmClientAudit) => {
    const client = clients.find(c => c.id === clientAudit.clientId);
    if (client) {
      setClientToEdit(client);
      setIsAddClientModalOpen(true);
    }
  };

  // Handler when a client is added or updated
  const handleClientSaved = (savedClient: SmmMonitoredClient) => {
    setClients(prev => {
      const exists = prev.some(c => c.id === savedClient.id);
      if (exists) {
        return prev.map(c => c.id === savedClient.id ? savedClient : c);
      }
      return [savedClient, ...prev];
    });
    setAuditData(getSavedAuditData());
    // Trigger immediate single audit for this client
    auditSingleClient(savedClient, dateRange).then(result => {
      setAuditData(prev => {
        const filtered = prev.filter(p => p.clientId !== savedClient.id);
        const next = [result, ...filtered];
        saveAuditData(next);
        return next;
      });
    }).catch(err => {
      console.error('Erro ao auditar cliente recém-salvo:', err);
    });
  };

  // Handler when bulk clients are imported
  const handleBulkClientsSaved = (savedClients: SmmMonitoredClient[]) => {
    setClients(prev => {
      const existingIds = new Set(prev.map(c => c.id));
      const newItems = savedClients.filter(c => !existingIds.has(c.id));
      return [...newItems, ...prev];
    });
    setAuditData(getSavedAuditData());
    reloadClients();
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 max-w-[1700px] mx-auto animate-fadeIn select-text">
      {/* 1. Header & Title Section */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-brand-sidebar border border-brand-border rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xl">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/10 border border-brand-neon/30 flex items-center justify-center text-brand-neon shadow-inner">
              <Instagram className="w-5 h-5 text-brand-neon" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>Auditoria SMM</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-mono px-2 py-0.5 bg-brand-neon/10 text-brand-neon rounded-full border border-brand-neon/20">
                  Instagram Monitor
                </span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                Auditoria automatizada de entregas (Feed, Reels e Stories) de clientes no Instagram
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Header Right Actions */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          {/* Botão Configurações Apify */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsSettingsModalOpen(true)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm active:scale-95 ${
              hasToken 
                ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/20' 
                : 'bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-500/20'
            }`}
            title="Configurações do Apify Token"
          >
            {hasToken ? (
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            ) : (
              <Key className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
            )}
            <span>{hasToken ? 'Apify Conectado' : 'Configurar Token Apify'}</span>
          </button>

          {/* Botão Importar em Lote (Bulk Add) */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsBulkModalOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-850 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-200 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold border border-zinc-700/80 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm active:scale-95 group"
            title="Importar múltiplos clientes através de lista de texto"
          >
            <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
            <span>Importar em Lote</span>
          </button>

          {/* Botão + Cadastrar Cliente */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setClientToEdit(null);
              setIsAddClientModalOpen(true);
            }}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black text-xs font-black shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[3]" />
            <span>Cadastrar Cliente</span>
          </button>

          {/* Botão Atualizar Auditoria */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleRunAudit}
            disabled={isAuditing || clients.length === 0}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-card hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-200 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold border border-brand-border transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon ${isAuditing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>{isAuditing ? 'Auditando...' : 'Atualizar Auditoria'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Top 3 KPI Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {/* Card 1: Clientes Monitorados */}
        <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg flex items-center justify-between hover:border-brand-neon/40 transition-all group">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">
              Clientes Monitorados
            </span>
            <div className="text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
              {kpis.totalClients}
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 font-medium">
              Contas de Instagram ativas
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-700/80 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors shadow-inner">

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 2: Entregas Concluídas */}
        <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg flex items-center justify-between hover:border-emerald-500/40 transition-all group">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider block flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Entregas Concluídas
            </span>
            <div className="text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-tight flex items-baseline gap-2">
              {kpis.completedDeliveries}
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/20">

              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 font-medium">
              Postagens identificadas no feed

          </div>
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-400 shadow-inner">

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 3: Falhas de Postagem */}
        <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg flex items-center justify-between hover:border-rose-500/40 transition-all group">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-400 uppercase tracking-wider block flex items-center gap-1.5">

            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-rose-400 shadow-inner">
            <XCircle className="w-6 h-6" />

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Filter and Search Toolbar */}
      <div className="bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-md flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 flex-1">
          {/* Keyword Search */}
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-sm">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-500" />

                      <td className="py-4 px-5 whitespace-nowrap">

                          {/* Re-auditar apenas esse cliente */}
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleAuditSingle(row)}
                            disabled={isRowAuditing || isAuditing}
                            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800/80 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-brand-neon hover:text-white border border-zinc-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                            title="Verificar Instagram deste cliente agora"
                          >
                            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isRowAuditing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />

                          {/* Link do Perfil no Instagram */}
                          <a

        ) : (
          <div className="p-16 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-4">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-700/80 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-500 shadow-inner">

            <div className="space-y-1">
              <p className="text-base font-extrabold text-white">

              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
                {clients.length === 0
                  ? 'Cadastre os perfis dos seus clientes informando o nome e o link do Instagram para auditar entregas e postagens automaticamente.'
                  : 'Ajuste os filtros de status ou a busca para localizar os clientes cadastrados.'}
              </p>
            </div>
            {clients.length === 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setClientToEdit(null);

                }}
                className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black text-xs font-black shadow-lg shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[3]" />
                <span>Cadastrar Primeiro Cliente</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 5. Modal de Detalhes da Postagem / Copy */}
      {selectedAuditPost && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn"
          onClick={() => setSelectedAuditPost(null)}
        >
          <div
            className="bg-brand-sidebar border border-brand-border rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full shadow-2xl p-6 space-y-4 text-white animate-scaleUp"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-brand-border pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <InstagramAvatar
                  avatarUrl={selectedAuditPost.avatarUrl}
                  handle={selectedAuditPost.handle}
                  name={selectedAuditPost.clientName}
                  size="md"
                />
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-extrabold text-white text-sm">
                    {selectedAuditPost.clientName}
                  </h3>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                    <span className="text-zinc-400 text-xs font-mono">
                      {selectedAuditPost.handle}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-zinc-600">•</span>
                    {(() => {
                      const smName = selectedAuditPost.socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(selectedAuditPost.clientName);
                      const smStyle = getSocialMediaBadgeStyle(smName);
                      return (
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${smStyle}`}>
                          {smName}
                        </span>
                      );
                    })()}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border ${
                selectedAuditPost.status === 'OK'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/20'
                  : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border-rose-500/20'
              }`}>
                {selectedAuditPost.status === 'OK' ? 'Postado com Sucesso' : 'Sem Postagem'}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Status do Feed */}
            <div className="space-y-2 bg-brand-card border border-brand-border rounded-xl p-3.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-brand-neon tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Entrega no Feed
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-zinc-300 font-bold">
                  {selectedAuditPost.postTypeLabel} {selectedAuditPost.postTime && `• às ${selectedAuditPost.postTime}`}
                </span>
              </div>
              {selectedAuditPost.copy && (
                <div className="text-xs text-zinc-200 leading-relaxed max-h-40 overflow-y-auto whitespace-pre-line select-text bg-brand-bg/60 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-brand-border/60">
                  {selectedAuditPost.copy}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-brand-border flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedAuditPost(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold border border-zinc-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Fechar
              </button>
              {selectedAuditPost.postUrl && (
                <a
                  href={selectedAuditPost.postUrl}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noreferrer"
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black text-xs font-extrabold shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <span>Ver no Instagram</span>
                  <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </a>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 6. Modal de Cadastro / Edição de Cliente */}
      <AddSmmClientModal
        isOpen={isAddClientModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsAddClientModalOpen(false);
          setClientToEdit(null);
        }}
        onClientSaved={handleClientSaved}
        clientToEdit={clientToEdit}
      />

      {/* 7. Modal de Cadastro em Massa (Bulk Add) */}
      <AddSmmClientBulkModal
        isOpen={isBulkModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsBulkModalOpen(false)}
        onClientsSaved={handleBulkClientsSaved}
      />

      {/* 8. Modal de Configuração do Scraper */}
      <SmmSettingsModal
        isOpen={isSettingsModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsSettingsModalOpen(false)}
        onSaved={() => {
          setHasToken(Boolean(getApifyToken()));
          handleRunAudit();
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/SmmSettingsModal.tsx`

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { X, Key, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, ExternalLink, ShieldCheck, Sparkles, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { getApifyToken, saveApifyToken, scrapeInstagramPostsViaApify } from '../services/instagramScraperService';

interface SmmSettingsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: () => void;
}

export const SmmSettingsModal: React.FC<SmmSettingsModalProps> = React.memo(({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSaved
}) => {
  const [token, setToken] = useState('');
  const [isTesting, setIsTesting] = useState(false);
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<{ success: boolean; message: string } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setToken(getApifyToken());
      setTestResult(null);
      setIsTesting(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const handleTestToken = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!token.trim()) {
      setTestResult({ success: false, message: 'Informe um token para testar.' });
      return;
    }

    setIsTesting(true);
    setTestResult(null);

    try {
      // Test with a public instagram handle
      await scrapeInstagramPostsViaApify('instagram', token.trim(), 1);
      setTestResult({ success: true, message: 'Conexão com a API do Apify estabelecida com sucesso!' });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setTestResult({ 
        success: false, 
        message: err?.message || 'Falha ao conectar ao Apify. Verifique se o token é válido.' 
      });
    } finally {
      setIsTesting(false);
    }
  }, [token]);

  const handleSave = useCallback((e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    saveApifyToken(token.trim());
    onSaved();
    onClose();
  }, [token, onSaved, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div 
        className="bg-brand-sidebar border border-brand-border rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-scaleUp"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-5 border-b border-brand-border bg-brand-card/40">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon/10 border border-brand-neon/30 flex items-center justify-center text-brand-neon shadow-inner">
              <Key className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
                Configuração do Apify Scraper
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                Token para raspagem e auditoria automática do Instagram.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="p-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 block flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>Apify API Personal Token</span>
              <a
                href="https://console.apify.com/account/integrations"
                target="_blank"
                rel="noreferrer"
                className="text-[11px] text-brand-neon hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                <span>Obter Token Grátis</span>
                <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
              </a>
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              placeholder="apify_api_..."
              value={token}
              onChange={(e) => setToken(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-brand-bg border border-brand-border rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-neon transition-all"
            />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed">
              O token é salvo localmente no seu navegador e utilizado para executar o Actor <code className="text-brand-neon bg-brand-neon/10 px-1 py-0.5 rounded font-mono">apify/instagram-scraper</code> sem risco de bloqueio das suas contas pessoais.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Test connection alert */}
          {testResult && (
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-start gap-2 border ${
              testResult.success
                ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400'
                : 'bg-rose-500/10 border-rose-500/20 text-rose-400'
            }`}>
              {testResult.success ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              ) : (
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              )}
              <span>{testResult.message}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Action Buttons */}
          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-brand-border flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleTestToken}
              disabled={isTesting || !token.trim()}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold border border-zinc-700 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isTesting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-brand-neon" />
                  <span>Testando...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-neon" />
                  <span>Testar Token</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold border border-zinc-700 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancelar
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-neon hover:bg-brand-neonHover text-black font-extrabold text-xs shadow-md shadow-brand-neon/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                Salvar Configurações
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});
```

### Arquivo: `src/components/SortableHeader.tsx`

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp } from 'lucide-react';
import { SortState } from '../utils/tableSort';

interface SortableHeaderProps {
  columnKey: string;
  label: string;
  sortState: SortState;
  onSort: (columnKey: string) => void;
  onResizeStart?: (columnKey: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  width?: number;
  align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right';
  className?: string;
}

export const SortableHeader: React.FC<SortableHeaderProps> = React.memo(({
  columnKey,
  label,
  sortState,
  onSort,
  onResizeStart,
  width,
  align = 'left',
  className = ''
}) => {
  const isSorted = sortState.column === columnKey;
  const isDesc = sortState.direction === 'DESC';

  const alignClass = {
    left: 'justify-start text-left',
    center: 'justify-center text-center',
    right: 'justify-end text-right'
  }[align];

  return (
    <th
      onClick={() => onSort(columnKey)}
      style={width ? { width: `${width}px`, minWidth: `${width}px`, maxWidth: `${width}px` } : undefined}
      className={`relative py-3 px-3 select-none cursor-pointer group transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-800/60 overflow-hidden text-ellipsis whitespace-nowrap ${alignClass} ${className}`}
    >
      <div className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden ${alignClass}`}>
        <span
          className={`font-bold transition-colors truncate ${
            isSorted ? 'text-blue-400' : 'text-brand-textMuted group-hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          {label}
        </span>

        {/* Crisp SVG Arrow Indicator */}
        {isSorted && (
          <span className="text-blue-400 shrink-0 font-extrabold flex items-center">
            {isDesc ? (
              <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[2.5]" />
            ) : (
              <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[2.5]" />
            )}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Resizable Drag Handle (Right Edge Handle) */}
      {onResizeStart && (
        <div
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          onMouseDown={(e) => onResizeStart(columnKey, e)}
          className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-2 h-full cursor-col-resize hover:bg-blue-500/70 active:bg-blue-400 z-20 group-hover:bg-zinc-700/50 transition-colors"
          title="Arrastar para redimensionar largura da coluna"
        />
      )}
    </th>
  );
});

SortableHeader.displayName = 'SortableHeader';
```
