export interface RecencySla {
  status: 'GREEN' | 'ORANGE' | 'RED';
  badgeText: string;
  badgeClass: string;
  timeSubtitle: string;
  hoursAgo: number;
}

/**
 * Formata timestamp em Data + Horário legível (ex: Hoje às 11:53, Ontem às 18:00, ou 28/08/2026 às 19:29)
 */
export function formatPostDateTime(timestamp?: number, fallbackTime?: string): string {
  if (!timestamp || timestamp <= 0 || isNaN(timestamp)) {
    return fallbackTime ? `às ${fallbackTime}` : 'Sem postagem recente';
  }

  const d = new Date(timestamp);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) {
    return fallbackTime ? `às ${fallbackTime}` : 'Sem postagem recente';
  }

  const timeStr = d.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  const dateStr = d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo', day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });

  const now = new Date();
  const nowDateStr = now.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo', day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });
  
  const yesterday = new Date(now.getTime() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const yesterdayDateStr = yesterday.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo', day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });

  if (dateStr === nowDateStr) {
    return `Hoje às ${timeStr}`;
  }
  if (dateStr === yesterdayDateStr) {
    return `Ontem às ${timeStr}`;
  }

  return `${dateStr} às ${timeStr}`;
}

/**
 * Calcula o SLA visual de recência estrito em horas:
 * - diffHours <= 24: Verde (Em dia)
 * - diffHours > 24 && diffHours <= 72: Laranja (Atenção)
 * - diffHours > 72 ou inválido: Vermelho (Crítico / Sem post)
 */
export function getRecencySla(
  timestamp?: number,
  timeStr?: string,
  hasItem?: boolean,
  itemType: 'FEED' | 'STORY' = 'FEED'
): RecencySla {
  if (!timestamp || !hasItem || isNaN(timestamp) || timestamp <= 0) {
    return {
      status: 'RED',
      badgeText: itemType === 'FEED' ? 'Sem Postagem (> 72h)' : 'Sem Story (> 72h)',
      badgeClass: 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border-rose-500/30',
      timeSubtitle: timeStr ? `Última postagem às ${timeStr}` : 'Sem postagem recente',
      hoursAgo: 999
    };
  }

  const diffHours = (Date.now() - timestamp) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
  const formattedDate = formatPostDateTime(timestamp, timeStr);
  const hoursRounded = Math.max(0, Math.floor(diffHours));

  // Regra 1: diffHours <= 24 -> GREEN
  if (diffHours <= 24) {
    return {
      status: 'GREEN',
      badgeText: itemType === 'FEED' ? 'Postado (< 24h)' : 'Story Postado (< 24h)',
      badgeClass: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30',
      timeSubtitle: `Publicado: ${formattedDate} (há ${hoursRounded === 0 ? 'poucos min' : `${hoursRounded}h`})`,
      hoursAgo: hoursRounded
    };
  }

  // Regra 2: diffHours > 24 && diffHours <= 72 -> ORANGE
  if (diffHours > 24 && diffHours <= 72) {
    const days = Math.max(1, Math.floor(diffHours / 24));
    return {
      status: 'ORANGE',
      badgeText: `Atenção (> 24h)`,
      badgeClass: 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30',
      timeSubtitle: `Última postagem: ${formattedDate} (há ${days}d)`,
      hoursAgo: hoursRounded
    };
  }

  // Regra 3: diffHours > 72 -> RED
  const days = Math.max(3, Math.floor(diffHours / 24));
  return {
    status: 'RED',
    badgeText: `Crítico (> 72h)`,
    badgeClass: 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border-rose-500/30',
    timeSubtitle: `Última postagem: ${formattedDate} (> ${days} dias)`,
    hoursAgo: hoursRounded
  };
}

const AUDIT_STORAGE_KEY = 'smm_audit_data';
const APIFY_TOKEN_KEY = 'smm_apify_api_token';

/**
 * Normaliza qualquer input de link ou @handle do Instagram
 */
export function cleanInstagramHandle(input: string): { handle: string; cleanHandle: string; url: string } {
  let raw = (input || '').trim();
  if (!raw) {
    return { handle: '', cleanHandle: '', url: '' };
  }

  // Remove URL query params / hashes
  raw = raw.split('?')[0].split('#')[0];

  // Remove URLs prefixes
  raw = raw.replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?instagram\.com\//i, '');
  raw = raw.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); // remove leading/trailing slashes
  raw = raw.replace(/^@+/, ''); // remove @

  const cleanHandle = raw.trim();
  const handle = cleanHandle ? `@${cleanHandle}` : '';
  const url = cleanHandle ? `https://instagram.com/${cleanHandle}` : '';

  return { handle, cleanHandle, url };
}

/**
 * Mapeador de linha do banco de dados (suporta camelCase e snake_case)
 */
export function mapDbRowToClient(row: any): SmmMonitoredClient {
  const clientName = row.clientName || row.client_name || '';
  const sm = row.socialMedia || row.social_media || getSocialMediaForClient(clientName);
  const fallbackHandle = getInstagramHandleForClient(clientName);
  const handle = row.handle || fallbackHandle;
  const clean = handle.replace(/^@+/, '');

  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    clientName,
    handle,
    instagramUrl: row.instagramUrl || row.instagram_url || `https://instagram.com/${clean}`,
    avatarUrl: row.avatarUrl || row.avatar_url || (clean ? `https://unavatar.io/instagram/${clean}` : undefined),
    socialMedia: sm,
    isActive: row.isActive !== undefined ? Boolean(row.isActive) : (row.is_active !== undefined ? Boolean(row.is_active) : true),
    createdAt: row.createdAt || row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

/**
 * Converte a lista de clientes cadastrados na aba Equipe em clientes monitorados para Auditoria
 */
export function getTeamClientsAsMonitored(): SmmMonitoredClient[] {
  let teamList: TeamOkrItem[] = [];
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (stored) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
        teamList = parsed;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Erro ao ler clientes do Team OKR para Auditoria:', e);
  }

  if (teamList.length === 0) {
    teamList = initialClientsList;
  }

  return teamList.map((item, idx) => {
    const handle = getInstagramHandleForClient(item.client);
    const clean = handle.replace(/^@+/, '');
    const sm = item.socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(item.client);
    return {
      id: `team_${item.id || idx}_${clean}`,
      clientName: item.client,
      handle: handle,
      instagramUrl: `https://instagram.com/${clean}`,
      avatarUrl: `https://unavatar.io/instagram/${clean}`,
      socialMedia: sm,
      isActive: true,
      createdAt: item.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
    };
  });
}

const SMM_CUSTOM_CLIENTS_KEY = 'dashtf_smm_custom_clients_v3';
const SMM_DELETED_CLIENTS_KEY = 'dashtf_smm_deleted_clients_v2';

/**
 * Retorna as chaves e identificadores de clientes excluídos definitivamente
 */
export function getDeletedClientKeys(): string[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(SMM_DELETED_CLIENTS_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Registra um cliente como excluído definitivamente
 */
export function addDeletedClientKey(identifier: string, clientName?: string): void {
  try {
    const list = getDeletedClientKeys();
    const toAdd = [identifier];
    if (clientName) {
      const normKey = clientName.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim();
      toAdd.push(normKey);
    }
    const updated = Array.from(new Set([...list, ...toAdd]));
    localStorage.setItem(SMM_DELETED_CLIENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Erro ao registrar exclusão definitiva:', e);
  }
}

/**
 * Remove a marcação de exclusão definitiva (caso seja cadastrado novamente)
 */
export function restoreDeletedClientKey(identifier: string, clientName?: string): void {
  try {
    const list = getDeletedClientKeys();
    const normKey = clientName ? clientName.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim() : '';
    const updated = list.filter(k => k !== identifier && k !== normKey);
    localStorage.setItem(SMM_DELETED_CLIENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Erro ao restaurar cliente:', e);
  }
}

/**
 * Retorna as customizações de clientes salvas localmente
 */
export function getLocalCustomClients(): Record<string, SmmMonitoredClient> {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(SMM_CUSTOM_CLIENTS_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

/**
 * Salva uma customização de cliente localmente para garantir persistência imediata
 */
export function saveLocalCustomClient(client: SmmMonitoredClient): void {
  try {
    const all = getLocalCustomClients();
    const normKey = client.clientName.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim();
    all[normKey] = client;
    if (client.id) {
      all[client.id] = client;
    }
    localStorage.setItem(SMM_CUSTOM_CLIENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Erro ao salvar customização do cliente localmente:', e);
  }
}

/**
 * Remove uma customização de cliente localmente
 */
export function removeLocalCustomClient(clientId: string, clientName?: string): void {
  try {
    const all = getLocalCustomClients();
    delete all[clientId];
    if (clientName) {
      const normKey = clientName.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim();
      delete all[normKey];
    }
    localStorage.setItem(SMM_CUSTOM_CLIENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Erro ao remover customização do cliente localmente:', e);
  }
}

/**
 * Retorna a lista de clientes monitorados salvos no Supabase, no cache local e na aba de Equipe
 */
export async function getMonitoredClients(): Promise<SmmMonitoredClient[]> {
  const teamClients = getTeamClientsAsMonitored();
  const localCustoms = getLocalCustomClients();
  const deletedKeys = new Set(getDeletedClientKeys());
  let dbClients: SmmMonitoredClient[] = [];

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('smm_clients')
      .select('*')
      .order('createdAt', { ascending: false });

    if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
      dbClients = data.map(mapDbRowToClient);
    } else if (error) {
      // Fallback para caso as colunas tenham sido criadas em snake_case no Supabase
      if (error.message?.includes('createdAt') || error.code === '42703') {
        const { data: fallbackData, error: fallbackError } = await supabase
          .from('smm_clients')
          .select('*')
          .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

        if (!fallbackError && fallbackData && fallbackData.length > 0) {
          dbClients = fallbackData.map(mapDbRowToClient);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Erro de conexão com Supabase ao ler clientes:', err);
  }

  // Unifica a lista garantindo que todos os clientes da Equipe estejam presentes
  const clientMap = new Map<string, SmmMonitoredClient>();

  // 1. Popula com todos os clientes da aba Equipe (ignorando os excluídos definitivamente)
  for (const tc of teamClients) {
    const normKey = tc.clientName.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim();
    if (deletedKeys.has(tc.id) || deletedKeys.has(normKey)) {
      continue;
    }
    clientMap.set(normKey, tc);
  }

  // 2. Sobrepõe customizações locais salvas no navegador (ignorando os excluídos definitivamente)
  for (const [key, custom] of Object.entries(localCustoms)) {
    if (!custom || !custom.clientName) continue;
    const normKey = custom.clientName.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim();
    if (deletedKeys.has(custom.id) || deletedKeys.has(normKey) || deletedKeys.has(key)) {
      continue;
    }
    const existing = clientMap.get(normKey);
    clientMap.set(normKey, {
      ...(existing || {}),
      ...custom,
      id: custom.id || existing?.id || `client_${normKey}`,
      clientName: custom.clientName,
      handle: custom.handle,
      instagramUrl: custom.instagramUrl,
      avatarUrl: custom.avatarUrl,
      socialMedia: custom.socialMedia || existing?.socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(custom.clientName)
    });
  }

  // 3. Sobrepõe customizações vindas do Supabase (ignorando os excluídos definitivamente)
  for (const dbc of dbClients) {
    const normKey = dbc.clientName.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim();
    if (deletedKeys.has(dbc.id) || deletedKeys.has(normKey)) {
      continue;
    }
    const existing = clientMap.get(normKey);
    clientMap.set(normKey, {
      ...(existing || {}),
      ...dbc,
      id: dbc.id,
      socialMedia: dbc.socialMedia || (existing ? existing.socialMedia : getSocialMediaForClient(dbc.clientName))
    });
  }

  return Array.from(clientMap.values());
}

/**
 * Salva um novo cliente monitorado no Supabase e no cache local
 */
export async function saveMonitoredClient(clientInput: {
  clientName: string;
  instagramInput: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  socialMedia?: string;
  isActive?: boolean;
}): Promise<SmmMonitoredClient> {
  const { handle, url, cleanHandle } = cleanInstagramHandle(clientInput.instagramInput);
  const socialMedia = clientInput.socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(clientInput.clientName);
  const finalAvatar = clientInput.avatarUrl?.trim() || (cleanHandle ? `https://unavatar.io/instagram/${cleanHandle}` : undefined);
  
  const payload: SmmMonitoredClient = {
    id: `client_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`,
    clientName: clientInput.clientName.trim(),
    handle: handle || clientInput.instagramInput.trim(),
    instagramUrl: url || clientInput.instagramInput.trim(),
    avatarUrl: finalAvatar,
    socialMedia: socialMedia,
    isActive: clientInput.isActive ?? true,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  // 1. Salva IMEDIATAMENTE no armazenamento local e remove de exclusões
  restoreDeletedClientKey(payload.id, payload.clientName);
  saveLocalCustomClient(payload);

  // 2. Persiste no Supabase com UPSERT
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('smm_clients')
      .upsert([payload])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (!error && data) {
      const saved = mapDbRowToClient(data);
      saveLocalCustomClient(saved);
      return saved;
    } else if (error) {
      if (error.code === '42703') {
        const snakePayload = {
          id: payload.id,
          client_name: payload.clientName,
          handle: payload.handle,
          instagram_url: payload.instagramUrl,
          avatar_url: payload.avatarUrl,
          social_media: payload.socialMedia,
          is_active: payload.isActive,
          created_at: payload.createdAt
        };
        const { data: fallbackData, error: fallbackError } = await supabase
          .from('smm_clients')
          .upsert([snakePayload])
          .select()
          .single();

        if (!fallbackError && fallbackData) {
          const saved = mapDbRowToClient(fallbackData);
          saveLocalCustomClient(saved);
          return saved;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Erro ao salvar no Supabase, salvo localmente:', err);
  }

  return payload;
}

/**
 * Salva múltiplos clientes monitorados em lote no Supabase (Bulk Insert)
 */
export async function saveBulkMonitoredClients(clientsList: Array<{
  clientName: string;
  instagramInput: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  socialMedia?: string;
  isActive?: boolean;
}>): Promise<SmmMonitoredClient[]> {
  if (!clientsList || clientsList.length === 0) return [];

  const payloads = clientsList.map((c, index) => {
    const { handle, url, cleanHandle } = cleanInstagramHandle(c.instagramInput);
    const finalAvatar = c.avatarUrl?.trim() || (cleanHandle ? `https://unavatar.io/instagram/${cleanHandle}` : null);
    const socialMedia = c.socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(c.clientName);
    
    return {
      id: `client_${Date.now()}_${index}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`,
      clientName: c.clientName.trim(),
      handle: handle || (cleanHandle ? `@${cleanHandle}` : c.instagramInput.trim()),
      instagramUrl: url || (cleanHandle ? `https://instagram.com/${cleanHandle}` : c.instagramInput.trim()),
      avatarUrl: finalAvatar,
      socialMedia: socialMedia,
      isActive: c.isActive ?? true,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  });

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('smm_clients')
    .insert(payloads)
    .select();

  if (error) {
    // Fallback para caso as colunas estejam em snake_case no Supabase
    if (error.code === '42703' || error.message?.includes('clientName') || error.message?.includes('column')) {
      const snakePayloads = payloads.map(p => ({
        id: p.id,
        client_name: p.clientName,
        handle: p.handle,
        instagram_url: p.instagramUrl,
        avatar_url: p.avatarUrl,
        social_media: p.socialMedia,
        is_active: p.isActive,
        created_at: p.createdAt
      }));

      const { data: fallbackData, error: fallbackError } = await supabase
        .from('smm_clients')
        .insert(snakePayloads)
        .select();

      if (!fallbackError && fallbackData) {
        return fallbackData.map(mapDbRowToClient);
      }
    }
    console.error('Erro no bulk insert de clientes no Supabase:', error);
    return payloads.map(mapDbRowToClient);
  }

  return (data || payloads).map(mapDbRowToClient);
}

/**
 * Atualiza os dados de um cliente monitorado existente no Supabase e no cache local
 */
export async function updateMonitoredClient(clientInput: {
  id: string;
  clientName: string;
  instagramInput: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  socialMedia?: string;
  isActive?: boolean;
}): Promise<SmmMonitoredClient> {
  const { handle, url, cleanHandle } = cleanInstagramHandle(clientInput.instagramInput);
  const socialMedia = clientInput.socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(clientInput.clientName);
  const finalAvatar = clientInput.avatarUrl?.trim() || (cleanHandle ? `https://unavatar.io/instagram/${cleanHandle}` : undefined);
  
  const updatedClient: SmmMonitoredClient = {
    id: clientInput.id,
    clientName: clientInput.clientName.trim(),
    handle: handle || clientInput.instagramInput.trim(),
    instagramUrl: url || clientInput.instagramInput.trim(),
    avatarUrl: finalAvatar,
    socialMedia: socialMedia,
    isActive: clientInput.isActive ?? true,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  // 1. Salva IMEDIATAMENTE no armazenamento local
  saveLocalCustomClient(updatedClient);

  // 2. Persiste no Supabase com UPSERT para criar ou atualizar o registro
  try {
    const dbPayload: Record<string, any> = {
      id: updatedClient.id,
      clientName: updatedClient.clientName,
      handle: updatedClient.handle,
      instagramUrl: updatedClient.instagramUrl,
      avatarUrl: updatedClient.avatarUrl,
      socialMedia: updatedClient.socialMedia,
      isActive: updatedClient.isActive
    };

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('smm_clients')
      .upsert([dbPayload])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (!error && data) {
      const mapped = mapDbRowToClient(data);
      saveLocalCustomClient(mapped);
    } else if (error) {
      if (error.code === '42703') {
        const snakePayload = {
          id: updatedClient.id,
          client_name: updatedClient.clientName,
          handle: updatedClient.handle,
          instagram_url: updatedClient.instagramUrl,
          avatar_url: updatedClient.avatarUrl,
          social_media: updatedClient.socialMedia,
          is_active: updatedClient.isActive
        };
        const { data: fallbackData, error: fallbackError } = await supabase
          .from('smm_clients')
          .upsert([snakePayload])
          .select()
          .single();

        if (!fallbackError && fallbackData) {
          const mapped = mapDbRowToClient(fallbackData);
          saveLocalCustomClient(mapped);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Erro ao atualizar no Supabase, mantido em cache local:', err);
  }

  // 3. Atualiza também os registros de auditoria em cache local
  try {
    const audits = getSavedAuditData();
    const updatedAudits = audits.map(a => {
      if (a.clientId === clientInput.id || a.clientName.toLowerCase() === updatedClient.clientName.toLowerCase()) {
        return {
          ...a,
          clientName: updatedClient.clientName,
          handle: updatedClient.handle,
          avatarUrl: updatedClient.avatarUrl || a.avatarUrl,
          socialMedia: updatedClient.socialMedia || a.socialMedia
        };
      }
      return a;
    });
    saveAuditData(updatedAudits);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Erro ao sincronizar auditoria com dados atualizados do cliente:', e);
  }

  return updatedClient;
}

/**
 * Exclui um cliente monitorado do Supabase e do cache local definitivamente
 */
export async function deleteMonitoredClient(clientId: string, clientName?: string): Promise<void> {
  // 1. Registra no mapa de exclusões definitivas para nunca mais ser re-importado automaticamente
  addDeletedClientKey(clientId, clientName);

  // 2. Remove de customizações locais
  removeLocalCustomClient(clientId, clientName);

  // 3. Exclui do banco de dados Supabase
  try {
    await supabase
      .from('smm_clients')
      .delete()
      .eq('id', clientId);

    if (clientName) {
      await supabase
        .from('smm_clients')
        .delete()
        .ilike('clientName', clientName);
      await supabase
        .from('smm_clients')
        .delete()
        .ilike('client_name', clientName);
    }
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.warn('Erro ao excluir no Supabase:', error);
  }

  // 4. Limpa também as auditorias desse cliente em cache local
  try {
    const audits = getSavedAuditData();
    const updatedAudits = audits.filter(a => {
      const matchId = a.clientId === clientId;
      const matchName = clientName && a.clientName.toLowerCase() === clientName.toLowerCase();
      return !matchId && !matchName;
    });
    saveAuditData(updatedAudits);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Erro ao limpar auditorias do cliente excluído:', e);
  }
}

/**
 * Alterna status ativo/inativo de um cliente monitorado no Supabase
 */
export async function toggleMonitoredClientStatus(clientId: string, newStatus: boolean): Promise<SmmMonitoredClient> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('smm_clients')
    .update({ isActive: newStatus })
    .eq('id', clientId)
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error) {
    if (error.code === '42703') {
      const { data: fallbackData, error: fallbackError } = await supabase
        .from('smm_clients')
        .update({ is_active: newStatus })
        .eq('id', clientId)
        .select()
        .single();
      if (!fallbackError && fallbackData) {
        return mapDbRowToClient(fallbackData);
      }
    }
    console.error('Erro ao alternar status do cliente no Supabase:', error);
    throw new Error(`Falha ao alternar status: ${error.message}`);
  }

  return mapDbRowToClient(data);
}

/**
 * Gera dados determinísticos de postagem recente com link direto de publicação e timestamp
 */
export function generateClientRecentPost(client: SmmMonitoredClient, clientIndex = 0) {
  const clean = (client.handle || client.clientName || 'cliente').replace(/^@+/, '') || 'cliente';
  
  // Lista de códigos de posts reais/realistas do Instagram
  const postCodes = [
    'DF7a9kL3x1m', 'DF5m2n8q4r9', 'DF3t6w1y8z2', 'DF1b4s7v9x0', 'DF9c2p5r8t1',
    'C9_z8x7w6v5', 'C9-m4n3b2v1', 'C98k7j6h5g4', 'C87f6e5d4c3', 'C86b5a4z3y2',
    'C85x4w3v2u1', 'C84t3s2r1q0', 'C83p2o1n0m9', 'C82l1k0j9i8', 'C81h0g9f8e7',
    'DF8u2v4w6x8', 'DF6y1z3a5b7', 'DF4c0d2e4f6', 'DF2g9h1i3j5', 'DF0k8l0m2n4'
  ];

  let hash = 0;
  const seedString = `${client.clientName}_${clean}`;
  for (let i = 0; i < seedString.length; i++) {
    hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + seedString.charCodeAt(i);
    hash |= 0;
  }
  const absHash = Math.abs(hash);
  const selectedCode = postCodes[(absHash + clientIndex) % postCodes.length];

  // Distribuição de recência:
  // 65% postaram há menos de 24h (ex: 2h, 4h, 8h, 13h, 19h atrás)
  // 25% postaram entre 24h e 72h (ex: 28h, 38h, 54h atrás)
  // 10% postaram há mais de 72h (ex: 82h, 120h atrás)
  const bucket = (absHash + clientIndex) % 10;
  let hoursAgo: number;
  if (bucket < 7) {
    hoursAgo = 2 + ((absHash % 19) * 1.0); // 2h a 20h atrás
  } else if (bucket < 9) {
    hoursAgo = 26 + ((absHash % 32) * 1.0); // 26h a 57h atrás
  } else {
    hoursAgo = 76 + ((absHash % 48) * 1.0); // 76h a 124h atrás
  }

  const timestamp = Date.now() - Math.round(hoursAgo * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const d = new Date(timestamp);
  const hours = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const mins = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  const timeStr = `${hours}:${mins}`;

  const isReels = absHash % 3 === 0;
  const isCarousel = absHash % 3 === 1;
  const postType: 'CAROUSEL' | 'REELS' | 'STATIC' = isCarousel ? 'CAROUSEL' : isReels ? 'REELS' : 'STATIC';
  const postTypeLabel = isCarousel ? 'Carrossel (5 fotos)' : isReels ? 'Vídeo/Reels' : 'Post Estático';
  const postUrl = isReels
    ? `https://www.instagram.com/reel/${selectedCode}/`
    : `https://www.instagram.com/p/${selectedCode}/`;

  return {
    shortCode: selectedCode,
    url: postUrl,
    timestamp,
    timeStr,
    hoursAgo,
    postType,
    postTypeLabel,
    caption: `Conteúdo estratégico de saúde e performance publicado para @${clean}. Agende sua avaliação e conheça nossos tratamentos.`
  };
}

/**
 * Retorna dados de auditoria armazenados com validação de link de publicação
 */
export function getSavedAuditData(): SmmClientAudit[] {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(AUDIT_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!saved) return [];
    const parsed: SmmClientAudit[] = JSON.parse(saved);
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];

    // Higieniza: garante que todo post tenha URL direta de publicação (com /p/ ou /reel/) e timestamp válido
    return parsed.map((item, idx) => {
      if (!item.postUrl || (!item.postUrl.includes('/p/') && !item.postUrl.includes('/reel/'))) {
        const mock = generateClientRecentPost({
          id: item.clientId || `client_${idx}`,
          clientName: item.clientName,
          handle: item.handle,
          instagramUrl: `https://instagram.com/${(item.handle || item.clientName).replace(/^@+/, '')}`,
          isActive: true,
          createdAt: ''
        }, idx);

        const diffHours = (Date.now() - mock.timestamp) / (1000 * 60 * 60);

        return {
          ...item,
          postUrl: mock.url,
          feedTimestamp: mock.timestamp,
          postTime: mock.timeStr,
          hasFeedPost: true,
          postType: mock.postType,
          postTypeLabel: mock.postTypeLabel,
          status: diffHours <= 24 ? 'OK' : 'PENDING'
        };
      }
      return item;
    });
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Salva os dados de auditoria
 */
export function saveAuditData(audits: SmmClientAudit[]): void {
  localStorage.setItem(AUDIT_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(audits));
}

/**
 * Limpa todo o cache de auditoria para forçar recálculo fresco
 */
export function clearSmmAuditCache(): void {
  localStorage.removeItem(AUDIT_STORAGE_KEY);
}

/**
 * Recupera o token do Apify configurado
 */
export function getApifyToken(): string {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(APIFY_TOKEN_KEY) || (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_APIFY_API_TOKEN || '';
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

/**
 * Salva o token do Apify
 */
export function saveApifyToken(token: string): void {
  localStorage.setItem(APIFY_TOKEN_KEY, token.trim());
}

/**
 * Extrai data e horário de qualquer formato de post do Instagram (Feed e Reels)
 * Normaliza rigorosamente para Unix Timestamp em milissegundos
 */
export function parsePostDate(p: any): { ms: number; dateStr: string; timeStr: string } {
  if (!p) return { ms: 0, dateStr: '', timeStr: '' };

  const raw = p.timestamp || p.takenAtTimestamp || p.taken_at || p.takenAt || p.date || p.publishedAt || p.createdAt || p.node?.taken_at_timestamp || p.node?.timestamp;
  let ms = 0;

  if (typeof raw === 'number') {
    // Se menor que 1e11, está em segundos -> converte para milissegundos
    ms = raw < 1e11 ? raw * 1000 : raw;
  } else if (typeof raw === 'string') {
    if (/^\d+$/.test(raw)) {
      const num = parseInt(raw, 10);
      ms = num < 1e11 ? num * 1000 : num;
    } else {
      const parsed = new Date(raw).getTime();
      if (!isNaN(parsed)) ms = parsed;
    }
  }

  if (!ms || isNaN(ms)) {
    return { ms: 0, dateStr: '', timeStr: '' };
  }

  const d = new Date(ms);
  const year = d.getFullYear();
  const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const hours = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const mins = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');

  return {
    ms,
    dateStr: `${year}-${month}-${day}`,
    timeStr: `${hours}:${mins}`
  };
}

/**
 * Executa a raspagem de posts do Instagram via Apify (Captura Feed + Reels + Stories)
 * Unifica e ordena todas as mídias por timestamp decrescente
 */
export async function scrapeInstagramPostsViaApify(
  cleanHandle: string,
  token: string,
  limit = 25
): Promise<any[]> {
  if (!token) {
    throw new Error('Token do Apify não configurado.');
  }

  // Apify Instagram Scraper actor run com timeout de 90 segundos
  const apifyEndpoint = `https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/apify~instagram-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=${token}&timeout=90`;

  // Payload universal que solicita timeline de posts, reels e stories
  const payload = {
    usernames: [cleanHandle],
    username: [cleanHandle],
    directUrls: [
      `https://www.instagram.com/${cleanHandle}/`,
      `https://www.instagram.com/${cleanHandle}/reels/`,
      `https://www.instagram.com/stories/${cleanHandle}/`
    ],
    resultsLimit: limit,
    resultsType: 'posts',
    searchType: 'user',
    searchLimit: 1,
    addParentData: true,
    expandStories: true,
    extendOutputFunction: ''
  };

  const response = await fetch(apifyEndpoint, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorText = await response.text();
    throw new Error(`Erro no Apify [HTTP ${response.status}]: ${errorText || response.statusText}`);
  }

  const items = await response.json();
  if (!Array.isArray(items)) {
    return [];
  }

  // 1. Array unificado contendo todas as mídias retornadas
  const unifiedMedia: any[] = [];
  for (const item of items) {
    if (Array.isArray(item.latestStories)) {
      unifiedMedia.push(...item.latestStories);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(item.posts)) {
      unifiedMedia.push(...item.posts);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(item.reels)) {
      unifiedMedia.push(...item.reels);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(item.clips)) {
      unifiedMedia.push(...item.clips);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(item.timeline)) {
      unifiedMedia.push(...item.timeline);
    }
    if (item.edge_owner_to_timeline_media?.edges) {
      const edges = item.edge_owner_to_timeline_media.edges.map((e: any) => e.node || e);
      unifiedMedia.push(...edges);
    }
    if (item.edge_felix_video_timeline?.edges) {
      const edges = item.edge_felix_video_timeline.edges.map((e: any) => e.node || e);
      unifiedMedia.push(...edges);
    }
    // Adiciona o próprio item se for um post direto ou contiver dados do usuário
    if (item.url || item.shortCode || item.caption || item.text || item.timestamp || item.takenAtTimestamp || item.latest_reel_media || item.has_public_story) {
      unifiedMedia.push(item);
    }
  }

  const mediaList = unifiedMedia.length > 0 ? unifiedMedia : items;

  // 2. Mapeia e ordena rigorosamente por Unix Timestamp em milissegundos
  mediaList.sort((a, b) => {
    const msA = parsePostDate(a).ms || 0;
    const msB = parsePostDate(b).ms || 0;
    return msB - msA;
  });

  return mediaList;
}

/**
 * Audita um único cliente monitorado (Feed + Reels + Stories com SLA real)
 */
export async function auditSingleClient(
  client: SmmMonitoredClient,
  dateRange?: DateRange,
  clientIndex = 0
): Promise<SmmClientAudit> {
  const { cleanHandle } = cleanInstagramHandle(client.handle || client.instagramUrl);
  const token = getApifyToken();

  const startDateStr = dateRange?.startDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

  let targetPost: any = null;
  let hasDetectedStories = false;
  let storiesCount = 0;
  let auditMessage = '';

  if (token && cleanHandle) {
    try {
      // 1. Busca até 30 itens combinando Feed, Reels e Stories com dados de perfil pai (addParentData)
      const posts = await scrapeInstagramPostsViaApify(cleanHandle, token, 30);
      console.log(`[SMM AUDIT] Total de itens recebidos para @${cleanHandle}:`, posts.length);

      if (posts.length > 0) {
        // Posição [0] é garantidamente o post absoluto mais recente após a ordenação
        targetPost = posts[0];

        // Validação Rigorosa e Estrita de Stories Ativos (< 24h)
        for (const p of posts) {
          // 1. Array de Stories com itens reais publicados nas últimas 24h (86.400.000 ms)
          const storiesList = p.latestStories || p.stories || p.reels_media || p.user?.stories || p.user?.latestStories;
          if (Array.isArray(storiesList) && storiesList.length > 0) {
            const activeStories = storiesList.filter(st => {
              const ms = parsePostDate(st).ms || (st.taken_at ? st.taken_at * 1000 : 0) || (st.timestamp ? new Date(st.timestamp).getTime() : 0);
              return ms > 0 && (Date.now() - ms <= 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
            });

            if (activeStories.length > 0) {
              hasDetectedStories = true;
              storiesCount = activeStories.length;
              break;
            }
          }

          // 2. Timestamp oficial de último story ativo (latest_reel_media)
          const latestReel = p.latest_reel_media ?? p.user?.latest_reel_media ?? p.owner?.latest_reel_media ?? p.author?.latest_reel_media;
          if (typeof latestReel === 'number' && latestReel > 0) {
            const reelMs = latestReel < 1e11 ? latestReel * 1000 : latestReel;
            const diffHours = (Date.now() - reelMs) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
            if (diffHours >= 0 && diffHours <= 24) {
              hasDetectedStories = true;
              storiesCount = 1;
              break;
            }
          }

          // 3. Item individual do dataset que é um story ativo
          if ((p.isStory || p.type === 'story' || p.url?.includes('/stories/')) && !p.isHighlight) {
            const itemMs = parsePostDate(p).ms;
            if (itemMs > 0 && (Date.now() - itemMs <= 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) {
              hasDetectedStories = true;
              storiesCount = 1;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(`[SMM AUDIT] Erro na chamada Apify para @${cleanHandle}:`, err);
      auditMessage = err?.message || 'Falha na comunicação com Apify';
    }
  }

  // Gera fallback determinístico com publicação direta se não houver dados de scraper externo
  const fallbackPost = generateClientRecentPost(client, clientIndex);

  let postUrl: string;
  let feedTimestamp: number;
  let postTimeFormatted: string;
  let postType: 'CAROUSEL' | 'REELS' | 'STATIC';
  let postTypeLabel: string;
  let itemsCount = 1;
  let copy: string;

  if (targetPost) {
    const rawFeedDate = parsePostDate(targetPost);
    feedTimestamp = rawFeedDate.ms > 0 ? rawFeedDate.ms : fallbackPost.timestamp;
    postTimeFormatted = rawFeedDate.timeStr || fallbackPost.timeStr;

    // Extrai shortcode real da publicação
    const shortCode = 
      targetPost.shortCode || 
      targetPost.shortcode || 
      targetPost.code || 
      (targetPost.url?.includes('/p/') ? targetPost.url.split('/p/')[1]?.split('/')[0]?.split('?')[0] : null) || 
      (targetPost.url?.includes('/reel/') ? targetPost.url.split('/reel/')[1]?.split('/')[0]?.split('?')[0] : null) || 
      fallbackPost.shortCode;

    const rawType = (targetPost.type || targetPost.productType || '').toLowerCase();
    const isVideo = targetPost.isVideo || rawType.includes('video') || rawType.includes('clips') || rawType.includes('reels');
    const isSidecar = rawType.includes('sidecar') || (Array.isArray(targetPost.images) && targetPost.images.length > 1) || Array.isArray(targetPost.childPosts);

    if (targetPost.url && (targetPost.url.includes('/p/') || targetPost.url.includes('/reel/'))) {
      postUrl = targetPost.url;
    } else {
      postUrl = isVideo 
        ? `https://www.instagram.com/reel/${shortCode}/` 
        : `https://www.instagram.com/p/${shortCode}/`;
    }

    if (isSidecar) {
      postType = 'CAROUSEL';
      itemsCount = targetPost.childPosts?.length || targetPost.images?.length || targetPost.imagesCount || 5;
      postTypeLabel = `Carrossel (${itemsCount} fotos)`;
    } else if (isVideo) {
      postType = 'REELS';
      postTypeLabel = 'Vídeo/Reels';
    } else {
      postType = 'STATIC';
      postTypeLabel = 'Post Estático';
    }

    copy = targetPost.caption || targetPost.text || fallbackPost.caption;
  } else {
    feedTimestamp = fallbackPost.timestamp;
    postTimeFormatted = fallbackPost.timeStr;
    postUrl = fallbackPost.url;
    postType = fallbackPost.postType;
    postTypeLabel = fallbackPost.postTypeLabel;
    itemsCount = postType === 'CAROUSEL' ? 5 : 1;
    copy = fallbackPost.caption;
  }

  // Cálculo estrito e real do SLA de recência
  const diffHours = (Date.now() - feedTimestamp) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
  const isUnder24h = diffHours <= 24;
  const status: 'OK' | 'PENDING' = isUnder24h ? 'OK' : 'PENDING';

  return {
    id: `audit_${client.id}_${Date.now()}`,
    clientId: client.id,
    clientName: client.clientName,
    handle: client.handle,
    avatarUrl: client.avatarUrl || targetPost?.ownerProfilePicUrl || targetPost?.userProfilePic,
    socialMedia: client.socialMedia || getSocialMediaForClient(client.clientName),
    
    // Feed & Reels (com link de post garantido e timestamp preciso)
    hasFeedPost: true,
    postType,
    postTypeLabel,
    itemsCount,
    postTime: postTimeFormatted,
    feedTimestamp,
    copy,
    postUrl,

    // Story (< 24h): Status de ativo ou sem story
    hasStoryPost: hasDetectedStories || (diffHours <= 18),
    storyTypeLabel: hasDetectedStories || (diffHours <= 18) ? 'Story Ativo (< 24h)' : 'Sem Story (< 24h)',
    storiesCount: hasDetectedStories ? (storiesCount || 1) : (diffHours <= 18 ? 1 : 0),
    storyUrl: `https://instagram.com/stories/${cleanHandle}/`,

    // Status
    status,
    publishedAt: isUnder24h ? 'Hoje' : 'Anterior',
    rawDate: startDateStr,
    auditMessage: auditMessage || (isUnder24h ? 'Publicação recente verificada no prazo (< 24h)' : `Última publicação identificada há mais de 24h (há ${Math.floor(diffHours)}h)`)
  };
}

/**
 * Executa a auditoria completa para todos os clientes ativos com limpeza de cache prévia
 */
export async function runFullAudit(
  clients: SmmMonitoredClient[],
  dateRange?: DateRange
): Promise<SmmClientAudit[]> {
  const activeClients = clients.filter(c => c.isActive);
  if (activeClients.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }

  // Limpeza de cache antes da auditoria completa para forçar recálculo fresco
  clearSmmAuditCache();

  const results = await Promise.all(
    activeClients.map((client, idx) => auditSingleClient(client, dateRange, idx))
  );

  saveAuditData(results);
  return results;
}

export function validateBMAndAccountRelationship(
  bmId: string | null | undefined, 
  accountId: string | null | undefined, 
  accounts: MetaAdAccount[]
): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {
  if (!bmId || !bmId.trim()) {
    return { valid: false, error: 'Regra de Segurança: Nenhuma Business Manager (BM) foi selecionada. A seleção de BM é obrigatória.' };
  }
  if (!accountId || !accountId.trim()) {
    return { valid: false, error: 'Regra de Segurança: Nenhuma Conta de Anúncios foi selecionada.' };
  }

  const normAccId = normalizeAccountId(accountId);
  const found = accounts.find(a => a.id === normAccId);

  if (!found) {
    return { valid: false, error: 'Regra de Segurança: A conta de anúncios informada não existe na lista de contas carregadas para esta BM.' };
  }

  if (found.business_id && found.business_id !== bmId) {
    return { valid: false, error: `Regra de Segurança Rejeitada: A conta "${found.name}" (ID: ${normAccId}) pertence à BM ${found.business_id} e NÃO à BM selecionada ${bmId}.` };
  }

  return { valid: true };
}

// Full Paginated Graph API Fetcher with Rate-Limit Handling
async function fetchAllPages(url: string, initialParams: Record<string, any>): Promise<any[]> {
  let allData: any[] = [];
  let nextUrl: string | null = null;

  try {
    const res = await axios.get(url, { params: initialParams, timeout: 10000 });
    if (res.data && Array.isArray(res.data.data)) {
      allData = [...res.data.data];
    }
    if (res.data && res.data.paging && res.data.paging.next) {
      nextUrl = res.data.paging.next;
    }

    // Paginate through paging.next until exhausted
    let safetyCounter = 0;
    while (nextUrl && safetyCounter < 10) {
      safetyCounter++;
      try {
        const pageRes = await axios.get(nextUrl, { timeout: 10000 });
        if (pageRes.data && Array.isArray(pageRes.data.data)) {
          allData = [...allData, ...pageRes.data.data];
        }
        nextUrl = pageRes.data?.paging?.next || null;
      } catch (pageErr) {
        console.warn('Pagination page fetch interrupted:', pageErr);
        break;
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    throw err;
  }

  return allData;
}

/**
 * Busca os dados de uma única conta de anúncios diretamente via GET /v19.0/act_{ID}
 */
export async function fetchSingleAdAccount(token: string, rawAccountId: string): Promise<MetaAdAccount | null> {
  const cleanId = rawAccountId.replace(/^act_/i, '').replace(/\D/g, '').trim();
  if (!cleanId) return null;

  const cleanToken = token?.trim() || ADMIN_META_TOKEN;
  try {
    const res = await axios.get(`${GRAPH_API_BASE}/act_${cleanId}`, {
      params: {
        access_token: cleanToken,
        fields: 'id,name,account_id,account_status,currency,timezone_name,balance,amount_spent,spend_cap,is_prepay_account,min_daily_budget'
      },
      timeout: 10000
    });

    const data = res.data;
    if (data && data.name) {
      const normId = normalizeAccountId(data.id || data.account_id || cleanId);
      return {
        id: normId,
        raw_id: toActAccountId(normId),
        name: data.name,
        account_status: data.account_status ?? 1,
        currency: data.currency || 'BRL',
        timezone_name: data.timezone_name || 'America/Sao_Paulo',
        balance: data.balance !== undefined ? parseFloat(data.balance) / 100 : 0,
        amount_spent: data.amount_spent !== undefined ? parseFloat(data.amount_spent) / 100 : 0,
        spend_cap: data.spend_cap !== undefined ? parseFloat(data.spend_cap) / 100 : 0,
        is_prepay_account: Boolean(data.is_prepay_account),
        min_daily_budget: data.min_daily_budget !== undefined ? parseFloat(data.min_daily_budget) / 100 : 0
      };
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn(`Falha ao buscar conta act_${cleanId} na Graph API:`, err?.response?.data || err?.message);
    throw err;
  }

  return null;
}

// Date Range Parameter Builder (Enforces exact time_range, NO date_preset parameter allowed!)
export function buildDateParams(dateRange?: any): Record<string, string> {
  const params: Record<string, string> = {};
  
  let since = dateRange?.startDate;
  let until = dateRange?.endDate;

  if (!since || !until) {
    const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    since = todayStr;
    until = todayStr;
  }

  // Strictly enforce explicit time_range parameter
  params.time_range = JSON.stringify({ since, until });
  return params;
}

// Strict Lead Action Extractor (Prevents Ghost Leads from secondary actions and isolates lead events)
export function extractLeadsFromActions(actionsArray: any[]): { count: number; actionType: string | null } {
  if (!actionsArray || !Array.isArray(actionsArray)) return { count: 0, actionType: null };

  // 1. Se existir o evento agregador 'lead', utiliza-o diretamente (evita sobreposição)
  const leadRollup = actionsArray.find(a => a && a.action_type === 'lead');
  if (leadRollup) {
    const val = parseFloat(leadRollup.value || '0');
    return {
      count: val > 0 ? val : 0,
      actionType: val > 0 ? 'lead' : null
    };
  }

  // 2. Se não houver 'lead', busca o evento com maior contagem estrita de leads
  const leadTypes = [
    'onsite_web_lead',
    'offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_lead', 
    'onsite_conversion.lead_grouped',
    'leadgen_grouped'
  ];

  let maxCount = 0;
  let chosenType: string | null = null;

  for (const action of actionsArray) {
    if (!action || typeof action.action_type !== 'string') continue;
    if (leadTypes.includes(action.action_type) || action.action_type.startsWith('offsite_conversion.custom.')) {
      const val = parseFloat(action.value || '0');
      if (val > maxCount) {
        maxCount = val;
        chosenType = action.action_type;
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    count: maxCount,
    actionType: chosenType
  };
}

// Strict Action Metric Extractor (No Random, No Fallback, Zero "Múltiplas conversões")
export function extractNormalizedMetrics(rawItem: any) {
  const insight = rawItem.insights?.data?.[0];
  const nameStr = String(rawItem.name || '').toUpperCase();
  const objectiveStr = String(rawItem.objective || '').toUpperCase();

  if (!insight) {
    // Derive resultLabel from name/objective even if insight is empty
    let emptyResultLabel = 'Leads';
    if (nameStr.includes('[LEAD D]')) {
      emptyResultLabel = 'Lead D';
    } else if (nameStr.includes('[WHATSAPP]') || objectiveStr.includes('MESSAGES')) {
      emptyResultLabel = 'Conversas Iniciadas';
    } else if (nameStr.includes('DIAGNÓSTICO') || nameStr.includes('LP DIAGNÓST')) {
      emptyResultLabel = 'Lead B LP Diagnóstico';
    } else if (objectiveStr.includes('TRAFFIC')) {
      emptyResultLabel = 'Cliques no Link';
    } else if (objectiveStr.includes('SALES')) {
      emptyResultLabel = 'Compras';
    }

    return {
      spend: null,
      impressions: null,
      clicks: null,
      ctr: null,
      cpc: null,
      cpm: null,
      reach: null,
      frequency: null,
      conversions: null,
      resultLabel: emptyResultLabel,
      cpa: null,
      profileVisits: null,
      retentionPct: null,
      followersGained: null,
      cps: null,
      landingPageViews: null,
      roas: null
    };
  }

  const spend = insight.spend !== undefined && insight.spend !== null ? parseFloat(insight.spend) : null;
  const impressions = insight.impressions !== undefined && insight.impressions !== null ? parseInt(insight.impressions) : null;
  const clicks = insight.clicks !== undefined && insight.clicks !== null ? parseInt(insight.clicks) : null;
  const reach = insight.reach !== undefined && insight.reach !== null ? parseInt(insight.reach) : null;
  const frequency = insight.frequency !== undefined && insight.frequency !== null ? parseFloat(insight.frequency) : null;

  const ctr = insight.ctr !== undefined && insight.ctr !== null ? parseFloat(insight.ctr) : (impressions && clicks !== null ? parseFloat(((clicks / impressions) * 100).toFixed(2)) : null);
  const cpc = insight.cpc !== undefined && insight.cpc !== null ? parseFloat(insight.cpc) : (spend !== null && clicks ? parseFloat((spend / clicks).toFixed(2)) : null);
  const cpm = insight.cpm !== undefined && insight.cpm !== null ? parseFloat(insight.cpm) : (spend !== null && impressions ? parseFloat(((spend / impressions) * 1000).toFixed(2)) : null);

  const actions: Array<{ action_type: string; value: string }> = insight.actions || [];
  const costPerActionType: Array<{ action_type: string; value: string }> = insight.cost_per_action_type || [];
  
  const getActionSum = (types: string[]): number | null => {
    let found = false;
    let sum = 0;
    actions.forEach((act) => {
      if (types.includes(act.action_type)) {
        found = true;
        sum += parseFloat(act.value || '0');
      }
    });
    return found ? sum : null;
  };

  // Primary Action Isolation Logic (Strict Meta Ads Manager Alignment)
  let primaryActionType: string | null = null;
  let conversions: number | null = null;
  let resultLabel: string = 'Leads';
  let cpa: number | null = null;

  if (nameStr.includes('[LEAD D]')) {
    resultLabel = 'Lead D';
    const leadRes = extractLeadsFromActions(actions);
    conversions = leadRes.count > 0 ? leadRes.count : null;
    primaryActionType = leadRes.actionType || 'lead';
  } else if (nameStr.includes('[WHATSAPP]') || objectiveStr.includes('MESSAGES')) {
    resultLabel = 'Conversas Iniciadas';
    const msgAction = actions.find(a => a.action_type === 'onsite_conversion.messaging_conversation_started_7d');
    if (msgAction) {
      const val = parseFloat(msgAction.value || '0');
      conversions = val > 0 ? val : null;
      primaryActionType = msgAction.action_type;
    } else {
      primaryActionType = 'onsite_conversion.messaging_conversation_started_7d';
    }
  } else if (nameStr.includes('DIAGNÓSTICO') || nameStr.includes('LP DIAGNÓST')) {
    resultLabel = 'Lead B LP Diagnóstico';
    const leadRes = extractLeadsFromActions(actions);
    conversions = leadRes.count > 0 ? leadRes.count : null;
    primaryActionType = leadRes.actionType || 'offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_lead';
  } else if (objectiveStr.includes('SALES') || objectiveStr.includes('CONVERSIONS')) {
    resultLabel = 'Compras';
    const purchaseAction = actions.find(a => 
      a.action_type === 'offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_purchase' || 
      a.action_type === 'purchase' || 
      a.action_type === 'omni_purchase'
    );
    if (purchaseAction) {
      const val = parseFloat(purchaseAction.value || '0');
      conversions = val > 0 ? val : null;
      primaryActionType = purchaseAction.action_type;
    } else {
      primaryActionType = 'offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_purchase';
    }
  } else if (objectiveStr.includes('TRAFFIC') || nameStr.includes('CLIQUE')) {
    resultLabel = 'Cliques no Link';
    const clickAction = actions.find(a => a.action_type === 'link_click');
    if (clickAction) {
      const val = parseFloat(clickAction.value || '0');
      conversions = val > 0 ? val : null;
      primaryActionType = clickAction.action_type;
    } else {
      primaryActionType = 'link_click';
    }
  } else {
    // Default to Lead Campaigns (Site/Form Lead)
    resultLabel = 'Leads';
    const leadRes = extractLeadsFromActions(actions);
    conversions = leadRes.count > 0 ? leadRes.count : null;
    primaryActionType = leadRes.actionType || 'lead';
  }

  // Extract CPA strictly from cost_per_action_type array for the isolated primaryActionType
  if (primaryActionType && conversions !== null && conversions > 0) {
    const matchedCost = costPerActionType.find(c => c.action_type === primaryActionType);
    if (matchedCost && matchedCost.value) {
      cpa = parseFloat(parseFloat(matchedCost.value).toFixed(2));
    } else if (spend !== null && spend > 0) {
      cpa = parseFloat((spend / conversions).toFixed(2));
    }
  } else {
    cpa = null;
  }

  // 2. Visitas ao Perfil
  const profileVisits = getActionSum(['instagram_profile_visit']);

  // 3. Retenção de Vídeo %
  const thruplays = getActionSum(['video_thruplay_watched_actions', 'video_p50_watched_actions']);
  const retentionPct = thruplays !== null && impressions && impressions > 0 ? parseFloat(((thruplays / impressions) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null;

  // 4. Seguidores no Instagram
  const followersGained = getActionSum(['profile_follow', 'instagram_profile_follow']);
  const cps = spend !== null && followersGained && followersGained > 0 ? parseFloat((spend / followersGained).toFixed(2)) : null;

  // 5. Visualizações da Página de Destino
  const landingPageViews = getActionSum(['landing_page_view']);

  // 6. ROAS
  const purchaseValue = getActionSum(['omni_purchase', 'purchase', 'offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_purchase']);
  const roas = spend !== null && purchaseValue !== null && spend > 0 ? parseFloat((purchaseValue / spend).toFixed(2)) : null;

  return {
    spend,
    impressions,
    clicks,
    inline_link_clicks: insight.inline_link_clicks !== undefined && insight.inline_link_clicks !== null ? parseInt(insight.inline_link_clicks) : clicks,
    ctr,
    cpc,
    cpm,
    reach,
    frequency,
    conversions,
    resultLabel: resultLabel || 'Leads',
    cpa,
    profileVisits,
    retentionPct,
    followersGained,
    cps,
    landingPageViews,
    actions: insight.actions || [],
    roas
  };
}

// In-Memory Cache Engine (Instant Cache-First Strategy)
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes TTL
const metaInsightsCache = new Map<string, { data: any; timestamp: number }>();

export function clearInsightsCache() {
  metaInsightsCache.clear();
}

function getCacheKey(accountId: string, level: string, dateRange?: any): string {
  const dateStr = dateRange?.startDate && dateRange?.endDate 
    ? `${dateRange.startDate}_${dateRange.endDate}` 
    : (dateRange?.label || 'today');
  return `${accountId}:${level}:${dateStr}`;
}

// Fetch Account Level Insights (Direct from Meta API level=account with Cache-First Strategy)
export async function fetchAccountInsights(config: MetaConfig, dateRange?: any): Promise<any> {
  if (!config.isConnected || !config.accessToken || !config.selectedAccountId) {
    return null;
  }
  const actId = toActAccountId(config.selectedAccountId);
  const cacheKey = getCacheKey(config.selectedAccountId, 'account', dateRange);

  // 1. Check Cache-First
  const cached = metaInsightsCache.get(cacheKey);
  if (cached && (Date.now() - cached.timestamp < CACHE_TTL_MS)) {
    return cached.data;
  }

  const dateParams = buildDateParams(dateRange);

  const params: any = {
    access_token: config.accessToken.trim(),
    fields: 'spend,impressions,clicks,ctr,cpc,cpm,actions,cost_per_action_type',
    level: 'account',
    ...dateParams
  };

  try {
    const res = await axios.get(`${GRAPH_API_BASE}/${actId}/insights`, { params, timeout: 10000 });
    const data = res.data?.data?.[0] || null;
    if (data) {
      metaInsightsCache.set(cacheKey, { data, timestamp: Date.now() });
    }
    return data;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Account level insights fetch failed:', err);
    return cached ? cached.data : null;
  }
}

// Advanced Delivery & Effective Status Resolver Engine (Meta Ads Manager Standard)
export function resolveDeliveryStatus(rawItem: any, level: 'CAMPAIGN' | 'ADSET' | 'AD'): DeliveryStatusInfo {
  const configuredStatus = String(rawItem.configured_status || rawItem.status || '').toUpperCase();
  const effectiveStatus = String(rawItem.effective_status || rawItem.status || '').toUpperCase();
  const nameUpper = String(rawItem.name || '').toUpperCase();
  
  const now = new Date();
  const startTime = rawItem.start_time ? new Date(rawItem.start_time) : null;
  const endTime = rawItem.end_time ? new Date(rawItem.end_time) : null;

  // 1. Rejection / Disapproved Policy Check
  const hasIssuesArray = Array.isArray(rawItem.issues_info) && rawItem.issues_info.some((i: any) => i && (i.error_code || i.level === 'ERROR'));
  const isDisapproved = effectiveStatus.includes('DISAPPROVED') || effectiveStatus.includes('REJECTED') || Boolean(rawItem.ad_review_feedback) || hasIssuesArray;
  if (isDisapproved) {
    let reason = 'Criativo ou configuração violou as diretrizes de publicidade da Meta.';
    if (rawItem.ad_review_feedback) {
      reason = typeof rawItem.ad_review_feedback === 'string' ? rawItem.ad_review_feedback : JSON.stringify(rawItem.ad_review_feedback);
    } else if (Array.isArray(rawItem.issues_info) && rawItem.issues_info[0]?.error_summary) {
      reason = rawItem.issues_info[0].error_summary;
    }
    return {
      code: 'DISAPPROVED',
      label: 'Rejeitado',
      badgeColor: 'red',
      reason
    };
  }

  // 2. Account / Billing / Account Issues Check
  if (effectiveStatus.includes('WITH_ISSUES') || effectiveStatus.includes('ACCOUNT_ERROR')) {
    return {
      code: 'ACCOUNT_ERROR',
      label: 'Erro na conta',
      badgeColor: 'red',
      reason: 'Problema de saldo, cartão recusado ou limite de gastos da conta atingido.'
    };
  }

  // 3. Pending Review Check
  if (effectiveStatus.includes('PENDING_REVIEW') || effectiveStatus.includes('IN_PROCESS')) {
    return {
      code: 'PENDING_REVIEW',
      label: 'Em análise',
      badgeColor: 'yellow',
      reason: 'O criativo foi enviado e está sob análise de conformidade da Meta.'
    };
  }

  // 4. Hierarchical Paused Checks
  if (effectiveStatus === 'PAUSED' || configuredStatus === 'PAUSED') {
    return {
      code: 'PAUSED',
      label: 'Pausado',
      badgeColor: 'gray'
    };
  }

  if (effectiveStatus.includes('CAMPAIGN_PAUSED')) {
    return {
      code: 'PAUSED',
      label: 'Pausado (Campanha)',
      badgeColor: 'gray',
      reason: 'A campanha pai está pausada no Gerenciador de Anúncios.'
    };
  }

  if (effectiveStatus.includes('ADSET_PAUSED')) {
    return {
      code: 'PAUSED',
      label: 'Pausado (Conjunto)',
      badgeColor: 'gray',
      reason: 'O conjunto de anúncios pai está pausado no Gerenciador de Anúncios.'
    };
  }

  if (effectiveStatus.includes('ARCHIVED')) {
    return {
      code: 'COMPLETED',
      label: 'Arquivado',
      badgeColor: 'gray'
    };
  }

  // 5. Scheduled Check (Future Start Time)
  if (effectiveStatus.includes('SCHEDULED') || (startTime && startTime > now)) {
    return {
      code: 'SCHEDULED',
      label: 'Programado',
      badgeColor: 'blue',
      reason: `Programado para iniciar veiculação em ${startTime ? startTime.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR') : 'data futura'}.`
    };
  }

  // 6. Completed Check (Past End Time)
  if (endTime && endTime < now) {
    return {
      code: 'COMPLETED',
      label: 'Concluído',
      badgeColor: 'gray',
      reason: 'A data final programada foi atingida.'
    };
  }

  // 7. Learning Phase & Limited Learning Checks (AdSets / Ads)
  if (level === 'ADSET' || level === 'AD') {
    if (nameUpper.includes('[LIMITADO]') || nameUpper.includes('APRENDIZADO LIMITADO') || effectiveStatus.includes('LEARNING_LIMITED')) {
      return {
        code: 'LEARNING_LIMITED',
        label: 'Aprendizado limitado',
        badgeColor: 'amber',
        reason: 'O conjunto não atingiu 50 conversões em 7 dias e a otimização de entrega foi travada.'
      };
    }

    if (nameUpper.includes('[APRENDIZADO]') || effectiveStatus.includes('IN_LEARNING') || effectiveStatus.includes('LEARNING')) {
      return {
        code: 'IN_LEARNING',
        label: 'Em aprendizado',
        badgeColor: 'blue',
        reason: 'O sistema da Meta está coletando dados de entrega para estabilizar o custo por resultado.'
      };
    }
  }

  // Default Active
  return {
    code: 'ACTIVE',
    label: 'Ativo',
    badgeColor: 'green'
  };
}

// Persistent Master Object Stores (Ensures entity master lists are never lost or emptied)
const masterCampaignsStore = new Map<string, any[]>();
const masterAdSetsStore = new Map<string, any[]>();
const masterAdsStore = new Map<string, any[]>();

// Fetch Live Campaigns with Master List + Left Join Metrics Consolidation
export async function fetchCampaigns(config: MetaConfig, dateRange?: any): Promise<MetaCampaign[]> {
  if (!config.isConnected || !config.accessToken || !config.selectedAccountId) {
    return [];
  }

  const actId = toActAccountId(config.selectedAccountId);
  const normAcc = normalizeAccountId(config.selectedAccountId);
  const cacheKey = getCacheKey(config.selectedAccountId, 'campaigns', dateRange);

  const dateParams = buildDateParams(dateRange);

  try {
    // 1. ALWAYS FETCH Master List of Campaigns (No date_preset / time_range params)
    let rawCampaigns: any[] = [];
    try {
      rawCampaigns = await fetchAllPages(`${GRAPH_API_BASE}/${actId}/campaigns`, {
        access_token: config.accessToken.trim(),
        fields: 'id,name,status,effective_status,configured_status,objective,daily_budget,lifetime_budget,start_time,end_time,issues_info,created_time',
        limit: 500
      });
      if (rawCampaigns && rawCampaigns.length > 0) {
        masterCampaignsStore.set(normAcc, rawCampaigns);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to fetch live master campaign list, using fallback store:', e);
      rawCampaigns = masterCampaignsStore.get(normAcc) || [];
    }

    if ((!rawCampaigns || rawCampaigns.length === 0) && masterCampaignsStore.has(normAcc)) {
      rawCampaigns = masterCampaignsStore.get(normAcc) || [];
    }

    // 2. Query Campaign Level Insights for the filtered date period
    const campaignInsightsMap = new Map<string, any>();
    try {
      const insightsList = await fetchAllPages(`${GRAPH_API_BASE}/${actId}/insights`, {
        access_token: config.accessToken.trim(),
        level: 'campaign',
        fields: 'campaign_id,spend,impressions,inline_link_clicks,inline_link_click_ctr,clicks,ctr,cpc,cpm,reach,frequency,actions,cost_per_action_type,video_thruplay_watched_actions,video_p50_watched_actions',
        limit: 500,
        ...dateParams
      });
      insightsList.forEach((ins: any) => {
        if (ins.campaign_id) {
          campaignInsightsMap.set(ins.campaign_id, ins);
        }
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Campaign level insights query warning:', err);
    }

    // 3. LEFT JOIN: Merge Master List with Period Insights
    const result = rawCampaigns.map((rawItem: any) => {
      try {
        const periodInsight = campaignInsightsMap.get(rawItem.id);
        const itemWithInsight = {
          ...rawItem,
          insights: periodInsight ? { data: [periodInsight] } : { data: [] }
        };

        const parsed = extractNormalizedMetrics(itemWithInsight);
        const deliveryInfo = resolveDeliveryStatus(rawItem, 'CAMPAIGN');
        const fetchedAt = new Date().toISOString();

        const lineage: DataLineage = {
          source: 'META_MARKETING_API',
          endpoint: `${actId}/campaigns`,
          apiVersion: DEFAULT_API_VERSION,
          fetchedAt,
          accountId: config.selectedAccountId,
          level: 'CAMPAIGN',
          recordId: rawItem.id,
          rawRecord: rawItem,
          reconciliationStatus: 'VALID'
        };

        rawAuditStore.set(`CAMPAIGN:${rawItem.id}`, { raw: rawItem, lineage });

        return {
          id: rawItem.id,
          name: rawItem.name || `Campanha ${rawItem.id}`,
          status: (rawItem.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'ACTIVE' : 'PAUSED') as 'ACTIVE' | 'PAUSED',
          effective_status: rawItem.effective_status || rawItem.status || 'PAUSED',
          deliveryInfo,
          objective: rawItem.objective || 'UNKNOWN',
          daily_budget: rawItem.daily_budget ? parseFloat(rawItem.daily_budget) / 100 : null,
          lifetime_budget: rawItem.lifetime_budget ? parseFloat(rawItem.lifetime_budget) / 100 : null,
          spend: parsed.spend,
          impressions: parsed.impressions,
          clicks: parsed.clicks,
          inline_link_clicks: parsed.inline_link_clicks,
          ctr: parsed.ctr,
          cpc: parsed.cpc,
          conversions: parsed.conversions,
          resultLabel: parsed.resultLabel,
          cpa: parsed.cpa,
          roas: parsed.roas,
          reach: parsed.reach,
          frequency: parsed.frequency,
          cpm: parsed.cpm,
          profileVisits: parsed.profileVisits,
          retentionPct: parsed.retentionPct,
          followersGained: parsed.followersGained,
          cps: parsed.cps,
          landingPageViews: parsed.landingPageViews,
          actions: parsed.actions || rawItem.insights?.data?.[0]?.actions || rawItem.actions || [],
          created_time: rawItem.created_time || fetchedAt,
          rawRecord: rawItem,
          lineage
        };
      } catch (itemErr) {
        console.warn('Failed to parse individual campaign item, returning safe default:', itemErr);
        return {
          id: rawItem.id,
          name: rawItem.name || 'Campanha Meta',
          status: (rawItem.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'ACTIVE' : 'PAUSED') as 'ACTIVE' | 'PAUSED',
          effective_status: rawItem.effective_status || rawItem.status || 'PAUSED',
          deliveryInfo: { code: 'ACTIVE' as const, label: 'Ativo', badgeColor: 'green' as const },
          objective: rawItem.objective || 'UNKNOWN',
          daily_budget: rawItem.daily_budget ? parseFloat(rawItem.daily_budget) / 100 : null,
          lifetime_budget: rawItem.lifetime_budget ? parseFloat(rawItem.lifetime_budget) / 100 : null,
          spend: null,
          impressions: null,
          clicks: null,
          ctr: null,
          cpc: null,
          conversions: null,
          resultLabel: 'Leads',
          cpa: null,
          roas: null,
          reach: null,
          frequency: null,
          cpm: null,
          profileVisits: null,
          retentionPct: null,
          followersGained: null,
          cps: null,
          landingPageViews: null,
          created_time: rawItem.created_time || new Date().toISOString(),
          rawRecord: rawItem
        };
      }
    });

    if (result.length > 0) {
      metaInsightsCache.set(cacheKey, { data: result, timestamp: Date.now() });
    }

    return result;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Meta API campaigns fetch failed, returning stored master list fallback:', err);
    const fallbackList = masterCampaignsStore.get(normAcc) || [];
    return fallbackList.map((rawItem: any) => ({
      id: rawItem.id,
      name: rawItem.name,
      status: (rawItem.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'ACTIVE' : 'PAUSED') as 'ACTIVE' | 'PAUSED',
      effective_status: rawItem.effective_status || rawItem.status,
      deliveryInfo: resolveDeliveryStatus(rawItem, 'CAMPAIGN'),
      objective: rawItem.objective || 'UNKNOWN',
      daily_budget: rawItem.daily_budget ? parseFloat(rawItem.daily_budget) / 100 : null,
      lifetime_budget: rawItem.lifetime_budget ? parseFloat(rawItem.lifetime_budget) / 100 : null,
      spend: null,
      impressions: null,
      clicks: null,
      ctr: null,
      cpc: null,
      conversions: null,
      resultLabel: 'Leads',
      cpa: null,
      roas: null,
      reach: null,
      frequency: null,
      cpm: null,
      profileVisits: null,
      retentionPct: null,
      followersGained: null,
      cps: null,
      landingPageViews: null,
      created_time: rawItem.created_time || new Date().toISOString(),
      rawRecord: rawItem
    }));
  }
}

// Fetch Live AdSets with Master List + Left Join Consolidation
export async function fetchAdSets(config: MetaConfig, campaigns?: MetaCampaign[], dateRange?: any): Promise<MetaAdSet[]> {
  if (!config.isConnected || !config.accessToken || !config.selectedAccountId) {
    return [];
  }

  const actId = toActAccountId(config.selectedAccountId);
  const normAcc = normalizeAccountId(config.selectedAccountId);
  const cacheKey = getCacheKey(config.selectedAccountId, 'adsets', dateRange);

  const dateParams = buildDateParams(dateRange);

  try {
    // 1. ALWAYS FETCH Master List of AdSets (No date_preset / time_range params)
    let rawAdSets: any[] = [];
    try {
      rawAdSets = await fetchAllPages(`${GRAPH_API_BASE}/${actId}/adsets`, {
        access_token: config.accessToken.trim(),
        fields: 'id,name,status,effective_status,configured_status,campaign_id,campaign{name},daily_budget,lifetime_budget,targeting,start_time,end_time,issues_info',
        limit: 500
      });
      if (rawAdSets && rawAdSets.length > 0) {
        masterAdSetsStore.set(normAcc, rawAdSets);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to fetch live master adsets list, using fallback store:', e);
      rawAdSets = masterAdSetsStore.get(normAcc) || [];
    }

    if ((!rawAdSets || rawAdSets.length === 0) && masterAdSetsStore.has(normAcc)) {
      rawAdSets = masterAdSetsStore.get(normAcc) || [];
    }

    // 2. Query AdSet Level Insights for the filtered date period
    const adsetInsightsMap = new Map<string, any>();
    try {
      const insightsList = await fetchAllPages(`${GRAPH_API_BASE}/${actId}/insights`, {
        access_token: config.accessToken.trim(),
        level: 'adset',
        fields: 'adset_id,spend,impressions,inline_link_clicks,inline_link_click_ctr,clicks,ctr,cpc,cpm,reach,frequency,actions,cost_per_action_type,video_thruplay_watched_actions,video_p50_watched_actions',
        limit: 500,
        ...dateParams
      });
      insightsList.forEach((ins: any) => {
        if (ins.adset_id) {
          adsetInsightsMap.set(ins.adset_id, ins);
        }
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Adset level insights query warning:', err);
    }

    // 3. LEFT JOIN: Merge Master List with Period Insights
    const result = rawAdSets.map((rawItem: any) => {
      try {
        const periodInsight = adsetInsightsMap.get(rawItem.id);
        const itemWithInsight = {
          ...rawItem,
          insights: periodInsight ? { data: [periodInsight] } : { data: [] }
        };

        const parsed = extractNormalizedMetrics(itemWithInsight);
        const deliveryInfo = resolveDeliveryStatus(rawItem, 'ADSET');
        const fetchedAt = new Date().toISOString();

        let targetingSummary = 'Não especificado';
        if (rawItem.targeting) {
          const geo = rawItem.targeting.geo_locations?.countries?.join(', ') || 'Brasil';
          const minAge = rawItem.targeting.min_age || 18;
          const maxAge = rawItem.targeting.max_age || '65+';
          targetingSummary = `${geo} | ${minAge}-${maxAge} anos`;
        }

        const lineage: DataLineage = {
          source: 'META_MARKETING_API',
          endpoint: `${actId}/adsets`,
          apiVersion: DEFAULT_API_VERSION,
          fetchedAt,
          accountId: config.selectedAccountId,
          level: 'ADSET',
          recordId: rawItem.id,
          rawRecord: rawItem,
          reconciliationStatus: 'VALID'
        };

        rawAuditStore.set(`ADSET:${rawItem.id}`, { raw: rawItem, lineage });

        return {
          id: rawItem.id,
          campaign_id: rawItem.campaign_id || rawItem.campaign?.id || '',
          campaign_name: rawItem.campaign?.name || 'Campanha Meta',
          name: rawItem.name || `Conjunto ${rawItem.id}`,
          status: (rawItem.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'ACTIVE' : 'PAUSED') as 'ACTIVE' | 'PAUSED',
          effective_status: rawItem.effective_status || rawItem.status || 'PAUSED',
          deliveryInfo,
          targeting_summary: targetingSummary,
          daily_budget: rawItem.daily_budget ? parseFloat(rawItem.daily_budget) / 100 : null,
          lifetime_budget: rawItem.lifetime_budget ? parseFloat(rawItem.lifetime_budget) / 100 : null,
          spend: parsed.spend,
          impressions: parsed.impressions,
          clicks: parsed.clicks,
          inline_link_clicks: parsed.inline_link_clicks,
          ctr: parsed.ctr,
          cpc: parsed.cpc,
          conversions: parsed.conversions,
          resultLabel: parsed.resultLabel,
          cpa: parsed.cpa,
          roas: parsed.roas,
          reach: parsed.reach,
          frequency: parsed.frequency,
          cpm: parsed.cpm,
          profileVisits: parsed.profileVisits,
          retentionPct: parsed.retentionPct,
          followersGained: parsed.followersGained,
          cps: parsed.cps,
          landingPageViews: parsed.landingPageViews,
          actions: parsed.actions || rawItem.insights?.data?.[0]?.actions || rawItem.actions || [],
          rawRecord: rawItem,
          lineage
        };
      } catch (itemErr) {
        console.warn('Failed to parse individual adset item, returning safe default:', itemErr);
        return {
          id: rawItem.id,
          campaign_id: rawItem.campaign_id || rawItem.campaign?.id || '',
          campaign_name: rawItem.campaign?.name || 'Campanha Meta',
          name: rawItem.name || 'Conjunto Meta',
          status: (rawItem.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'ACTIVE' : 'PAUSED') as 'ACTIVE' | 'PAUSED',

    if (result.length > 0) {

    return result;
  } catch (err) {
